prs.title: test(web-shell): restore the shadow overview focus test budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a describe-scoped 120-second per-test budget to the three tests in the Web Shell browser smoke suite that boot the app twice: the shadow-DOM session-overview focus test and the two `sorting during rename preserves keyboard navigation` cases. Each group gets a `test.describe` wrapper with `test.describe.configure({ timeout: 120_000 })`, so the budget covers the shared `beforeEach` boot as well as the test body — a body-scoped `test.setTimeout` would run only after the hook had already spent the suite's 60-second ceiling.

The diff is +115/−97 in that one spec file: the two wrappers, the two `configure` calls, explanatory comments, and re-indentation of the wrapped bodies. No assertion, locator, input, or step ordering is changed — the independent verification on this PR confirmed identical token counts between base and head (`expect(` 96→96, `getByRole(` 71→71, `.fill(` 6→6, `.press(` 9→9, `.hover(` 6→6, `.goto(` 3→3, `.click(` 23→23; counting the bare word `expect` gives 102→102 on both sides). Nothing is skipped, loosened, retried, or wrapped in retry logic, and the shared suite configuration is not modified.

## Why it's needed

**The budget addresses boot cost.** These three tests boot the app twice — once in the file-level `beforeEach` on `/`, and again on their own scenario (the shadow-DOM harness page is its own dev-server entry; the sorting tests install their own mock daemon and re-navigate). On a loaded host that double boot stretches past the suite's default 60-second per-test ceiling while every assertion is still passing, so the run aborts on whichever wait happens to be in flight. Under one-core contention the shadow test measured 50–66s and the 4-session sorting test ~72s — the old ceiling sits inside the tests' runtime distribution under load, not above it.

**Provenance.** A 120-second budget was authored for the shadow test in #17063 (`ec1df00d60`). #17067 withdrew it when the failure it was meant to cover proved to be a deterministic `More`-locator timeout — the footer-only shadow harness never renders that button, so no ceiling could rescue the click — and #17092 (`c75a831d39`) removed the raise from main. This PR re-lands the budget on the new double-boot measurements above, for boot cost only. The code comment records this history so a future deflake round does not read the raise as an accident to be undone.

**The patrol failure is a different, already-fixed bug.** The failure CI Failure Patrol reported in #17483 was that deterministic `More`-locator timeout (3/3 attempts on the stale-branch head), already fixed on main by #17067; its triage concluded no stabilization is needed on current main. This PR does not fix that failure and does not close the issue — it references it for context only.

**Known residual, out of scope.** Under contention a background session refresh can still remount the focused row and drop focus to `<body>`: a new sessions array recomputes the panel's `columns` memo, every inline `cell` closure becomes a new component type, and TanStack `flexRender` remounts each cell, detaching the focused node. This is a pre-existing production rendering defect, reproduced at unit level and under load during this PR's review — it is not introduced here, and the budget does not address it. It is tracked in #17547 with the measurements, the invariants a fix must preserve, and acceptance criteria. The code comment names this residual so a future CI red on the focus assertion is not misdiagnosed as a budget regression.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the touched spec file in the Web Shell package and confirm all of its tests pass (14 runs with the table-driven cases), including the named shadow-portal test:

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
npx playwright test web-shell.session-overview.spec.ts
```

Then confirm the budget is what makes the difference under load (Linux): pin the run to a single CPU with one competing busy loop, `--workers=1 --retries=0`, and repeat the named test:

```bash
taskset -c 0 npx playwright test web-shell.session-overview.spec.ts \
  -g "shadow portal details keep focus" --repeat-each=2 --retries=0
```

With the base revision of the spec file (60s ceiling) those repetitions fail with `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded`; with this branch they pass. The [independent verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17487#issuecomment-6935033555) ran exactly this A/B on the same tree and dependencies (only the spec file differs between arms): three loaded cells flip 3/3 from a 60s budget abort on base to a pass on head, with the passing head runs at ~66s (shadow, 2 runs) and ~72s (sorting with 4 sessions) — above the old ceiling, so the raise, not a quieter host, carried them. It also probed the mechanism directly: a describe-scoped `configure({ timeout })` bounds the `beforeEach` hook (a 3s group budget reds inside a 5s hook; a 120s budget passes a 65s hook) and does not leak to tests outside the describe (still 60000ms).

To confirm the assertions were not weakened, diff the spec file: the only additions are the two describe wrappers, the two `configure` calls, and the comments; everything else is re-indentation. The verification report's token-count comparison above is the scripted form of that check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behavior. Before/after test output is under How to verify above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux against the package's real Vite dev server and a real Chromium. The macOS leg was verified by the maintainer at this head (arm64, real Chromium 1208, pre-warmed Vite dev server): full spec 14/14 twice, plus a describe-timeout mechanism probe — see the [local verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17487#issuecomment-6953541258). The author's initial measurements ran in a sandbox that needed two environment workarounds (Chromium system libraries staged outside the repository via `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`; `COREPACK_HOME` pointed at a temp directory); neither touched repository configuration. The independent verification ran in a credential-free `node:22-bookworm` container with the unchanged lockfile. CPU pinning plus a busy loop is a surrogate for a loaded CI host, not the CI host itself; the head's own CI smoke shards passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely hung run of one of these three tests now takes up to two minutes to be reported instead of one. That is the intended trade — the ceiling only rises, and it applies to the three double-boot tests rather than the suite, so a real regression still fails on its assertions well before the budget matters.
- Known residual: the pre-existing remount focus loss described above is not fixed here; it is tracked in #17547. Under contention the focus assertion can still red for that reason, independently of the budget.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Windows leg was not run locally (macOS was verified by the maintainer, see Environment); the workflow's independent CI remains the final gate. The underlying cost of booting the app twice is not reduced here — removing the shared setup boot for these tests would restructure the file and is deliberately left alone. Vitest does not cover this file, since the package's unit config excludes its e2e directory, so the browser runs above are the focused verification.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No product code, configuration, or dependency changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17483 — patrol context only; the deterministic locator failure it records was fixed on main by #17067, and this PR does not fix it.

Follow-up for the residual remount focus loss: #17547.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为 Web Shell 浏览器冒烟套件中三个会启动应用两次的测试加上 describe 作用域的 120 秒单测试预算：影子 DOM 会话概览焦点测试，以及两个 `sorting during rename preserves keyboard navigation` 用例。每组各加一个 `test.describe` 包裹与 `test.describe.configure({ timeout: 120_000 })`，使预算同时覆盖共享 `beforeEach` 的启动与测试体——测试体内的 `test.setTimeout` 只会在钩子已经耗尽套件 60 秒上限之后才执行。

diff 为该 spec 文件 +115/−97：两个包裹、两个 `configure` 调用、解释性注释，以及被包裹体的重排缩进。所有断言、定位器、输入与步骤顺序均未改动——本 PR 的独立验证确认 base 与 head 的 token 计数完全一致（`expect(` 96→96、`getByRole(` 71→71、`.fill(` 6→6、`.press(` 9→9、`.hover(` 6→6、`.goto(` 3→3、`.click(` 23→23；按裸词 `expect` 计数则两侧同为 102→102）。没有跳过、放宽、重试或包裹重试逻辑，也没有修改共享的套件配置。

## 为什么需要

**预算解决的是启动成本。** 这三个测试会启动应用两次——一次在文件级 `beforeEach` 的 `/` 上，另一次在各自的场景上（影子 DOM 夹具页是 dev server 的独立入口；sorting 测试安装自己的 mock daemon 并重新导航）。在高负载主机上，这次双重启动会把测试推过套件默认的 60 秒单测试上限，而此时每条断言仍在正常通过，于是运行中断在恰好正在执行的那次等待上。单核争用下实测 shadow 测试 50–66s、4 sessions sorting 测试约 72s——旧上限落在这些测试负载下的运行时间分布之内，而非在其之上。

**来历。** #17063（`ec1df00d60`）曾为 shadow 测试编写 120 秒预算。#17067 在其所要覆盖的失败被证实是确定性的 `More` 定位器超时后撤回了它——只有 footer 的影子夹具根本不渲染该按钮，任何上限都救不了这次点击——#17092（`c75a831d39`）把该提升从 main 移除。本 PR 基于上述新的双重启动实测重新落地该预算，且只针对启动成本。代码注释记录了这段历史，避免未来 deflake 轮次把这次提升读成一次可以撤销的事故。

**patrol 失败是另一个已修复的 bug。** CI Failure Patrol 在 #17483 报告的失败正是那个确定性 `More` 定位器超时（旧分支 head 上 3/3 次尝试均失败），已由 #17067 在 main 修复；其 triage 结论是当前 main 无需稳化。本 PR 不修复该失败，也不关闭该 issue——仅引用它作为背景。

**已知残留，范围之外。** 争用下后台会话刷新仍可能重挂载被聚焦的行并把焦点丢到 `<body>`：新的 sessions 数组重算面板的 `columns` memo，每个内联 `cell` 闭包成为新组件类型，TanStack `flexRender` 逐个重挂载单元格，被聚焦节点随之脱离文档。这是一个预存的生产渲染缺陷，在本 PR 评审中已被单元级与负载下复现——不是本 PR 引入的，预算也不解决它。它被跟踪在 #17547，附有实测数据、修复必须保留的不变量与验收标准。代码注释点名了该残留，避免未来该焦点断言的 CI 红被误诊为预算回归。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 Web Shell 包中运行被改动的 spec 文件，确认其全部测试通过（含表驱动用例共 14 次运行），包括被点名的 shadow-portal 测试：

```bash
cd packages/web-shell
npx playwright test web-shell.session-overview.spec.ts
```

然后确认在负载下正是预算起了决定作用（Linux）：把运行绑定到单个 CPU 并加一个竞争忙循环，`--workers=1 --retries=0`，重复被点名测试：

```bash
taskset -c 0 npx playwright test web-shell.session-overview.spec.ts \
  -g "shadow portal details keep focus" --repeat-each=2 --retries=0
```

用 spec 文件的 base 修订版（60s 上限）这些重复会以 `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded` 失败；用本分支则通过。[独立验证报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17487#issuecomment-6935033555)在同一代码树与依赖上跑了这个 A/B（两臂之间只有 spec 文件不同）：三个负载格 3/3 从 base 的 60s 预算中止翻为 head 通过，head 通过耗时约 66s（shadow，2 次）与约 72s（4 sessions sorting）——均超过旧上限，因此撑住它们的是预算提升而非更空闲的主机。报告还直接探针了机制：describe 作用域的 `configure({ timeout })` 约束 `beforeEach` 钩子（3s 组预算在 5s 钩子内红；120s 预算让 65s 钩子通过），且不泄漏给 describe 外的测试（仍为 60000ms）。

评审者若想确认断言未被弱化，可以直接 diff 该 spec 文件：新增的只有两个 describe 包裹、两个 `configure` 调用与注释，其余全是重排缩进。上文验证报告的 token 计数对比就是该检查的脚本化形式。

### 证据（修复前后）

N/A — 仅测试改动，无用户可见行为变化。修复前后的测试输出见上方"如何验证"。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，针对该包真实的 Vite dev server 和真实 Chromium。macOS 分支由维护者在本 head 验证（arm64，真实 Chromium 1208，预热的 Vite dev server）：完整 spec 两遍 14/14，外加 describe-timeout 机制探针——见[本地验证报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17487#issuecomment-6953541258)。作者的最初测量在沙箱中运行，需要两项环境变通（Chromium 系统库暂存到仓库之外并通过 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 提供；`COREPACK_HOME` 指向临时目录）；两者都未触及仓库配置。独立验证在无凭据的 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中进行，依赖与未改动的 lockfile 一致。CPU 绑定加忙循环是高负载 CI 主机的替身，而非 CI 主机本身；head 自身的 CI 冒烟分片已通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：这三个测试中任何一个若真的卡住，现在最多需要两分钟才会被报告，而不是一分钟。这正是预期的权衡——上限只升不降，且只作用于三个双重启动测试而非整个套件，因此真实回归仍会在预算起作用之前很早就因断言失败。
- 已知残留：上文描述的预存重挂载焦点丢失不在此修复，跟踪于 #17547。争用下焦点断言仍可能因此变红，与预算无关。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：Windows 分支未在本地运行（macOS 已由维护者验证，见"环境"）；工作流的独立 CI 仍是最终关卡。此处并未降低"启动应用两次"的底层成本——为这些测试移除共享 setup 启动会重构整个文件，故刻意不动。Vitest 不覆盖此文件，因为该包的单测配置排除了其 e2e 目录，所以上述浏览器运行就是聚焦验证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有产品代码、配置或依赖改动。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #17483 — 仅作 patrol 背景；其中记录的确定性定位器失败已由 #17067 在 main 修复，本 PR 不修复它。

残留重挂载焦点丢失的后续跟踪：#17547。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): unify unbound Session authority under the ownership row [16023 A/2]
prs.body:
Split from #16023 at source commit `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935` (base `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e` on `main`); candidate A: `24a02a0165494`. This is **[16023 A/2]** — the unbound Session principal ownership migration extracted from #16023 so it can be reviewed and verified independently of the shared resident external Workspace runtime changes in #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**). Both A/2 and B/2 target `main` directly with zero runtime dependency between them.

## What this PR does

Unifies unbound (non-Workspace) Session ownership under an immutable ownership record written in the Session creation transaction. Every new unbound Session persists its verified caller principal (tenant, user, and optional business actor subject) in `ma_session_principal`. When an ownership row is present, that row is the sole authority for reading, listing, replaying, and mutating the Session, and a caller whose principal does not match receives a fail-closed `404 session_not_found`. Genuine legacy row-less Sessions remain tenant-wide so pre-existing records continue to work, while actorless creation of new unbound Sessions is closed across all routes.

It also widens `actor_id` to `VARBINARY(2048)` on the user-message queue tables so raw Workspace actors that exceed the 512-byte principal component bound continue to work on Workspace-bound routes without eagerly constructing a byte-bounded `SessionPrincipal`, and decomposes the store collaborators so every class stays below its class-size ratchet ceiling with zero ceiling increases.

## Why it's needed

Previously, #16023 bundled this 99-file unbound Session principal ownership migration together with the 70-file shared resident external Workspace lifecycle changes (+12,319 lines total). Because unbound Session ownership changes who may create, read, list, replay, and mutate non-Workspace Sessions across every controller and store surface, it is a distinct trust boundary that deserves dedicated review and standalone CI execution against `main`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the ownership, route-authority, transaction-boundary, and class-size ratchet tests from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=SessionPrincipalOwnershipTest,SubjectActorRouteOwnershipTest,PrincipalEntryTransactionBoundaryTest,ManagedTaskActorBoundaryTest,TenantContextFilterTest,ManagedStoreDecompositionTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

Expected:
- A newly created unbound Session writes one row in `ma_session_principal` and is visible only to its owning principal; another user or another business actor subject of the same user receives `404 session_not_found`.
- Idempotent replay of Session creation, turn submission, cancellation, rename, and lifecycle mutations checks the caller principal before returning a recorded receipt, and cross-Session key collisions do not leak foreign Session existence.
- Bound Workspace routes defer principal construction so a 1,536-byte UTF-8 Workspace actor continues to read and operate its bound Session without hitting `400 invalid_actor`.
- `ClassSizeRatchetTest` passes with zero ceiling raises.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend authority and schema change with no TUI/UI surface.

Local verification on macOS (JDK 21):

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) for offline reactor compilation and unit tests; Linux and MySQL 8.4 lanes run in CI against `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changing read/write/replay authority for unbound Sessions can break callers that omit the trusted actor header or reuse idempotency keys across Sessions. Row-less legacy Sessions keep their existing tenant-wide behavior, and Workspace-bound routes keep raw-actor compatibility.
- Not validated / out of scope: the shared resident external Workspace lifecycle, `reattach`, and `EPHEMERAL` storage registration from #16023 are split into #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**) and are intentionally absent here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: adds `ma_session_principal` to `V1__managed_schema.sql` (following the pre-release baseline policy where `ManagedSchema.schemaVersion()` is 1) and closes actorless creation of new unbound Sessions (`401 actor_required`).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15512, #15247. Split from #16023 (`[16023 A/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #16023 的源码提交 `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935`（基于 `main` 的 `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e`）拆分而来；候选提交 A 为 `24a02a0165494`。本 PR 是 **[16023 A/2]** —— 将无绑定（非 Workspace）Session 的 principal 归属迁移从 #16023 中独立出来，以便与 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)（常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话共享）分别评审与验证。A/2 与 B/2 均直接以 `main` 为 base，两者之间零运行时代码依赖。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

将无绑定（非 Workspace）Session 的归属权统一收敛到创建事务内写入的不可变归属记录中。每个新建的无绑定 Session 都会在 `ma_session_principal` 表中持久化经过校验的调用方 principal（tenant、user 以及可选的业务 actor subject）。当归属行存在时，该行即为读取、列表、幂等重放与变更该 Session 的唯一权限依据；principal 不匹配的调用方会收到 fail-closed 的 `404 session_not_found`。真正无归属行的存量旧 Session 保持租户内可见以兼容历史数据，而所有新建无绑定 Session 的无 actor 创建路径均已关闭。

同时将用户消息队列表上的 `actor_id` 拓宽为 `VARBINARY(2048)`，使超过 512 字节 principal 限制的原始 Workspace actor 在绑定 Workspace 的路由上继续正常工作（不会提前构造受字节限制的 `SessionPrincipal`），并拆解了 Store 协作类，使所有类均保持在 class-size ratchet 上限之内且零上限上调。

## 为什么需要它

此前 #16023 将这部分涉及 99 个文件的无绑定 Session principal 归属迁移与 70 个文件的常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话生命周期改动绑在了同一个 PR（共 +12,319 行）。由于无绑定 Session 归属变更直接决定谁能创建、读取、列表、重放和修改非 Workspace 会话，属于独立的安全与信任边界，拆出后可以单独评审并直接针对 `main` 跑全量 CI。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行归属权、路由鉴权、事务边界与类尺寸上限测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=SessionPrincipalOwnershipTest,SubjectActorRouteOwnershipTest,PrincipalEntryTransactionBoundaryTest,ManagedTaskActorBoundaryTest,TenantContextFilterTest,ManagedStoreDecompositionTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

预期行为：
- 新建无绑定 Session 会写入一行 `ma_session_principal`，且仅对该归属 principal 可见；其他用户或同一用户的其他业务 actor subject 访问时返回 `404 session_not_found`。
- Session 创建、Turn 提交、取消、重命名及生命周期变更的幂等重放在返回已记录回执前均会校验调用方 principal，且跨 Session 的幂等键碰撞不会泄露外部 Session 是否存在。
- 绑定 Workspace 的路由推迟构造 principal，使 1,536 字节 UTF-8 的 Workspace actor 仍可正常读取和操作其绑定 Session，不会触发 `400 invalid_actor`。
- `ClassSizeRatchetTest` 通过且没有任何类尺寸上限上调。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端鉴权与 Schema 变更）。

本地 macOS（JDK 21）验证：

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

本地使用 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）完成离线全模块编译校验；Linux 与 MySQL 8.4 通道由针对 `main` 的 CI 执行。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：收敛无绑定 Session 的读/写/重放权限会影响未携带可信 actor 请求头或跨 Session 复用幂等键的调用方。无归属行的历史 Session 保持原有租户级行为不变，绑定 Workspace 的路由保持原始 actor 兼容性。
- 未验证 / 范围外：原 #16023 中的常驻外部 Workspace 共享生命周期、`reattach` 以及 `EPHEMERAL` 存储注册已拆分至 #17472 (**[16023 B/2]**)，不在本 PR 范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：向 `V1__managed_schema.sql` 基线新增 `ma_session_principal` 表（遵循首次正式发布前单 V1 基线策略），并关闭无 actor 的新建无绑定 Session（返回 `401 actor_required`）。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15512、#15247。拆自 #16023（`[16023 A/2]`）。

prs.title: fix(verify-pr): register the watch round ahead of prepare (R17-2 liveness)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Registers a `/verify-pr --watch` round **ahead of prepare** instead of after it. The watch-state helper's `--start` no longer requires `--artifact-dir` (the directory prepare prints); the directory is recorded at `--complete`, which already falls back to the in-flight marker. The skill contract (the watch prompt and the manual re-verification step) now registers first, then runs prepare, and releases the marker if prepare fails after registration. `--start --artifact-dir <dir>` is still accepted, so existing callers are unaffected.

## Why it's needed

This closes **R17-2**, the last open item in the "report integrity / local correctness / docs / liveness" tier of #17371 (the residual-risk inventory accepted by #17185's land-with-residual-risk decision). The probe cursor advances when a head-move event is *delivered* to the model — before prepare runs. Under the old contract a session killed inside the prepare window (after delivery, before `--start`) left the delivered head in **no state**: the cursor had already advanced past it, so no second event arrived, and no in-flight marker recorded the delivery. The head was silently dropped — even the next head move could not recover it, because the new head's `--start` saw no blocker and the dropped head left no trace. Registering first turns that silent drop into a recoverable in-flight marker (the existing dead-round `--release` recovery now also covers a prepare-window kill). It is a liveness/availability fix, not attacker-controlled. The core trust-boundary residual R17-1 was already closed by #17375; R16-1/R16-2/R16-4 and D17-1…3 by #17440.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Non-user-visible (a CLI helper + skill prose). From the repo root with Node ≥22:

- Unit witnesses: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-state.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js` — the new `R17-2 register ahead of prepare` block covers `--start` without a dir (in flight, null dir), backward-compatible `--start --artifact-dir`, empty-dir rejection, `--complete` recording the dir, the inherit fallback, and a prepare-window kill leaving a recoverable marker.
- Real CLI: in a temp `git init` state root, `node scripts/verify-pr-watch-state.mjs 7 --start --head <40hex> --round 11 --repo o/r --state-root <root>` now exits 0 (before: exit 2 `--start requires --artifact-dir`); a following `--release --head <40hex>` then `--start --round 12` exits 0 (the head is startable again, not deduped away).
- Mutation: re-adding the `--start requires --artifact-dir` guard reds the registration-ahead witness; forcing `completeRound`'s recorded dir to `null` reds the dir-recording witness.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Baseline dry-run: `--start` without `--artifact-dir` exited 2 with `--start requires --artifact-dir`; after the change it exits 0 and records an in-flight entry with a null directory. Four scripts suites: 581 total, 576 passed, 0 failed, 5 ambient-gated skips. Both mutation witnesses KILLED with byte-level restore (sha256 verified). Real CLI probe 12/12 PASS.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node v24.22.1; unit tests + real `verify-pr-watch-state.mjs` CLI invocations against temp git state roots. No daemon/sandbox needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a completion that omits `--artifact-dir` records a null directory on the verdict (the artifact link degrades, certification is unaffected); the contract instructs passing it, and the optional fallback preserves the inconclusive/replay paths.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows lanes (scripts-only, exercised on Linux); the below-Critical deferred items (D17-4…14, R5-2, round-7/8 deferred) stay tracked in #17371. The watch-gate ownership/cursor, dedup/defer/release semantics, and trust-boundary checks are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — `--start --artifact-dir` remains accepted; only a requirement is removed and the contract reordered. A verify checkout synced to pre-R17-2 main still works (the old contract remains valid) until re-synced.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/verify-pr-register-ahead-of-prepare.md) · [中文](docs/design/verify-pr-register-ahead-of-prepare.zh-CN.md) (synchronized).

## Linked Issues

References #17371 (closes the R17-2 residual; the issue tracks further below-Critical items, so it is not auto-closed).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

把 `/verify-pr --watch` 轮次的注册**提前到 prepare 之前**，而非之后。watch-state 助手的 `--start` 不再强制 `--artifact-dir`（prepare 打印的目录）；目录在 `--complete` 记录，后者本就回退到在飞标记。skill 契约（watch prompt 与手动复验步骤）现在先注册、再跑 prepare，并在注册后 prepare 失败时 release 标记。`--start --artifact-dir <dir>` 仍被接受，既有调用方不受影响。

## 为何需要

闭合 **R17-2**——#17371（#17185 land-with-residual-risk 决定接受的残余清单）「报告完整性 / 本地正确性 / 文档 / 活性」层最后一个开放项。探针游标在 head-move 事件*投递*给模型时前进——早于 prepare。旧契约下，会话在 prepare 窗口内被杀（投递后、`--start` 前）使已投递 head **无状态**：游标已越过它，无第二次事件，也无在飞标记记录投递。head 被静默丢弃——即便下一次 head move 也无法恢复，因为新 head 的 `--start` 看不到阻塞者，被丢的 head 不留痕迹。先注册把静默丢弃变为可恢复的在飞标记（既有死轮 `--release` 恢复现在也覆盖 prepare 窗口被杀）。这是活性/可用性修复，非攻击者可控。核心信任边界残余 R17-1 已由 #17375 闭合；R16-1/R16-2/R16-4 与 D17-1…3 由 #17440 闭合。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

非用户可见（CLI 助手 + skill  prose）。仓库根、Node ≥22：

- 单测见证：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/verify-pr-watch-state.test.js scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js`——新 `R17-2 register ahead of prepare` 块覆盖无目录 `--start`（在飞、null 目录）、向后兼容 `--start --artifact-dir`、空目录拒绝、`--complete` 记录目录、继承回退、prepare 窗口被杀留下可恢复标记。
- 真实 CLI：临时 `git init` 状态根中，`node scripts/verify-pr-watch-state.mjs 7 --start --head <40hex> --round 11 --repo o/r --state-root <root>` 现 exit 0（之前 exit 2 `--start requires --artifact-dir`）；随后 `--release --head <40hex>` 再 `--start --round 12` exit 0（head 可再启动，未被去重丢弃）。
- 变异：重加 `--start requires --artifact-dir` 守卫使提前注册见证变红；强制 `completeRound` 记录目录为 null 使目录记录见证变红。

### 证据（前后）

N/A（非 UI）。基线 dry-run：无 `--artifact-dir` 的 `--start` exit 2 报 `--start requires --artifact-dir`；改后 exit 0 并记录 null 目录的在飞条目。四 scripts 套件：581 总 / 576 过 / 0 败 / 5 环境门控跳过。两变异见证 KILLED，字节级还原（sha256 校验）。真实 CLI 探针 12/12 PASS。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测 · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测 · 🐧 Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

Node v24.22.1；单测 + 对临时 git 状态根的真实 `verify-pr-watch-state.mjs` CLI 调用。无需 daemon/sandbox。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：省略 `--artifact-dir` 的完成会在判定上记录 null 目录（产物链接降级，认证不受影响）；契约指示传它，可选回退保留 inconclusive/replay 路径。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 车道（scripts-only，Linux 演练）；below-Critical 延后项（D17-4…14、R5-2、第 7/8 轮 deferred）仍由 #17371 跟踪。watch-gate 所有权/游标、去重/defer/release 语义、信任边界检查均不变。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无——`--start --artifact-dir` 仍接受；仅移除一个强制要求并重排契约。同步到 R17-2 前 main 的 verify checkout 仍可用（旧契约仍合法）直到再同步。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/verify-pr-register-ahead-of-prepare.md) · [中文](docs/design/verify-pr-register-ahead-of-prepare.zh-CN.md)（已同步）。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #17371（闭合 R17-2 残余；该 issue 还跟踪其它 below-Critical 项，故不自动关闭）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): track model availability for the fallback chain (Qoder port)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ports the Qoder preview line's model-availability ledger into main as the first capability under the Option B integration decision (main's architecture wins; differentiated Qoder capabilities are ported as normal-sized PRs). It adds a session-scoped, per-model health state machine and, behind a new opt-in setting, teaches the model fallback chain to remember which models were just exhausted on capacity errors so it skips them for the rest of the turn and re-probes them once on the next turn. The turn boundary runs once per request at the send entry, and only session-turn sends participate (an `isSessionTurn` allowlist decided by the sender, not inferred from going through `Turn`): `LlmClient` sets the flag per message type for the live turn's own sends, and the ACP session send and the hosted-harness prepared resume set it explicitly, while `Notification`/`Teammate` sends, concurrent side queries, `turnModelRound`'s background rounds (subagent shared loop, unified-loop speculation), and direct background sends (forked queries, suggestions) leave it unset, so they neither disturb the live turn nor skip a recovered fallback. Because a background interaction's ToolResult/Hook/Steer continuations are resubmitted without the flag, a prompt-id registry (`backgroundInteractionPromptIds`) keeps the whole side-query/Notification/Teammate chain excluded, and the ACP sender normalizes mid-turn continuation suffixes into a stable `ledgerTurnKey` so a continuation does not reset the turn's consumed marks. With the setting off, the fallback chain is byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Today the fallback chain is stateless per request: when the primary model exhausts its retry budget on a capacity error (429/503/529), every subsequent request in the same turn re-tries the same exhausted model from scratch before falling back again, wasting latency and quota. The ledger gives the chain cross-request memory within a turn. This is the first, smallest, self-contained capability chosen to establish the Option B porting workflow (design → baseline → implement → verify) before larger ports.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/model-availability-service.test.ts` (10 tests: terminal not downgraded, sticky consumed once per turn, resetTurn/beginTurn re-probe). Preview's `selectFirstAvailable`/`reset` helpers are not ported — nothing in the fallback-skipping wiring calls them, so they would be dead surface.
- Retry + membership threading: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/turn.test.ts -t 'forwards isExplicitRetry and isSessionTurn'` (Turn forwards both flags to the chat send options from its 10th/11th positional slots); `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'explicit-Retry turn-boundary flag'` (only a Retry carries the flag — UserQuery/ToolResult/Hook/Cron/Steer do not); `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'marks ledger membership'` (membership true for UserQuery/Retry/ToolResult/Cron/Goal/Hook/Steer, false for Notification/Teammate).
- Wiring: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t 'sendMessageStream with retries'` (gate off unchanged) — includes `-t 'skips a fallback exhausted earlier'` (gate on: same-turn skip + new-turn re-probe), `-t 'an explicit Retry re-probes'`, and the regression cases: `-t 'subagent send does not wipe'` / `-t 'two consecutive forked'` / `-t 'shared-loop background round'` (background sends — direct and via `turnModelRound` — neither wipe the live turn nor fail on a skipped fallback), `-t 'Retry served by the primary'` (turn boundary hoisted to the request entry), `-t 'failed after emitting output'` (a post-output capacity failure is still recorded), `-t 'non-eligible error'` (a post-output failure on a non-eligible error is NOT recorded), `-t 'resolved model id'` (the skip keys on the resolved id), and `-t 'gate off keeps'` (the gate is falsifiable with a real service injected).
- ACP session turns: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` (1537 tests) — the ACP send sets `isSessionTurn`, and the send-options assertions pin it.
- Gate / Config defaults: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'modelAvailabilityTracking'` (false default, constructor param, stable lazy service instance, per-Config isolation, and derived Configs deliberately share the session ledger through the prototype chain).
- CLI wiring: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'model availability tracking'` (opt-in/opt-out propagation + unset-by-default, mirroring the `unifiedAgentLoop` shape).
- Mutation witnesses (each restored byte-for-byte): deleting the fallback skip-check reds the gate-on test (`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`); deleting the Retry `resetTurn` reds the Retry test (`expected … 2 times, but got 1 times`); deleting the CLI propagation line reds both CLI wiring tests; deleting the `isExplicitRetry` spread in `Turn.run` reds the forwarding test; forcing the client's 10th Turn argument to `false` reds the Retry call-site test; hardcoding `isSessionTurn: true` in `Turn.run` reds the shared-loop background-round test (`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`); forcing the client's membership predicate always-true reds the per-messageType membership test (Notification `true` instead of `false`); removing the hoisted `resetTurn` reds the Retry-served-by-primary test; exempting post-output failures from marking reds the output-then-fail test; removing `&& canTryNextFallback` from the ledger write reds the non-eligible post-output test (the request is then served by a later fallback); switching the skip to the configured id reds the resolved-id test; dropping the gate reds the gate-off test; Config `?? false` → `?? true` reds the default test, a fresh-instance getter reds the stability test, a process-global holder reds the per-Config isolation test, and own-property getter semantics red the derived-Config sharing test; deleting the settings.md row reds the presence test.
- Full affected suites: `llm-chat.test.ts`, `turn.test.ts`, `client.test.ts`, `agent-loop.test.ts`, `goal-turn-integration.test.ts`, core `config.test.ts`, cli `config.test.ts`; core + cli `tsc --noEmit` clean; settings schema regenerated.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI; behavior gated behind an opt-in setting).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests + `npm run build && npm run bundle`. A live headless E2E was attempted with a mock server returning capacity errors for the primary model; reaching the fallback chain requires exhausting the primary's internal retry budget, which the unit tests simulate directly via `maxRetries: 0`. The live run's persistent retry prevented reaching the fallback within the timeout, so the fallback-triggering evidence is the unit + mutation coverage above.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the ledger only affects fallback selection in this port; the primary model is still attempted first. Terminal/quota marking and the prompt-vs-silent policy map are deferred. Internal background sends are excluded from the ledger; the turn key is a single scalar, so the residual case of two genuine user turns sharing one Config concurrently fails open (re-probe = pre-PR behaviour); the design doc records this limitation.
- Not validated / out of scope: cross-session/account-wide health sharing; flipping the setting default; terminal/quota marking; live headless fallback-triggering E2E (see Environment).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; new opt-in setting `experimental.modelAvailabilityTracking` defaults to false.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

First capability ported under the Qoder→main integration's Option B decision (main architecture wins; port differentiated capabilities). No tracking issue is closed by this PR. Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把 Qoder preview 线的模型可用性台账移植进 main，作为选项 B 集成决策（main 架构赢、Qoder 差异化能力按正常粒度 PR 移植）下的首个能力。新增一个会话级、按模型的健康状态机，并在一个新的 opt-in 设置之下，让模型 fallback 链记住刚在容量错误上耗尽的模型，本轮剩余请求跳过它们、下一轮重探一次。轮边界在发送入口每请求执行一次，且只有会话轮发送参与（`isSessionTurn` 白名单，由发送方判定，而非从「走了 `Turn`」推断）：`LlmClient` 按消息类型为实时轮自身的发送置位该标志，ACP 会话发送与 hosted-harness prepared 续发显式置位，而 `Notification`/`Teammate` 发送、并发 side query、`turnModelRound` 的后台轮（subagent 共享 loop、unified-loop speculation）与直接后台发送（forked 查询、建议）不打该标志，既不干扰正在进行的那一轮，也不跳过已恢复的 fallback。由于后台交互的 ToolResult/Hook/Steer 续发不带该标志重新提交，prompt id 登记表（`backgroundInteractionPromptIds`）使侧问/Notification/Teammate 的整条续轮链保持排除；ACP 发送方把轮内续发后缀归一化为稳定的 `ledgerTurnKey`，使续发不会重置本轮已消费的标记。设置关闭时 fallback 链逐字节不变。

## 为什么需要

如今 fallback 链每请求无状态：主模型在容量错误（429/503/529）上耗尽重试预算后，同一轮的每个后续请求都从头重试同样耗尽的模型再 fallback，白白消耗时延与配额。台账给链上提供轮内跨请求记忆。这是为建立选项 B 移植流程（设计→基线→实现→验证）而选的首个最小、自包含能力，之后再做更大的移植。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 单测：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/model-availability-service.test.ts`（10 条：terminal 不降级、sticky 每轮消费一次、resetTurn/beginTurn 重探）。preview 的 `selectFirstAvailable`/`reset` 助手不移植——fallback-跳过接线中没有调用方，移植只会是死代码。
- Retry + 成员资格穿线：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/turn.test.ts -t 'forwards isExplicitRetry and isSessionTurn'`（Turn 从第 10/11 个位置参数把两个标志透传到 chat send options）；`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'explicit-Retry turn-boundary flag'`（仅 Retry 带该标志——UserQuery/ToolResult/Hook/Cron/Steer 不带）；`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'marks ledger membership'`（UserQuery/Retry/ToolResult/Cron/Goal/Hook/Steer 成员资格为 true，Notification/Teammate 为 false）。
- 接线：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t 'sendMessageStream with retries'`（gate off 不变）——含 `-t 'skips a fallback exhausted earlier'`（gate on：同轮跳过 + 新轮重探）、`-t 'an explicit Retry re-probes'`，以及回归用例：`-t 'subagent send does not wipe'` / `-t 'two consecutive forked'` / `-t 'shared-loop background round'`（后台发送——直调与经 `turnModelRound`——既不擦除正在进行那一轮，也不因跳过 fallback 而失败）、`-t 'Retry served by the primary'`（轮边界提升到请求入口）、`-t 'failed after emitting output'`（产出后的容量失败仍被记录）、`-t 'non-eligible error'`（产出后失败但错误非 eligible 时不被记录）、`-t 'resolved model id'`（跳过以解析后 id 为键）、`-t 'gate off keeps'`（注入真实 service 时门可被证伪）。
- ACP 会话轮：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts`（1537 条）——ACP 发送置位 `isSessionTurn`，send-options 断言钉住它。
- 门 / Config 默认值：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'modelAvailabilityTracking'`（false 默认、构造参数、稳定懒加载 service 单实例、按 Config 隔离，以及派生 Config 刻意通过原型链共享会话台账）。
- CLI 接线：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'model availability tracking'`（opt-in/opt-out 透传 + 默认 unset，镜像 `unifiedAgentLoop` 形状）。
- 变异见证（均字节级还原）：删 fallback 链跳过检查使 gate-on 用例红（`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`）；删 Retry 的 `resetTurn` 使 Retry 用例红（`expected … 2 times, but got 1 times`）；删 CLI 透传行使两条 CLI 接线用例红；删 `Turn.run` 的 `isExplicitRetry` spread 使透传用例红；把 client 第 10 个 Turn 参数强制为 `false` 使 Retry 调用点用例红；在 `Turn.run` 硬编码 `isSessionTurn: true` 使 shared-loop 后台轮用例红（`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`）；把 client 成员资格判据强制恒 true 使按 messageType 的成员资格用例红（Notification 为 `true` 而非 `false`）；删提升后的 `resetTurn` 使 Retry-served-by-primary 用例红；把产出后失败豁免出标记使 output-then-fail 用例红；删台账写入的 `&& canTryNextFallback` 使 non-eligible 产出后用例红（请求转而被更后的 fallback 服务）；把跳过改成配置 id 使 resolved-id 用例红；删门使 gate-off 用例红；Config `?? false`→`?? true` 使默认值用例红、getter 每次新实例使 stability 用例红、进程级持有者使按 Config 隔离用例红、getter 自有属性语义使派生 Config 共享用例红；删 settings.md 行使存在性用例红。
- 受影响全量套件：`llm-chat.test.ts`、`turn.test.ts`、`client.test.ts`、`agent-loop.test.ts`、`goal-turn-integration.test.ts`、core `config.test.ts`、cli `config.test.ts`；core + cli `tsc --noEmit` 干净；settings schema 已重生成。

N/A（非 UI；行为由 opt-in 设置门控）。

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

本地单测 + `npm run build && npm run bundle`。曾尝试用对 primary 返回容量错误的 mock server 做 live headless E2E；进入 fallback 链需耗尽 primary 的内部重试预算，单测通过 `maxRetries: 0` 直接模拟。live 运行的持久重试使其在超时内未能进入 fallback，故 fallback 触发的证据为上述单测 + 变异覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：本次移植台账只影响 fallback 选择；primary 仍最先被尝试。terminal/quota 标记与 prompt-vs-silent 策略映射延后。内部后台发送被排除在台账之外；轮键是单个标量，故残余情形——共享同一 Config 的两个真实用户轮并发——会失败即放开（重探＝改动前行为）；设计文档记录了该局限。

prs.title: fix(channels): centralize DingTalk reconnect so one drop arms one chain
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the managed DingTalk stream own its reconnect instead of sharing it with the SDK. SDK `autoReconnect` is turned off, and a drop of a healthy socket and a failed connect attempt both funnel into one scheduler that keeps at most one pending reconnect timer, while at most one connect attempt runs at a time.

## Why it's needed

The SDK arms `setTimeout(this.connect, 1000)` from **every** socket's close event without reading its own `reconnecting` flag — and `this.connect` is this wrapper's `guardedConnect`, which arms its own 5-second retry when an attempt fails. One drop whose replacement also fails before opening therefore leaves **two independent reconnect chains**, and every further close compounds them.

Measured with the real SDK and a fake ws boundary: after a single drop whose replacement closed before opening, two reconnect timers were pending; across five further rounds the pending count climbed 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 and the socket count 2 → 3 → 4 → 6 → 8 → 10.

This is the reconnect-arbitration item deferred from the round-11 review of #17136 and tracked in #17173.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the DingTalk channel suite from `packages/channels/dingtalk` (`npx vitest run`): 1006 tests pass, including three new witnesses over the real SDK with only the ws/axios boundary faked. They count **active timers**, not socket state:

- **A drop whose replacement also fails leaves one pending reconnect, not two.** After the first drop the count is 1 (heartbeat retired, one reconnect armed); after the replacement closes before opening it is still 1, and it stays 1 across four further drop rounds. Before the fix this climbed.
- **A healthy socket dropping still reconnects, now that the SDK does not.** This is the new responsibility: with `autoReconnect` off, nothing else would recover a drop of a working socket.
- **A first connect that never opens surfaces and arms no retry.** A bad credential must reach the operator, not become a silent retry loop. This also keeps the retry callback from re-entering the throwing first-failure path as an unhandled rejection.

Mutation-verified:

- Turning `autoReconnect` back on reds the arbitration witness (`expected 2 to be 1`), the first-failure witness, the SDK wiring pin, and one heartbeat case.
- Removing the wrapper's close→schedule wiring reds the arbitration and healthy-drop witnesses — the stream goes deaf, which is the other half of the change.

Two existing witnesses were **retargeted, not weakened**: the heartbeat cleanup cases now advance the wrapper's retry interval instead of the SDK's 1s (their property is unchanged — removing the heartbeat retire still reds both), and the SDK wiring pin additionally asserts `autoReconnect` is turned off.

`autoReconnect` is set through internals because the published config type omits it even though the runtime reads it (`DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the close handler in `dist/client.mjs`); passing it to the constructor is a type error. The suite alone would not have caught that — package typecheck did.

### Real-environment evidence

A probe ran the real SDK, the real `ws` client, real TLS and real timers against a local WSS server; only endpoint discovery was stubbed (an axios adapter), because the real `getEndpoint` needs tenant credentials. Same 22-second window, same server, A/B against the pre-fix setting:

| scenario | before (`autoReconnect` on) | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| server drops each socket 300ms after open | **17** upgrade attempts | **5** |
| server rejects the upgrade after one good connect | **59** upgrade attempts | **4** |

One chain at the wrapper's 5s cadence is ~4–5 attempts in 22s, which is what the fixed code does. The rejected-upgrade case compounds hardest before the fix (~15×).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no TUI or UI surface. The user-visible effect is that a flapping connection no longer multiplies reconnect attempts against the provider.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local TypeScript source via `tsx`. The probe's certificate is self-signed for `localhost` and trusted only through `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` for the probe process; no system trust store, hosts file, or DNS was modified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: recovery from a drop now waits the wrapper's 5-second retry instead of the SDK's 1-second, in exchange for one chain instead of two. A reconnect that fires while an attempt is still running re-arms rather than being dropped, so a busy attempt cannot swallow the recovery.
- Behaviour preserved deliberately: a failure before the first successful connect still surfaces to the caller and arms nothing. Scheduling is refused until `everConnected`, which is also what keeps the deferred retry callback out of the throwing path.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live-tenant smoke. The remaining #17173 connect-lifecycle item (the console-suppression hang) and the state-directory identity key are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No configuration, wire format, or persisted state changes.

## Linked Issues

References #17173 — lands the reconnect-arbitration item deferred from the round-11 review of #17136. Does not close the tracker.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让托管钉钉流自己拥有重连，而不是与 SDK 共享。关掉 SDK 的 `autoReconnect`，健康 socket 掉线与连接尝试失败都汇入同一个调度器：最多一个待触发的重连定时器，同时最多一个连接尝试在跑。

## 为什么需要

SDK 在**每个** socket 的 close 事件上 `setTimeout(this.connect, 1000)`，且不读它自己的 `reconnecting` 标志——而 `this.connect` 正是本 wrapper 的 `guardedConnect`，它在尝试失败时又会武装自己的 5 秒重试。于是「一次掉线 + 替换 socket 在打开前也失败」就留下**两条独立重连链**，此后每次 close 都在复合增长。

用真实 SDK + 假 ws 边界实测：单次掉线且替换在打开前关闭后，有 2 个重连定时器待触发；再经五轮，待触发数 2 → 3 → 4 → 5，socket 数 2 → 3 → 4 → 6 → 8 → 10。

这是 #17136 第 11 轮评审延期、由 #17173 跟踪的重连仲裁项。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/channels/dingtalk` 下跑钉钉频道套件（`npx vitest run`）：1006 条通过，含三条新见证——真实 SDK，只假 ws/axios 边界，断言的是**活跃定时器数**而非 socket 状态：

- **掉线且替换也失败时，只留一个待触发重连，而不是两个。** 首次掉线后计数为 1（心跳已回收、一个重连已武装）；替换在打开前关闭后仍为 1，并在此后四轮掉线中保持 1。修复前这里会爬升。
- **健康 socket 掉线仍会重连——现在 SDK 不管了。** 这是新增的职责：关掉 autoReconnect 后，没有别的东西会恢复一个正常 socket 的掉线。
- **首连从未打开时必须上报且不武装重试。** 坏凭据必须让运维看见，而不是变成静默重试循环。这同时避免延后的重试回调重新进入会抛错的首连失败路径、产生未处理拒绝。

变异验证：把 `autoReconnect` 改回 on，会让仲裁见证（`expected 2 to be 1`）、首连失败见证、SDK 装配钉与一条心跳用例变红；去掉 wrapper 的 close→调度接线，会让仲裁与健康掉线见证变红——流变聋，那是本改动的另一半。

两条既有见证是**改靶而非削弱**：心跳清理用例改为推进 wrapper 的重试间隔而非 SDK 的 1s（性质不变——移除心跳回收仍让两条都红），SDK 装配钉额外断言 `autoReconnect` 被关掉。

`autoReconnect` 经 internals 设置，因为发布的 config 类型没有这个字段，而运行时会读它（`dist/client.mjs` 的 `DEFAULT_CONFIG` 与 close 处理器）；写进构造参数是类型错误。只跑套件抓不到这点，是包类型检查抓到的。

### 真实环境证据

探针用真实 SDK、真实 `ws` 客户端、真实 TLS 与真实定时器对接本地 WSS 服务端；只桩掉端点发现（一个 axios adapter），因为真实 `getEndpoint` 需要租户凭据。同一 22 秒窗口、同一服务端，对修复前设置做 A/B：

| 场景 | 修复前（autoReconnect on） | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 服务端在每个 socket 打开 300ms 后掉线 | **17** 次升级尝试 | **5** |
| 一次成功连接后服务端拒绝升级 | **59** 次升级尝试 | **4** |

wrapper 5s 节奏的单链在 22s 内约 4–5 次，正是修复后的表现。拒绝升级那一档在修复前复合最烈（约 15×）。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A——没有 TUI 或 UI 面。用户可见的效果是：抖动的连接不再对 provider 成倍放大重连尝试。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

通过 `tsx` 跑本地 TypeScript 源码。探针证书为 `localhost` 自签，仅通过 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 让探针进程信任；没有修改系统信任库、hosts 文件或 DNS。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险／权衡：掉线恢复现在等 wrapper 的 5 秒重试而非 SDK 的 1 秒，换来的是单链而非双链。重连触发时若仍有尝试在跑，会重新排期而不是被丢弃，所以忙碌的尝试不会吞掉这次恢复。
- 刻意保留的行为：首次成功连接之前的失败仍向调用方上报且不武装任何重试。调度在 `everConnected` 之前一律拒绝，这也正是让延后的重试回调避开抛错路径的原因。

prs.title: fix(sdk-python): isolate initialization from caller cancellation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keep the Python SDK's shared initialization alive when one waiting control call is cancelled. Other waiting calls, later calls and prompt input can continue after the initialization reply. Query-owned shutdown still stops those continuations before they write another prompt or control request.

## Why it's needed

Every initialization waiter currently awaits the same task directly. Cancelling one public call therefore cancels the shared handshake, an unrelated waiting call and prompt input. The transport remains open, but the query can no longer make useful progress. Isolating caller cancellation also requires checking whether the query closed during the handshake, so an initialization error cannot let waiting work resume after shutdown.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Delay the initialization reply, start two independent control calls and cancel only one. Deliver a successful initialization reply. The cancelled call should report cancellation, the other call and a later call should receive their own responses, and the prompt should be sent once.
2. Repeat with both a string prompt and asynchronous input. Include an uncancelled control to verify normal startup behavior.
3. Close the query during initialization, then separately reject initialization. Waiting controls must terminate and neither input form may write after shutdown. Background input must not produce an unhandled exception.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The eight new regression cases report **4 failed, 4 passed** on the unchanged base and **8 passed** with this change. The complete local Python SDK suite reports **195 passed, 26 skipped**, with Python linting and the configured type check passing. An independent rerun of the original four-case reproduction reports **4 passed** against the exact proposed commit: cancellation stays with the selected caller, unrelated and later calls succeed, each input form writes one prompt, and the input task is not cancelled.

[Official upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43955496117/job/133608965234) now passes the selected Linux workspace build and static checks. [Python SDK checks](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43955496170/job/133608908711) pass on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12. Both selected Linux unit-test shards now pass. The earlier Draft check snapshot contained 20 successful checks and 26 skipped checks, with none still running at that observation. The earlier local build attempts ended during CLI TypeScript compilation with status 137. This PR is now ready for review after the completed SDK checks and normal Linux build. The ready_for_review workflow will run the integration gates previously skipped for Draft status. Complete repository preflight and official CLI end-to-end coverage remain unverified; those earlier skipped jobs are not counted as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Local Python SDK tests; official Linux build/static checks and Python 3.10–3.12 checks |

### Environment (optional)

Python 3.12.14 on Linux. Node.js 24.22.1 and the pinned pnpm 11.24.0 were used for the attempted workspace build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: isolating cancellation must preserve query-owned shutdown and initialization failure. The regression cases check both outcomes and require that no prompt or control is written after shutdown.
- Not validated / out of scope: official CLI end-to-end behavior, macOS, Windows and the complete repository preflight.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or protocol change. Cancelling one waiting call no longer cancels unrelated calls or input.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17496.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

取消一个等待初始化的控制调用时，保留 Python SDK 的共享初始化任务。初始化成功后，其他等待中的调用、后续调用和提示输入均可继续。查询自身关闭时，这些任务会在写入新的提示或控制请求前停止。

## 修改原因

目前所有初始化等待者都会直接等待同一个任务，因此取消一个公开调用会连带取消共享握手、其他等待中的调用以及提示输入。此时传输仍然打开，但查询已无法继续正常工作。隔离调用者取消后，还需要检查查询是否已在握手期间关闭，避免初始化失败后等待中的任务继续向已关闭的传输写入。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 延迟初始化回复，启动两个独立控制调用，然后只取消其中一个。发送初始化成功回复后，被取消的调用应收到取消结果，另一调用和后续调用应分别成功收到自己的回复，提示应只发送一次。
2. 分别使用字符串提示和异步输入重复测试，并加入没有取消操作的对照，检查正常启动行为。
3. 分别在初始化期间关闭查询、拒绝初始化。等待中的控制调用必须结束，两种输入都不应在关闭后继续写入，后台输入也不应产生未处理异常。

### 修改前后证据

新增八个回归用例在未修改基线上的结果为 **4 失败、4 通过**，修改后为 **8 通过**。完整本地 Python SDK 测试结果为 **195 通过、26 跳过**，Python lint 和配置的类型检查均通过。独立重新运行原始四例复现脚本，在拟提交的精确版本上得到 **4 通过**：取消仅影响指定调用，其他调用和后续调用均成功，两种输入分别发送一条提示，输入任务没有被取消。

[上游官方 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43955496117/job/133608965234) 已通过选定的 Linux 工作区构建和静态检查；[Python SDK 检查](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43955496170/job/133608908711) 在 Python 3.10、3.11 和 3.12 上均通过。选定的两个 Linux 单元测试分片现均已通过。此前 Draft 阶段的检查快照记录 20 项成功、26 项跳过，在该次观察时没有运行中的检查。此前本地构建尝试在 CLI 的 TypeScript 编译阶段以状态码 137 结束。SDK 检查和正常 Linux 构建已完成，本 PR 现已进入正式评审；ready_for_review 工作流将运行此前因 Draft 状态跳过的集成门禁。完整全仓 preflight 和官方 CLI 端到端覆盖仍未建立；此前跳过的任务不计为通过。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 本地 Python SDK 测试；官方 Linux 构建、静态检查与 Python 3.10–3.12 检查 |

### 环境

Linux 上的 Python 3.12.14。工作区构建尝试使用 Node.js 24.22.1 和仓库固定的 pnpm 11.24.0。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：隔离调用者取消时，仍须保留查询自身关闭和初始化失败的行为。回归用例覆盖两种情况，并要求关闭后没有新的提示或控制请求写入。
- 未验证或不在范围内：官方 CLI 端到端行为、macOS、Windows 和完整的全仓 preflight。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变公开 API 或协议。取消一个等待中的调用不再连带取消其他调用或输入。

## 关联问题

修复 #17496。

</details>

Completed official Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 job logs each report **195 passed, 26 skipped**, with Ruff, Ruff formatting and mypy successful. prs.title: test(integration): give the editor-parity waits the shared-pool stall tier (#17544)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the polling ceiling used by the interactive editor-parity acceptance suite so that a mid-turn repaint on the shared runner pool gets the same stall allowance the harness already grants the CLI at startup. The suite's local wait budget goes from 12s to 30s, and the shared wait helper triples that in CI, which lands the CI ceiling exactly on the 90s self-hosted boot tier. Both waits named in the flake report go through that one helper, so a single ceiling change covers both signatures. Every assertion, every input and every probe condition is untouched — nothing is skipped, retried, wrapped or loosened — and a small pin ships alongside so the ceiling cannot silently drift back below the boot tier.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol saw two waits in this suite expire on one commit and pass on a rerun of the same commit: the search/Tab/Escape case waiting for the model reply to become visible, and the streaming-cancel case waiting for the cancelled prompt to return to the composer. Both are waits for a repaint after a key press, and the suite is fully mocked against a local fake provider, so no real model latency is involved.

The harness already records that this shared pool stalls the very same CLI for much longer than the mid-turn ceiling allowed: the ready-prompt budget documentation describes a boot exhausting 30s on all three retries and another exhausting 90s, and grants 90s on self-hosted runners and 180s on self-hosted docker as a result. The mid-turn ceiling was 36s in CI — below the boot tier for the same host — so a stall the harness already tolerates at startup expired a wait in the middle of a test. An earlier change raised this whole family's wait ceilings for exactly this signature class; this file kept the second-lowest budget in the family while containing its longest and most interaction-dense cases.

One detail matters when reading the report: the polling helper throws only its label, never the screen it last saw, so "no content mismatch" describes the error text rather than a screen verified healthy. The investigation therefore checked the alternatives against code and captured frame evidence instead of trusting the signature. CPU contention was ruled out by pinning the whole test tree to a single core shared with three busy loops — the cases still passed, because the suite is dominated by its own fixed settles. Reply-label desynchronisation was ruled out by confirming one request per submit with matching labels and every background model caller disabled. Viewport scroll-off was ruled out by measuring the waited-for reply's row in every captured frame: it is always the newest transcript line, directly above a fixed six-row footer. The product's cancel/restore branch was traced and takes the restore path for a held stream that has already rendered content.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the suite the way the parity leg does, from `integration-tests`, with the sandbox off and retries disabled: `CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`. Expect all 30 cases green (29 acceptance cases plus the new pin), with the search/Tab/Escape case around 33s.

Confirm the pin actually witnesses the ceiling by reverting the budget literal to `12_000` and re-running just the pin: it must fail with `expected 36000 to be greater than or equal to 90000`. Restore the literal and it passes. This probe was run before committing, in that order.

Confirm the change is ceiling-only: the acceptance diff is one numeric literal plus an explanatory comment, with no assertion, input, key sequence or probe condition altered.

Two limits are worth knowing before reviewing. The flake did not reproduce locally — 18 pre-fix executions of the named case were green, including the harshest contention surrogate — so the ceiling is calibrated against the pool's recorded stall incidents and the existing boot policy, not against a local reproduction. And `bun` is not installed on this runner, so the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs were not exercised; if the stall is specific to the native renderer, CI remains the authority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. For the record: the CI wait ceiling moves from 36s to 90s and the local ceiling from 12s to 30s; post-fix the whole suite plus the pin passed 30/30 on two consecutive runs, and the pin failed against the pre-fix ceiling with the assertion quoted above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node v22.23.2 on Linux, driving the prebuilt bundle with `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` on the node+ink renderer leg, `CI=true` for the scaled budgets. `bun` is not installed, so the other two renderer legs were unavailable.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely stuck UI now takes up to 90s in CI and 30s locally to fail a wait, instead of 36s and 12s. The two reported cases inherit the suite's 300s per-test ceiling, so they still fail on the wait's own label. The three permissions cases pin a 90s per-test ceiling of their own; under a stall they would now report the suite timeout rather than the wait label, and they still fail either way. Local failure diagnosis for this file is correspondingly slower, which is the unavoidable consequence of the helper coupling its local and CI budgets by a factor of three.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local reproduction of the flake; the bun+ink and bun+opentui legs; and `npm run build`, which this sandbox cannot run because corepack is denied write access to its cache outside the project (`EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/github-runner/.cache/node/corepack/v1'`). The diff touches no workspace package — the integration tree has no manifest and is not a workspace member — so the per-package build never compiles it. `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces plus the integration program), `npm run lint` and Prettier all passed. No product code, CI machinery, shared wait policy or configuration was changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17544

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

提高交互式 editor-parity 验收套件所使用的轮询上限，使共享 runner 池上回合中途的重绘，获得 harness 在 CLI 启动阶段已经给予的同等卡顿余量。该套件的本地等待预算从 12s 提高到 30s，共享等待助手在 CI 中将其三倍放大，于是 CI 上限正好落在 90s 的自托管启动档位上。抖动报告中提到的两个等待都经过这一个助手，因此单处上限改动即可覆盖两个签名。所有断言、所有输入、所有探针条件均未改动——没有跳过、没有重试、没有包裹、也没有放宽——并随附一个小型 pin，使该上限不会悄悄回落到启动档位之下。

## 为什么需要它

CI Failure Patrol 看到该套件中两个等待在同一个 commit 上超时，并在同一 commit 的重跑中通过：search/Tab/Escape 用例等待模型回复可见，streaming-cancel 用例等待被取消的提示词回到输入框。两者都是按键之后等待重绘，而该套件完全基于本地 fake provider 做 mock，不涉及任何真实模型延迟。

harness 已经记录过：这个共享池让同一个 CLI 卡住的时间远超回合中途上限所允许的值——ready-prompt 预算文档描述了一次启动在三次重试中全部耗尽 30s，另一次耗尽 90s，并据此给予自托管 runner 90s、自托管 docker 180s。而回合中途的 CI 上限是 36s，低于同一主机的启动档位，于是 harness 在启动阶段已经容忍的卡顿，在测试中途让等待超时。此前已有一处改动针对完全相同的签名类别提高了整个家族的等待上限；而这个文件保留了家族中第二低的预算，却包含家族中最长、交互最密集的用例。

阅读报告时有一个细节很重要：轮询助手抛出的只有标签，从不附带它最后看到的屏幕，因此“没有内容不符”描述的是错误文本，而不是一块被验证为健康的屏幕。所以本次排查是对照代码与采集到的帧证据去核实各种可能，而不是相信签名本身。CPU 争用已被排除：把整棵测试进程树绑到与三个忙循环共享的单个核上，用例依然通过，因为该套件的时间主要花在自身的固定 settle 上。回复标签错位已被排除：确认每次提交对应一个请求且标签一致，并且所有后台模型调用方都已关闭。可视区滚出已被排除：逐帧测量被等待回复所在的行，它始终是最新的一条 transcript 行，紧邻固定的六行页脚之上。产品侧的取消/恢复分支也已追踪，对于已经渲染出内容的 held 流，它走的是恢复路径。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

按 parity leg 的方式运行该套件：在 `integration-tests` 目录下，关闭 sandbox 并禁用重试：`CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts interactive/tui-editor-parity-wait-budget.test.ts --retry=0 --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1`。预期 30 个用例全绿（29 个验收用例加新增 pin），其中 search/Tab/Escape 用例约 33s。

要确认该 pin 真的见证了上限，可把预算字面量回退为 `12_000` 并只重跑该 pin：它必须失败并报 `expected 36000 to be greater than or equal to 90000`。恢复字面量后即通过。提交前已按此顺序执行过该探针。

确认本改动只涉及上限：验收文件的 diff 是一个数字字面量加一段解释性注释，没有任何断言、输入、按键序列或探针条件被改动。

评审前值得知道两个边界。抖动在本地没有复现——修复前命名用例的 18 次执行全部通过，其中包括最严苛的争用 surrogate——因此上限是按该池已记录的卡顿事故与既有启动策略定标的，而不是按本地复现定标的。另外本 runner 未安装 `bun`，所以 bun+ink 与 bun+opentui 两条 leg 未被执行；如果卡顿特定于原生渲染器，CI 仍是最终权威。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 仅测试改动，没有用户可见行为变化。备查：CI 等待上限从 36s 提高到 90s，本地上限从 12s 提高到 30s；修复后整个套件加 pin 连续两轮均 30/30 通过，而该 pin 面对修复前的上限失败，报上文引用的断言。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 上的 Node v22.23.2，以 `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 在 node+ink 渲染器 leg 上驱动预构建 bundle，并用 `CI=true` 启用放大后的预算。未安装 `bun`，因此另外两条渲染器 leg 不可用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：真正卡死的 UI 现在在 CI 中最多需要 90s、本地最多 30s 才会让某个等待失败，而不是原来的 36s 与 12s。两个被报告的用例继承套件 300s 的单用例上限，因此仍会以该等待自身的标签失败。三个 permissions 用例各自固定了 90s 的单用例上限；在卡顿情况下它们现在会报套件超时而不是等待标签，但两种情况下都仍然失败。相应地，本文件的本地失败诊断会变慢，这是助手把本地与 CI 预算按三倍耦合所不可避免的结果。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：抖动的本地复现；bun+ink 与 bun+opentui 两条 leg；以及 `npm run build`——本沙箱无法运行它，因为 corepack 被拒绝写入项目之外的缓存（`EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/home/github-runner/.cache/node/corepack/v1'`）。本 diff 不触及任何 workspace 包——集成树没有 manifest，也不是 workspace 成员——因此逐包构建根本不会编译它。`npm run typecheck`（所有 workspace 加集成 program）、`npm run lint` 与 Prettier 均已通过。未改动任何产品代码、CI 机制、共享等待策略或配置。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17544

prs.title: fix(sdk-python): wait for process startup before closing a query
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Wait for an in-flight Python SDK process startup before closing the query, then shut down the resulting process and its background work. Repeated shutdown remains harmless, including shutdown requested from an input generator's cleanup.

## Why it's needed

Closing a query while process creation is suspended can currently return before that process exists. Startup can then finish after the query has been marked closed, leaving a live child behind. This matters when applications cancel startup or leave a query context quickly.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Pause process creation, begin closing the query, and then allow creation to finish. Shutdown should wait and should return only after the child has exited.
2. Request shutdown twice during the same pending startup. Both callers should finish without leaving a child or background work alive.
3. Close before startup, and repeat shutdown after completion. Both operations should remain safe.
4. Let an asynchronous input generator request shutdown from its cleanup. Cleanup should finish without waiting on itself.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original local reproduction starts a real Python child. On the unchanged base that child remains alive after shutdown returns; with this change it has exited when shutdown finishes. The new regression cases cover pending startup, concurrent shutdown callers, shutdown before startup and reentrant generator cleanup. The complete local Python SDK suite reports **192 passed, 26 skipped**. Python linting and the configured type check pass. An independent rerun of the original reproduction together with existing single-query and asynchronous-context happy paths reports **3 passed**.

[Official upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948503619/job/133584543040) now passes the selected Linux workspace build and static checks. [Python SDK checks](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948503307/job/133584492088) pass on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12. Both selected Linux unit-test shards also pass. The earlier local build attempts ended during CLI TypeScript compilation with status 137. This PR is now ready for review after the completed SDK checks and normal Linux build. The ready_for_review workflow will run the integration gates previously skipped for Draft status. Complete repository preflight and official CLI end-to-end coverage remain unverified; those earlier skipped jobs are not counted as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Local Python SDK tests; official Linux build/static checks and Python 3.10–3.12 checks |

### Environment (optional)

Python 3.12.14 on Linux. Node.js 24.22.1 and the pinned pnpm 11.24.0 were used for the attempted workspace build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shutdown now waits for process creation that is already in progress. The existing early-closed guard is preserved so an input generator can finish its own cleanup without a reentrant deadlock.
- Not validated / out of scope: indefinitely stalled process creation, cancellation of shutdown itself, official CLI end-to-end behavior, macOS, Windows and the complete repository preflight.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or protocol change; shutdown now waits for the resource it is responsible for releasing.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17493.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

关闭 Python SDK 查询时，先等待已经开始的进程创建完成，再关闭创建出的进程及其后台任务。重复关闭仍然安全，包括输入生成器在清理阶段再次请求关闭的情况。

## 修改原因

目前在进程创建暂停期间关闭查询，可能会在进程尚不存在时就返回。之后启动操作继续完成，查询虽然已经标记为关闭，却留下仍在运行的子进程。应用在启动期间取消操作或快速退出查询上下文时可能遇到这一问题。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 暂停进程创建，开始关闭查询，然后允许进程创建完成。关闭操作应等待，并且只在子进程退出后返回。
2. 在同一次待完成的启动期间发起两次关闭。两个调用者都应正常结束，不遗留子进程或后台任务。
3. 在启动前关闭，以及在完成关闭后重复关闭。这两种操作都应保持安全。
4. 让异步输入生成器在自己的清理阶段请求关闭。清理过程应顺利结束，不等待自身而形成死锁。

### 修改前后证据

[上游官方 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948503619/job/133584543040) 已通过选定的 Linux 工作区构建和静态检查；[Python SDK 检查](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948503307/job/133584492088) 在 Python 3.10、3.11 和 3.12 上均通过。选定的两个 Linux 单元测试分片也均已通过。此前本地构建尝试在 CLI 的 TypeScript 编译阶段以状态码 137 结束。SDK 检查和正常 Linux 构建已完成，本 PR 现已进入正式评审；ready_for_review 工作流将运行此前因 Draft 状态跳过的集成门禁。完整全仓 preflight 和官方 CLI 端到端覆盖仍未建立；此前跳过的任务不计为通过。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 本地 Python SDK 测试；官方 Linux 构建、静态检查与 Python 3.10–3.12 检查 |

### 环境

prs.title: perf(sdk): scan CRLF event batches in one pass
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Scan both supported SSE delimiters in a single forward pass, preserving complete frames and unfinished tails. When delimiters overlap, consume the first complete separator.

## Why it's needed

CRLF event batches repeatedly scan the remaining buffer for an LF-only separator. Large replay batches therefore grow quadratically and block consumers even though equivalent LF batches finish quickly.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Replay large LF-only, CRLF-only and mixed batches. Every frame should remain in order, and unfinished delimiters should remain buffered.
2. Check a CRLF separator followed by another newline. The first complete CRLF boundary should be consumed without merging neighboring events.
3. Compare increasing CRLF batch sizes. The parser should avoid the repeated full-suffix scans while ordinary LF throughput remains comparable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The focused framing suites report **22 passed, 1 failed** on the unchanged base and **23 passed** with the change; the failing base assertion concerns an overlapping delimiter boundary. An independent same-host sample measured 16,000 CRLF events at approximately **1,663 ms before / 6.38 ms after**, with LF controls at **4.39 / 4.33 ms**. Frame counts and unfinished tails were also checked. These are local framing measurements, not a network or end-to-end latency guarantee. Changed-file lint, formatting, normal commit hook and diff checks pass.

The unchanged full core build was killed with status 137, and a bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. The full repository preflight is not claimed as passed. This PR preserves the focused evidence while upstream checks evaluate the proposed commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Focused tests and independent reproduction |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1 on Linux, repository-pinned dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The scanner must choose the first complete delimiter and preserve tail bytes; focused mixed and overlapping-boundary controls cover those cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: Full repository preflight, real daemon network performance and native macOS/Windows execution remain unverified.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public API or wire-format change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17561.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

一次向前扫描同时识别两种 SSE 分隔符，保留完整事件及不完整尾部。分隔符重叠时，消费最先完整出现的分隔符。

## 修改原因

CRLF 事件批次原先反复扫描剩余缓冲区寻找 LF-only 分隔符，使大型回放呈二次增长并阻塞调用方，而等价 LF 批次很快完成。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 回放大型 LF、CRLF 和混合批次。全部事件应按顺序保留，不完整分隔符应继续缓冲。

3. 比较逐渐增大的 CRLF 批次，确认不再反复扫描完整后缀，同时普通 LF 性能保持相近。

### 环境

## 风险与范围

- 未验证或不在范围内：完整全仓 preflight、真实 daemon 网络性能及原生 macOS/Windows 执行尚未验证。

prs.title: fix(sdk-python): release cancelled and failed control requests
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Release a Python SDK control request's pending reply and timeout whenever the caller exits, including cancellation, write failure and drain failure. A reply or timeout that arrives during a failing write is consumed without replacing the caller's original error. Other requests keep their own replies and timers.

## Why it's needed

Cancelling a control request currently leaves its pending entry and timeout alive until another event happens to remove them. Repeated cancellation therefore retains work that has no caller, and a delayed failure can produce an unhandled future exception. A failed write has the same ownership problem.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Cancel several control requests after the peer receives them. Their pending entries and timeout callbacks should disappear immediately, while a separate request should still receive its own response.
2. Fail a write, fail a drain, or cancel while a drain is blocked. The caller should retain the original failure or cancellation, with no abandoned request state.
3. Allow a request to time out while its drain is blocked, then fail that drain. The original drain error should be preserved and the event loop should not report an unhandled future exception.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The five new regression cases fail on the unchanged base and pass with this change. The complete local Python SDK suite reports **192 passed, 26 skipped**. Python linting and the configured type check pass. An independent rerun of the original reproduction reports **2 passed**: all 16 cancelled requests leave zero retained entries and zero live timeout callbacks, failed writes leave no event-loop warning, and a later independent request succeeds.

[Official upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948450440/job/133584322380) now passes the selected Linux workspace build and static checks. [Python SDK checks](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948450628/job/133584302154) pass on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12. Both selected Linux unit-test shards also pass. The earlier local build attempts ended during CLI TypeScript compilation with status 137. This PR is now ready for review after the completed SDK checks and normal Linux build. The ready_for_review workflow will run the integration gates previously skipped for Draft status. Complete repository preflight and official CLI end-to-end coverage remain unverified; those earlier skipped jobs are not counted as passing.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Local Python SDK tests; official Linux build/static checks and Python 3.10–3.12 checks |

### Environment (optional)

Python 3.12.14 on Linux. Node.js 24.22.1 and the pinned pnpm 11.24.0 were used for the attempted workspace build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: cleanup must remain idempotent when cancellation, a reply, timeout or shutdown coincide. The regression cases cover those competing outcomes without changing the original exception seen by the caller.
- Not validated / out of scope: a permanently blocked drain, official CLI end-to-end behavior, macOS, Windows and the complete repository preflight.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or protocol change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17494.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

无论调用者正常结束、取消请求、写入失败还是等待写出失败，都释放 Python SDK 控制请求所持有的待回复状态和超时任务。如果写入尚未完成时已经收到回复或触发超时，会处理相应的完成状态，同时保留调用者原本应收到的异常。其他请求仍使用各自独立的回复和计时器。

## 修改原因

目前取消控制请求后，其待回复记录和超时任务会一直保留，直到其他事件恰好清除它们。反复取消因此会留下已没有调用者等待的工作，随后发生的失败还可能引发未处理的 future 异常。写入失败也存在相同的资源归属问题。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 在对端收到请求后取消多条控制请求。对应的待回复记录和超时回调应立即消失，另一条独立请求仍应收到自己的回复。
2. 分别触发写入失败、等待写出失败，以及等待写出受阻时的取消。调用者应保留原始异常或取消结果，不留下无人使用的请求状态。
3. 在等待写出受阻期间让请求超时，然后令等待写出失败。调用者应收到原始写出异常，事件循环不应报告未处理的 future 异常。

### 修改前后证据

新增的五个回归用例在未修改基线上失败，修改后通过。完整的本地 Python SDK 测试结果为 **192 通过、26 跳过**，Python lint 和配置的类型检查均通过。独立重新运行原始复现脚本的结果为 **2 通过**：16 条取消请求均未残留待回复记录或活动计时器，写入失败没有产生事件循环警告，之后的独立请求可以成功完成。

[上游官方 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948450440/job/133584322380) 已通过选定的 Linux 工作区构建和静态检查；[Python SDK 检查](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43948450628/job/133584302154) 在 Python 3.10、3.11 和 3.12 上均通过。选定的两个 Linux 单元测试分片也均已通过。此前本地构建尝试在 CLI 的 TypeScript 编译阶段以状态码 137 结束。SDK 检查和正常 Linux 构建已完成，本 PR 现已进入正式评审；ready_for_review 工作流将运行此前因 Draft 状态跳过的集成门禁。完整全仓 preflight 和官方 CLI 端到端覆盖仍未建立；此前跳过的任务不计为通过。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 本地 Python SDK 测试；官方 Linux 构建、静态检查与 Python 3.10–3.12 检查 |

### 环境

Linux 上的 Python 3.12.14。工作区构建尝试使用 Node.js 24.22.1 和仓库固定的 pnpm 11.24.0。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：取消、回复、超时和关闭发生在相邻时刻时，清理仍须保持幂等。回归用例覆盖这些竞争结果，并检查调用者收到的原始异常保持不变。
- 未验证或不在范围内：永久受阻的写出等待、官方 CLI 端到端行为、macOS、Windows 和完整的全仓 preflight。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变公开 API 或协议。

## 关联问题

修复 #17494。

</details>


### Ready-for-review verification

The existing exact head `e96d8980f129433b09c16dd76ed21e8a4dce5542` remains unchanged. Completed official Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 job logs each report **192 passed, 26 skipped**, with Ruff, Ruff formatting and mypy successful. The new Ready-triggered CI is separate and pending; no new source commit was needed for this transition.

prs.title: fix(cli): allow collapsing expanded tool details
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR makes collapsed tool-call summaries behave as a true click toggle. After a summary is expanded, the rendered tool group remains mouse-aware so a second complete click collapses it again. Shared batch state now toggles entries instead of only adding them, which keeps the behavior consistent when a live tool group moves into committed history. Link clicks, context-menu interactions, drag selections, required interaction states, and full-detail mode retain their existing behavior.

## Why it's needed

When `ui.showToolCallDetails` is disabled, the one-line tool summary advertises `click to expand`, but the mouse handler and its target disappear after expansion. Both the local state and shared batch state were one-way, leaving users unable to return to the compact view without using a global display toggle.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Set `ui.showToolCallDetails` to `false` with virtualized history and mouse tracking enabled. Trigger a completed tool call, click its one-line `click to expand` summary, and confirm the arguments and result appear. Click the expanded tool group again and confirm it returns to the one-line summary. Also confirm that dragging across the row does not toggle it, a live group stays expanded when committed to history, and approval prompts, focused interactive shells, user-initiated tools, and Ctrl+O full-detail mode remain expanded.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the first click expanded the tool group, but mouse handling became inactive and a second click left the group expanded. After: focused component coverage performs the complete collapsed → expanded → collapsed round trip for both local and shared batch state; all 12 cases pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; focused Ink component tests, repository build, TypeScript typecheck, and targeted ESLint. An isolated global-CLI baseline reached provider selection without credentials, so the click round trip was verified through the component harness rather than a live model-backed session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The expanded tool group receives a lightweight layout wrapper so it has a measurable click target; existing link and context-menu guards prevent pointer actions from falling through to the toggle.
- Not validated / out of scope: Manual model-backed TUI verification on Windows and Linux.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

N/A
