prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add PR-watch bound-session private injection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds proactive, private delivery of watched pull-request transitions into the Managed Session bound to that PR. Once a binding exists, the GitHub channel adapter observes the bound PR each tick and, when CI turns red, a merge conflict appears, or the head moves, injects a private prompt into the bound Session — waking it if dormant — so the agent can decide whether action is needed. Nothing is ever posted publicly on the PR, and no channel reply delivery is planned from these events. The control plane owns a durable binding table and an injection route that always forces the bound Session as the target (never a caller-chosen one), derives an idempotent input id from the transition identity plus a per-PR episode counter, and commits the input and wake through the existing Session input primitive. A crash between the journal commit and the SQL ledger replays to the same admission, while a legitimate recurrence (for example dirty → clean → dirty on the same head, or head A → B → A) is a new episode and derives a new input id rather than being deduped into the first admission.

## Why it's needed

The managed GitHub channel shipped in #17511 is reply-only: it routes @mention comments into bound Sessions and posts receipted replies. It cannot proactively tell a bound Session that its PR went red or conflicted unless a human comments. The legacy daemon PR watch was retired to `serve.sessionPrWatch` (#17214), which lives in the daemon sidecar world (cookie auth, daemon CI definition) and is not reachable from the managed control plane's token-authenticated trusted adapter surface. This slice gives the managed path its own adapter-side detection that reuses the daemon's CI verdict (one CI definition across both worlds) and delivers privately into the bound Session, closing the proactive-delivery gap without reintroducing double-poll or a second credential system. Public reply, role/action templates, and Web Shell UI are explicitly deferred beyond this first slice.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Bind an active Session of the channel's Workspace to a PR via the internal `pr-watch:create` route, then confirm `pr-watch:list` returns it and `pr-watch:retire` removes it; binding a missing, non-active, or foreign-Workspace Session is refused, and a conflicting rebind is a 409. With a binding in place, drive the watched PR through each transition and confirm a private input lands in the bound Session: CI failure fires once per head (a flapping aggregate on the same head does not re-fire, a new head re-arms), merge conflict is edge-triggered on `mergeable_state: dirty`, and head change fires when the head moves. Confirm the injected prompt is private — no public comment is posted and no channel delivery is queued — and that the evidence line names the failed checks. Redeliver the same transition and confirm it replays the same admission (same derived input id, `replayed: true`) rather than minting a second input; deliver a legitimate recurrence with a new episode and confirm it derives a new input id. Kill the adapter between persisting the pending event and the injection answer, restart, and confirm the re-drive sends the identical pinned event and replays the same admission. The adapter↔control-plane wire is exercised by a real-process hermetic E2E (bundled CLI + real Octokit against a local fake GitHub whose PR/CI state is mutated + a recording fake control plane that derives the idempotent id with the real shared core function); the Java control plane is exercised against H2 with a recording Harness, and the TS/Java identity derivation is pinned byte-for-byte by a shared fixture generated from the real TS.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI control-plane / adapter change. Local suite results on the current `main` base: core PR-watch contract 12/12; Harness funnel 21/21; capability-parity 217/217; managed GitHub adapter/deps/state 146/146 (full github package 1014/1014); Java `ManagedPrWatchServiceTest` 13/13, `PrWatchOperationsParityTest` 3/3, `WakeRecoveryStoreTest` 29/29, `SurfaceRegistryGateTest` 4/4, Checkstyle clean; real-process PR-watch E2E 28/28 (baseline, three transitions with durable episodes, once-per-head CI pin, crash-replay to the same derived id, private-only). An audit pass caught and fixed a cross-layer contract bug where the injection's transport operation id was the derived input id rather than a UUID the Harness channel-operation gate admits; the Java test now pins the exact UUID shape the Harness enforces.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, JDK 21 + Maven 3.9.11 (H2 for the Java suite); real-process E2E runs the bundled CLI against loopback fake GitHub / fake control plane, no real GitHub and no daemon. Real MySQL and the full Java↔Harness process integration are left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a new `pr_event` input source is added to both the TS wake whitelist and the Java SQL wake-recovery whitelist (with their pin tests); the workspace-lifecycle v2 source whitelist is deliberately NOT extended, so an accepted `pr_event` input blocks Workspace close/delete until its turn settles — the conservative fail-safe, since the input drives a real model turn.
- Not validated / out of scope: real MySQL lock scope and the full Java↔Harness process recovery (CI covers); public reply delivery, role/action templates, `state_change`, and Web Shell UI are deferred; reconciliation with the daemon `serve.sessionPrWatch` beyond disjointness is deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; new internal routes and a new V1 baseline table, additive wake-source whitelist entries.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-github-pr-watch-bound-session.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-github-pr-watch-bound-session.zh-CN.md) (complete and synchronized).

## Linked Issues

Builds on #17511 (managed GitHub channel) and the managed-channel epic #12827; relates to the retired daemon watch #17214.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为绑定到某 PR 的 Managed Session 增加 watched pull-request transition 的主动、私有投递。绑定存在后，GitHub channel adapter 每个 tick 观测绑定 PR，当 CI 变红、出现合并冲突或 head 移动时，向绑定 Session 注入一条私有提示词（dormant 则唤醒），让 agent 判断是否需要行动。绝不在 PR 上公开发帖，也不从这些事件 plan 任何 channel 回复投递。控制面持有一张持久绑定表和一个注入路由，注入目标恒强制为绑定 Session（绝不接受调用方指定），从 transition 身份加上每 PR 的 episode 计数器派生幂等 input id，并通过既有 Session input 原语提交 input + wake。journal commit 与 SQL ledger 之间崩溃会重放到同一 admission；而合法复发（如同一 head 上 dirty → clean → dirty，或 head A → B → A）是新 episode，派生新 input id，不会被去重进首次 admission。

## 为什么需要

#17511 落地的 managed GitHub channel 是 reply-only：把 @mention 评论路由进绑定 Session 并发回执回复。除非人工评论，它无法主动告知绑定 Session 其 PR 变红或冲突。legacy daemon PR watch 已退役到 `serve.sessionPrWatch`（#17214），属于 daemon sidecar 世界（cookie 鉴权、daemon CI 定义），managed 控制面的 token 鉴权 trusted adapter surface 无法触及。本切片给 managed 路径自己的 adapter 侧检测，复用 daemon 的 CI 裁决（两个世界一份 CI 定义），私有投递进绑定 Session，在不重新引入双重轮询或第二套凭据系统的前提下补齐主动投递缺口。公开回复、role/action 模板、Web Shell UI 明确延后到首切片之外。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

经内部 `pr-watch:create` 路由把 channel 所属 Workspace 的一个 active Session 绑定到 PR，确认 `pr-watch:list` 返回、`pr-watch:retire` 移除；绑定不存在/非 active/跨 Workspace 的 Session 被拒，冲突 rebind 为 409。绑定就位后，驱动 watched PR 经历各 transition，确认私有 input 落入绑定 Session：CI 失败每 head 只 fire 一次（同 head 抖动不重 fire，新 head 重 arm），合并冲突在 `mergeable_state: dirty` 边沿触发，head 移动触发 head_change。确认注入提示词私有——无公开发帖、无 channel delivery 入队——且 evidence 行点名失败 check。重投同一 transition 确认重放同一 admission（同派生 input id，`replayed: true`）而非二次 input；以新 episode 投递合法复发确认派生新 input id。在持久化 pending 与注入 answer 之间 kill adapter，重启，确认重驱发送同一 pinned 事件并重放同一 admission。adapter↔控制面 wire 由真实进程封闭 E2E 覆盖（bundled CLI + 真实 Octokit 对回环 fake GitHub（PR/CI 状态可变）+ recording fake 控制面（用真实共享 core 函数派生幂等 id））；Java 控制面对 H2 + recording Harness 覆盖；TS/Java 身份派生由真实 TS 生成的共享 fixture 逐字节钉死。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A——非 UI 的控制面/adapter 改动。当前 `main` 基线本地套件结果：core PR-watch 契约 12/12；Harness funnel 21/21；capability-parity 217/217；managed GitHub adapter/deps/state 146/146（github 全包 1014/1014）；Java `ManagedPrWatchServiceTest` 13/13、`PrWatchOperationsParityTest` 3/3、`WakeRecoveryStoreTest` 29/29、`SurfaceRegistryGateTest` 4/4、Checkstyle 干净；真实进程 PR-watch E2E 28/28（baseline、三 transition 带 durable episode、once-per-head CI pin、崩溃重放到同派生 id、private-only）。审计一轮发现并修复了一个跨层契约缺陷：注入的 transport operation id 原为派生 input id，而非 Harness channel-operation 门放行的 UUID；Java 测试现钉死 Harness 强制的精确 UUID 形状。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24，JDK 21 + Maven 3.9.11（Java 套件用 H2）；真实进程 E2E 跑 bundled CLI 对回环 fake GitHub / fake 控制面，无真实 GitHub、无 daemon。真实 MySQL 与完整 Java↔Harness 进程集成留 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：新 `pr_event` input source 同时加入 TS wake 白名单与 Java SQL wake-recovery 白名单（含钉死测试）；workspace-lifecycle v2 source 白名单刻意不扩展，故已接受的 `pr_event` input 会阻塞 Workspace close/delete 直到其 turn 结算——保守 fail-safe，因为该 input 驱动真实模型轮。
- 未验证/范围外：真实 MySQL 锁范围与完整 Java↔Harness 进程恢复（CI 覆盖）；公开回复投递、role/action 模板、`state_change`、Web Shell UI 延后；与 daemon `serve.sessionPrWatch` 超出 disjointness 的协调延后。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；新内部路由 + 新 V1 基线表，wake-source 白名单增量条目。

设计：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-github-pr-watch-bound-session.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-github-pr-watch-bound-session.zh-CN.md)（完整同步）。

## 关联 Issue

基于 #17511（managed GitHub channel）与 managed-channel epic #12827；关联退役的 daemon watch #17214。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): preserve plugin hook roots through installation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in hooks loaded from a plugin’s JSON file until the installed extension is loaded. Commands then resolve against the installed plugin directory, matching inline hooks. Existing path validation and command execution policy remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Converting a plugin previously replaced the token with its temporary clone directory. Once installation deleted that clone, the stored hook could reference a missing script even though the installed copy existed. A real SessionEnd invocation reported `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` at that deleted path; a targeted regression also reproduced the premature replacement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Install a plugin whose hooks file points to a script through `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`. Confirm the converted manifest retains the token, then remove the temporary source and start a fresh session with the installed extension. The hook should execute the installed script. Inline hooks, Mod resources and path escape refusals should keep their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the targeted conversion assertion fails because the command contains the temporary source path; a real hook invocation failed after that path was deleted. The larger public run also had an unrelated UI failure and is not reported as a whole-case pass.

After: build, type checking, lint, formatting and bundle pass. Six Core files and the CLI Mod consumer pass 487 unique tests; the changed converter file also passed its 79 tests after a formatting-only correction. The public A-only Git installation passes with hot and cold natural exits (0/signal 0), two qualified Bash receipts executing the installed script after clone cleanup, and zero model requests. This focused case does not requalify the earlier A/B partial-install/retry scenario.

The actual global 0.22.0 baseline completed two natural exits with zero model requests but lacked a qualified cold Shell receipt and showed no concrete hook error. It remains not qualified and is not treated as an independent reproduction or success.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Darwin arm64, Node 24.19.0 + Ink: verified |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Independent Core fix against main. Local public UI validation used Node 24.19.0 and Ink with the freshly built 0.27.4 source bundle. Remote CI has not run for this new PR yet.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: conversion output now retains the token until installed loading. Claude marketplace, standalone and Qoder conversion share this behavior; unknown external consumers of the exported conversion API may have relied on earlier expansion. Core Tier 2 maintainer review is required.
- Not validated / out of scope: the public verification covers the A-only file-hook path; other hook events, the original A/B workflow, Native lifecycle, other platforms and stability are outside it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: literal absolute commands and existing inline-hook semantics are retained. No new flags, loader, trust policy or security exceptions are introduced. This is not a claim of complete downstream compatibility or approval.

Design: [English](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/b18bdc272f53faa0341070f7e8dea9d7ed78d9e3/docs/design/2026-11-17-plugin-hook-root-relocation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/b18bdc272f53faa0341070f7e8dea9d7ed78d9e3/docs/design/2026-11-17-plugin-hook-root-relocation.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

No separate issue was filed for this fix.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

保留从插件 JSON 文件加载的 Hook 中的 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`，直到已安装扩展加载时再展开。命令将按已安装插件目录解析，与 inline Hook 一致。现有路径校验和命令执行策略保持不变。

## 为什么需要

此前转换插件时会将 token 替换为临时克隆目录。安装删除克隆后，持久化 Hook 可能指向不存在的脚本，即使已安装副本确实存在。真实 SessionEnd 调用在该已删除路径上报告了 `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`；定向回归也复现了过早替换。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

安装一个通过 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` 引用脚本的文件 Hook 插件。确认转换后的 manifest 保留 token，然后删除临时源目录，并使用已安装扩展启动新会话。Hook 应执行已安装脚本。Inline Hook、Mod 资源及路径逃逸拒绝行为应保持原样。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：定向转换断言因命令包含临时源路径而失败；真实 Hook 调用在该路径被删除后失败。较大的公开整案另有无关 UI 失败，因此不作为整案通过。

修改后：构建、类型检查、lint、格式与 bundle 均通过。六个 Core 文件与 CLI Mod 消费者的 487 个唯一测试通过；仅修正测试格式后，修改过的 converter 文件再次通过全部 79 个测试。公开 A-only Git 安装用例通过：热、冷两次自然退出（0/signal 0），两份完整 Bash receipt 确认在克隆清理后执行已安装脚本，模型请求为零。这项定向验证不替代此前 A/B 部分安装及重试整案。

真实全局 0.22.0 基线完成了两次自然退出且没有模型请求，但缺少合格冷启动 Shell receipt，也没有具体 Hook 错误。该结果仍不具备资格，不作为独立复现或成功。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Darwin arm64，Node 24.19.0 + Ink：已验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本改动是针对 main 的独立 Core 修复。本地公开 UI 验证使用 Node 24.19.0、Ink 及新构建的 0.27.4 源码 bundle；本新 PR 的远端 CI 尚未运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：转换产物现在将 token 保留到安装加载时。Claude marketplace、独立插件和 Qoder 转换共用此行为；导出转换 API 的未知外部消费者可能依赖提前展开，因此必须经过 Core Tier 2 维护者审查。
- 未验证或范围外：公开验证仅覆盖 A-only 文件 Hook 路径；其他 Hook 事件、原 A/B 业务整案、Native 生命周期、其他平台和稳定性不在其中。
- 兼容性与迁移说明：保留字面绝对命令及现有 inline Hook 语义。不新增开关、加载器、信任策略或安全例外。不声称完整下游兼容或已获批准。

设计：[English](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/b18bdc272f53faa0341070f7e8dea9d7ed78d9e3/docs/design/2026-11-17-plugin-hook-root-relocation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/b18bdc272f53faa0341070f7e8dea9d7ed78d9e3/docs/design/2026-11-17-plugin-hook-root-relocation.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

本修复没有另行提交 Issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(java): return newlines in file content responses
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The ACP Java SDK now joins selected file lines with text newlines when returning file content to the agent. Existing line selection, default limits, charset configuration, and file-error behavior are preserved.

## Why it's needed

File reads previously inserted the operating system's directory separator after every line. A two-line file became `alpha/beta/` on Linux or used backslashes on Windows, corrupting the text presented to the agent.

This carries Afloat16's original fix and regression tests from closed #17652 with the original branch and commit history preserved, following the [maintainer's reuse instructions](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/17642#issuecomment-6952272313). This PR supersedes #17652, which could not be reopened.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read a real file containing two text lines, then request only its second line. Both results should contain text newlines rather than directory separators. Also check blank lines, CRLF input, a configured nondefault charset, an empty file, the default 1000-line limit, and the missing-file error.

To confirm that the regression coverage detects the original defect, retain the new tests while restoring the parent implementation. The four content assertions should fail while the three compatibility controls pass; restoring the corrected implementation should make all seven pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

#### Current review follow-up (`8b30acb1`)

This revision narrows the tests without changing production code. The CRLF fixture now has its own final CRLF, so its assertion isolates blank-line and line-ending normalization. The test that certified `null` for an out-of-range start and its unused assertion import have been removed; that pre-existing response-shape gap remains follow-up work rather than a required compatibility contract.

With OpenJDK 21.0.13 and Maven 3.9.11, the normal client `clean test` lifecycle passed **14/14 tests**, including all seven focused file-content cases, with zero failures, errors, or skips. The runtime temporary directory was routed to a writable workspace directory; the checked-in Maven configuration, integration-group exclusion, and JaCoCo instrumentation were retained. Keeping the revised tests and restoring only the exact parent production source produced **four content failures and three passing controls**, including the narrowed CRLF regression. Restoring the head source passed the full 14-test suite again. The published tree is `e6632b851114ac085ce154f835e7c66ef57e9434`, matching the validated local tree. Fresh upstream checks for this revision are tracked separately from the historical results below.

#### Earlier validation on the original `7b92b2ac` head

The Java jobs in [validation run 44237746471](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44237746471) tested unchanged head [`7b92b2ac44a3c195eeb6d3a03714676414c75813`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/7b92b2ac44a3c195eeb6d3a03714676414c75813). Each of the five official OS/JDK combinations passed all 15 tests under the normal client Maven configuration, including the eight new file-content tests. With those eight tests unchanged and only the exact parent production source restored, each combination produced the expected four failures and four passing controls. Restoring the head source passed all eight again, with a clean Git diff.

The earlier unchanged public file-read probe used real temporary files and the actual file consumer: two failing text reads plus one passing empty-file control became three passing cases. This earlier local probe is separate from the new Maven results above.

At reviewed main `61476010ca7f46140eaa39c77952bd1b9109a587`, the affected production blob `ef8a7b50ec62fecd713ff23a1d5c5dcf13085681` remains identical to parent `5fc5a98ecc08d2e89f29cbea57934928224977b5`. The new test path is absent, and the original patch passes a target-path application check without code changes.

The same run also passed the frozen dependency install, normal workspace build, DEV bundle, workspace and integration typecheck, and final clean Git diff. These checks used the unchanged retained head above.

### Tested on

The matrix below records the earlier `7b92b2ac` validation. The current test-only revision's Linux Maven results are recorded separately above.

| OS | Local verification | Exact-head Maven CI |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Not run locally | Java 21: 15/15 tests passed |
| Windows | Not run locally | Java 21: 15/15 tests passed |
| Linux | Earlier actual-source temporary-file probe passed | Java 11, 17, and 21: 15/15 tests passed in each combination |

### Environment

The affected package is the ACP Java client. Its checked-in configuration uses Java 8 source/target compatibility, JUnit 5.14.1, and Surefire 3.5.4. The new native validation used the five OS/JDK combinations listed above. The earlier local probe used OpenJDK 21.0.13. No Java 8 runtime result is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: selected lines are joined with LF across platforms. The existing line reader's CRLF normalization and trailing-newline behavior are retained, so this does not provide byte-for-byte preservation of original line endings.
- Not validated / out of scope: Checkstyle, integration tests, and a live agent session were not exercised by this validation. The normal Maven configuration excludes the integration group. Workspace gate status is recorded above.
- Follow-up gap: a start line past EOF can return a result without the schema-required string content. This pre-existing behavior is no longer asserted as correct by these newline tests; changing that response shape is outside this maintainer-directed fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public method signature or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17642.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的修改

ACP Java SDK 现在使用文本换行符连接选中的文件行，再把内容返回给 agent。现有行范围、默认上限、编码配置和文件错误行为保持不变。

## 修改原因

原来的文件读取会在每行末尾插入操作系统的目录分隔符。两行文件在 Linux 上会变成 `alpha/beta/`，在 Windows 上则使用反斜杠，导致传给 agent 的文本内容损坏。

按照[维护者的复用指示](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/17642#issuecomment-6952272313)，本 PR 沿用 Afloat16 在已关闭 #17652 中完成的原始修复及回归测试，保留原分支及原提交历史。原 PR 无法重开，本 PR 承接并取代 #17652。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

读取包含两行文本的真实文件，再单独请求第二行。两次结果都应包含文本换行符，而非目录分隔符。同时检查空行、CRLF 输入、自定义编码、空文件、默认 1000 行上限和文件不存在时的错误。

要确认回归测试能够识别原缺陷，保持新增测试不变，只恢复父提交的实现。四项内容断言应失败，三项兼容性对照应通过；恢复修正后的实现后，七项应全部通过。

### 修改前后证据

#### 当前审查跟进（`8b30acb1`）

本次仅收敛测试，生产代码保持不变。CRLF 输入现在自带末尾 CRLF，使断言只固定空行与行尾规范化；移除了把越界起始行的 `null` 结果认定为正确行为的测试及其未使用导入。该既有响应结构差异已明确列为后续工作，不再作为兼容性契约固定下来。

prs.title: fix(serve): Prevent automatic work from blocking worktree restore
prs.body:
## What this PR does Cold worktree restoration now holds automatic work until the daemon validates ownership and restores the working directory. Saved user questions are reconstructed after that validation, and automatic work continues only when it can no longer displace the pending question. Boot rehydration and keepalive revival use the same workspace-bound restore path as Web Shell loads. Directory-context refresh preserves a trailing unanswered question and its call metadata. If a strict worktree record disappears or downgrades during restoration, the attempt is rejected and its restored session is cleaned up. The readiness hold protects lifecycle admission without counting as an executing turn that directory relocation must drain. ## Why it's needed A due cron can wait for a user answer while directory restoration waits for that cron to finish. The Web Shell waits for restoration before presenting the question, producing a loading loop followed by a 30-second timeout even though health and transcript reads succeed. An inactive bridge prompt summary does not prove that internal automatic work has settled. A saved question can also become undiscoverable when directory context or a due cron message is appended after its tool call. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Use temporary configuration/runtime directories, a real Git worktree and a local mock provider. Exercise cold restoration with an overdue session-bound durable cron, an unfinished saved question, and both together. Loading should finish in the exact owned worktree with its persisted ownership attestation, a readable transcript and the expected question content. For the combined case, leave the original question pending across repeated status reads, then answer it in the fixture. Confirm the due cron subsequently runs in that worktree and presents its own distinct question. Also check that invalid ownership, failed relocation, a strict record disappearing/downgrading and a closed workspace generation are rejected; warm attaches and initially legacy/no-worktree restores keep their compatibility behavior. Local validation passed full build, bundle and typecheck, changed-file lint/format checks, targeted bridge/Session/restore/keepalive/wiring/core unit suites or selections, and all three isolated daemon/ACP E2E cases. Two consecutive clean self-audit passes and an in-place correctness review completed. The tested patch is unchanged after rebasing onto current main. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before, installed 0.27.4 returned HTTP 500 after 30,458 ms for the overdue-cron fixture, with `AcpSessionBridge changeSessionCwd timed out after 30000ms` and child `Session close timed out after 30000ms`. Its cron request did not contain the intended worktree path. A separate saved-question fixture returned HTTP 200 but omitted the reconciled `currentCwd`. After, the final bundle returned HTTP 200 in 1,827 ms for overdue cron, 2,100 ms for the saved question, and 1,769 ms for the combined case. All returned the exact owned cwd and `persisted-v1`, with accessible questions and transcripts. The combined original question survived 15 probes over three seconds; after a fixture-only answer, due cron continued within 307 ms in the correct worktree and the transcript grew from 6 to 22 events. A separate E2E report comment records the verification details. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS 26.7.1; Node.js 26.12.1 for build/typecheck/unit checks; pnpm 11.24.0. Isolated daemon/ACP baseline and final E2E used Node.js 24.12.0, a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock provider, fake provider credentials and temporary Git/config/runtime/Conversations directories. No external model provider was contacted, and no shared user daemon was restarted or upgraded. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: automatic admission must remain held during cwd restoration and pending-question reconstruction, while foreground question handling and subsequent background resumption remain available. Coverage checks the close-gate/drain separation and answer-to-cron continuation. - Not validated / out of scope: Windows, Linux, external model providers and the full package test matrix were not validated locally. Adding daemon worktree reconciliation to raw bridge consumers outside Web Shell/scheduled restoration, Live conversation relocation, cross-daemon writer ownership and repair of already-running wedged sessions are outside this change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no public REST/configuration migration or transcript rewrite. The private restore metadata is additive; initially legacy/no-worktree restores and older bridge compatibility are retained. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9826e3318f5f6d8fd63f2447e4f227220803a647/docs/design/2026-11-17-worktree-restore-automatic-work.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9826e3318f5f6d8fd63f2447e4f227220803a647/docs/design/2026-11-17-worktree-restore-automatic-work.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized. ## Linked Issues Closes #17648
中文说明 ## 此 PR 的作用 worktree 冷恢复现在会暂停自动任务，直到 daemon 完成归属校验和工作目录恢复。保存的用户问题在校验后重建，自动任务仅在不会挤走待答问题时继续执行。启动恢复与 keepalive 唤醒使用和 Web Shell 加载相同、绑定工作区的恢复路径。 目录上下文刷新会保留末尾未回答的问题及其调用元数据。严格 worktree 记录在恢复期间消失或降级时，会拒绝本次恢复并清理其恢复出的会话。就绪暂停状态受到生命周期准入保护，但不计入目录迁移需要排空的执行中轮次。 ## 必要性 到期 cron 可能等待用户回答，而目录恢复又等待 cron 结束。Web Shell 等待恢复完成后才展示问题，形成加载循环，并在 30 秒后超时；此时健康检查和聊天记录读取仍然正常。bridge 的提示轮次摘要显示不活跃，并不能证明内部自动任务已经结束。当目录上下文或到期 cron 消息追加到工具调用之后时，保存的问题也可能无法再被发现。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 使用临时配置和 runtime 目录、真实 Git worktree 及本地 mock provider，分别验证会话绑定的持久化 cron 已过期、保存的问题尚未回答，以及两者同时存在的冷恢复。加载应在精确的归属 worktree 中完成，返回持久化归属证明，聊天记录可读且展示预期的问题内容。 组合场景中，通过多次状态读取让原问题保持待回答，再仅在夹具中回答。确认到期 cron 随后在该 worktree 中执行，并展示有独立内容的问题。同时检查错误归属、目录迁移失败、严格记录消失或降级、工作区 generation 已关闭等情况会被拒绝；热附着以及初始就是旧版记录或不含 worktree 的恢复保留兼容行为。 本地全量 build、bundle 和 typecheck、修改文件的 lint/format、bridge/Session/恢复/keepalive/接线/core 的聚焦单测或测试选择，以及三种隔离 daemon/ACP E2E 均通过。已完成连续两轮干净自审和原地正确性审查。同步到当前 main 后，被测试的补丁保持不变。 ### 证据（修改前后） 修改前，已安装的 0.27.4 在过期 cron 夹具中于 30,458 ms 后返回 HTTP 500，报错为 `AcpSessionBridge changeSessionCwd timed out after 30000ms`，子进程报 `Session close timed out after 30000ms`。cron 请求不包含目标 worktree 路径。独立的保存问题夹具返回 HTTP 200，但缺少调和后的 `currentCwd`。 修改后，最终 bundle 在过期 cron、保存的问题及组合场景中分别于 1,827 ms、2,100 ms 和 1,769 ms 返回 HTTP 200。三者均返回精确归属 cwd 和 `persisted-v1`，问题与聊天记录均可访问。组合场景的原问题在三秒内的 15 次探测中持续保留；仅在夹具中回答后，到期 cron 在 307 ms 内于正确 worktree 继续执行，聊天记录从 6 增至 22 个事件。独立 E2E 报告评论记录了验证细节。 ### 已测试平台 | 平台 | 状态 | | :---: | :---: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境（可选） macOS 26.7.1；build/typecheck/单测使用 Node.js 26.12.1；pnpm 11.24.0。隔离 daemon/ACP 的基线与最终 E2E 使用 Node.js 24.12.0、loopback OpenAI 兼容 mock provider、虚构 provider 凭证，以及临时 Git/配置/runtime/Conversations 目录。未调用外部模型 provider，也未重启或升级共享用户 daemon。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：cwd 恢复与待答问题重建期间必须保持自动任务准入暂停，同时允许前台问题处理及后续后台任务恢复。覆盖关闭锁与排空的分离，以及回答后的 cron 继续执行。 - 未验证或范围外：本地未验证 Windows、Linux、外部模型 provider 和完整包测试矩阵。为 Web Shell/定时恢复之外直接使用 bridge 的调用方增加 daemon worktree 调和、Live conversation 目录迁移、跨 daemon 写入归属以及修复已经在运行中卡住的会话，均不在本次范围内。 - 破坏性变更或迁移说明：不需要公开 REST/配置迁移，也不重写聊天记录。私有恢复元数据为增量扩展；保留初始旧版记录、不含 worktree 的恢复及旧 bridge 的兼容行为。 设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9826e3318f5f6d8fd63f2447e4f227220803a647/docs/design/2026-11-17-worktree-restore-automatic-work.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/9826e3318f5f6d8fd63f2447e4f227220803a647/docs/design/2026-11-17-worktree-restore-automatic-work.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。 ## 关联 Issue Closes #17648

prs.title: fix(sdk): wait for actual child termination
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Determine whether a child has terminated from its exit or signal result, rather than whether a signal was sent. Preserve the exit failure when termination is already observable before the close handler runs.

## Why it's needed

A successfully delivered signal sets the child's killed flag while the process can still be alive. Treating that flag as completion lets callers continue teardown too early. Conversely, an already-terminated process killed externally can leave a new waiter waiting for a close event that already happened.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a child that handles SIGTERM with delayed shutdown, send the signal, and wait for exit. Waiting should finish only after actual termination.
2. Wait on an already-closed signal-terminated child. The call should promptly report the signal failure.
3. Check normal exit, nonzero exit and the interval between the exit result becoming visible and close delivery.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The full transport unit file changes from 3 failed / 87 passed on the base to 90 passed. An independent real-child reproduction measured premature completion at approximately 0.04 ms on the base and completion after approximately 230 ms, when the delayed child actually terminates, with the fix. The independently signalled/already-closed case now promptly rejects. Normal SDK-only TypeScript checking, changed-file lint, formatting and the normal commit hook pass. Timings describe this reproduction, not a performance benchmark.

The remote tree is identical to the tested local commit tree. Complete repository preflight is not established locally: the unchanged core build was killed with status 137, and a bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. This PR records the completed scoped checks while upstream CI evaluates the proposed commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Scoped tests and independent reproduction |

### Environment

Linux, Node.js 24.22.1, repository-pinned pnpm dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Waiting after signal delivery can now take as long as actual child termination requires. Signal and nonzero exit errors remain visible.
- Not validated / out of scope: Native macOS/Windows process behavior and terminal end-to-end interaction. Complete repository preflight is also pending.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or protocol change; no migration required.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17564.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

依据退出码或终止信号判断子进程是否已经结束，不再将已发送信号当作结束。在 close 处理器尚未执行但退出结果已可见时，仍保留退出错误。

## 修改原因

成功发送信号会设置 killed 标记，但进程可能仍在运行。误判为结束会让调用者提前继续清理；反过来，外部信号终止且已经关闭的子进程可能让新等待者一直等不到已经发生的 close 事件。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 启动收到 SIGTERM 后延迟关闭的子进程，发送信号并等待退出，应等到真实结束才完成。
2. 对已经关闭且由信号终止的子进程等待，应及时报告信号错误。
3. 验证正常退出、非零退出，以及退出结果已可见而 close 尚未送达的阶段。

### 修改前后证据

完整 transport 单元测试文件由基线 3 失败、87 通过变为 90 通过。独立真实子进程复现中，基线约 0.04 ms 就提前完成；修复后约 230 ms，等到延迟子进程实际结束才完成。外部信号终止且已经关闭的情况现在及时拒绝。正常 SDK 范围 TypeScript 检查、修改文件 lint、格式及正常提交 hook 通过。这里的时间用于描述复现，不作为性能基准。

远端树与已测试本地提交树完全一致。本地尚未完成全仓 preflight：未修改的 core 构建以状态 137 被终止，限制堆内存的重试以状态 134 耗尽内存。本 PR 如实记录已完成的范围内检查，由上游 CI 继续验证拟提交版本。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 定向测试和独立复现 |

### 环境

Linux，Node.js 24.22.1，仓库固定版本的 pnpm 依赖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：发送信号后的等待现在会持续到子进程真实结束；信号及非零退出错误继续向调用者报告。
- 未验证或不在范围内：原生 macOS/Windows 进程行为和终端端到端交互。 完整全仓 preflight 也尚未完成。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变公开 API 或协议，无需迁移。

## 关联问题

修复 #17564。

</details>

## Hosted CI follow-up

[Qwen Code CI run 44089647428](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44089647428) built the current head successfully and passed lint/static checks and Linux shard 2/2. In shard 1/2, the SDK test phase passed **36 files / 1,640 tests**, including all **90 ProcessTransport tests**. That job failed later in the separate standalone-runtime check: downloading a runtime archive timed out after retries. The failure originates in the archive fetch, not a reported assertion failure in this PR's affected suite. That earlier run remains failed because of the download timeout. This PR is now ready for review; the new ready_for_review workflow will evaluate the remaining merge gates. Its result is pending.

中文：当前提交的上游 CI 已完成构建、lint/静态检查与 Linux shard 2/2。shard 1/2 中 SDK 测试为 **36 文件、1,640 项通过**，其中 ProcessTransport **90 项通过**；该任务随后在独立运行时检查下载运行时压缩包时重试超时而失败。失败点是下载步骤，并非本 PR 相关套件报告了断言失败。该旧运行仍因下载超时失败。本 PR 现已进入正式评审，新的 ready_for_review 工作流将重新评估其余合并门禁，结果待完成。

prs.title: fix(sdk): clear permission deadlines on callback failure
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Always clear the permission callback deadline when handling finishes, including synchronous throws and rejected promises.

## Why it's needed

A failing callback returns a denial but leaves its deadline running. A synchronous throw can later cause an unhandled timeout rejection and terminate the host; an asynchronous rejection leaves an unnecessary referenced timer after the denial.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Throw synchronously from the permission callback. One denial should be returned, with no later timeout rejection or process crash.
2. Return a rejected promise. One denial should be returned and no deadline timer should remain.
3. Verify ordinary allow and deny callbacks return Promises, observe an armed default deadline during execution, and return the expected response with no deadline remaining afterward. Keep the existing timeout behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The scoped results below apply to the previous head `2c3d75f`.

Both new failure-path cases fail on the base. The full corrected Query unit file passes 75 tests. An independent three-case reproduction passes, including a real child process that previously crashed after the deadline, the zero-retained-timer rejection case and a successful approval control. Normal SDK-only TypeScript checking, changed-file lint, formatting and the normal commit hook pass.

That previous remote tree was identical to the tested local commit tree. Complete repository preflight is not established locally: the unchanged core build was killed with status 137, and a bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44089656153) passed for that previous head; the completed scoped checks are recorded above.

### Review follow-up

#### Default deadline regression coverage (`0133d5f`)

A single outcome table covers allow, deny, synchronous throw and asynchronous rejection. Assertions run outside the permission callback and check the actual **60,000 ms** default delay, the expected response, and zero remaining timers.

- The normal complete Query test file passes **77 tests**. Normal SDK typechecking, including the test fence, and changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff checks pass.

prs.title: feat(acp): run Mods in ACP sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Runs Mods in ACP sessions (`qwen --acp`: the Web Shell daemon, Zed and the VS Code companion). Until now an ACP session never loaded them; with `experimental.mods` on, it now loads the workspace's Mods under the same trust and permission checks as the terminal and headless runs.

- **One Mod session per ACP session.** One ACP process serves many sessions, each with its own Config, and each ACP session now owns its own Mod session. It loads after history replay without holding up `newSession` or `loadSession`, and closes before the session's Config shuts down. A live session that a client loads again keeps its Mods and does not repeat `session.start`.
- **What a Mod hears.**
  - `session.start` and `session.end`, including `/clear`.
  - `turn.start` and `turn.complete` for each prompt that runs `UserPromptSubmit` (a new prompt or a retry), on both the legacy loop and the shared agent loop.
  - `$.model.complete`, `$.store`, the `$.session` reads, `$.clock` and `$.turn.abort`.
  - An ACP session reports `surface: null` and `isInteractive: false`, as a headless run does.
- **What it does not raise yet.**
  - `ui.render`, `prompt.submit`, `tool.call` and `tool.check` are not raised, and Mod commands are not offered.
  - A new load flag tells the Mod worker whether the host raises the tool events. Hooks on events the host does not raise are skipped with the existing "Hooks for unsupported events will not run" diagnostic, so a Mod meant to guard tools is told it is not guarding instead of being silently ignored.
  - `$.prompt.submit` drops its prompt.
- **Logs.** Transcript logs, `turn.complete` notes and load diagnostics reach the client as a new ACP extension notification, `qwen/notify/session/mod-log` with `{ sessionId, plugin, text }`. Clients that don't know the method ignore it. The daemon forwards it to the session's event stream as a `mod_log` frame and drops malformed lines and lines for sessions it does not own. Nothing is written to the ACP process's stdout, which carries the protocol.
- **Isolation.** `$.session.usage()` reads the session's own chat, not the process-wide telemetry count, which belongs to whichever session answered last. Each Mod session also raises the telemetry service's listener limit by one, so a daemon with many sessions does not print a leak warning.
- **Failure.** If the Mods fail to load, the session refuses each prompt with an error naming the failure. The terminal and headless runs also stop on a load failure instead of running without the person's Mods.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-18-mods-in-acp-sessions.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-18-mods-in-acp-sessions.zh-CN.md). User docs: a new "ACP sessions" section in `docs/users/extension/mods.md`, plus the `experimental.mods` description (schema, settings page and its zh / zh-TW translations).

## Why it's needed

Mods could not run anywhere the Web Shell reaches. A Mod that translates the model's English output, keeps per-turn notes, or calls `$.model.complete` did nothing there. This is the step before the Web Shell draws Mod rewrites of message rows, and it is the hook-based route that ACP's stopgap `MessageRewriteMiddleware` asks for in its README.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Turn on `"experimental": { "mods": true }` in user settings and install a Mod extension with, for example:
   ```js
   on('session.start', ($, e, next) => { $.ui.log('start ' + e.surface); return next(e); });
   on('turn.complete', async ($, e, next) => { await next(e); return { text: 'heard: ' + e.answer }; });
   ```
2. Start `qwen serve` on a trusted workspace, open a session, subscribe to `GET /session/:id/events`, and send a prompt. Expect two `mod_log` frames for that session: `start null`, then `heard: <the answer>`. Close the session and confirm a `session.end` hook still runs (for example, it writes to `$.store`).
3. Over plain `qwen --acp`, add a `tool.call` hook to the Mod. Expect the client to receive the `mod-log` notification "Hooks for unsupported events will not run: tool.call" when the session loads.

Automated checks:

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/mods/runtime.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: a host that raises no tool events skips `tool.call` hooks with the diagnostic and leaves the tool events out of `$.session.version()`.
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/acp-mod-session.test.ts`. These cover:
  - the ACP host loads only in ACP mode, raises no prompts or tool events, and logs through its callback without writing to stderr;
  - usage figures come from the session's own chat;
  - the listener limit goes up and back down;
  - log lines go out under the ACP session id, also after `/clear`;
  - a failed load refuses every prompt;
  - legacy-loop streams read as content, retries and a finish;
  - turn endings come out as answer, error or aborted.
- `cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridgeClient.test.ts`: the daemon forwards `mod-log` and drops malformed or foreign lines.
- `npm run bundle && cd integration-tests && QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/mods-acp.test.ts`, run once on the legacy loop and once on the shared loop. The built CLI runs over ACP with the fake model server and two sessions in one process. A Mod hooks `tool.call` and logs at `session.start`, `turn.start` and `session.end`. In `turn.complete` it calls `$.model.complete`, writes and reads `$.store`, and counts turns in a module variable. The first session's second prompt reads a file before answering, so its turn spans two model responses. Each session receives, in order:
  - the diagnostic;
  - its own `session.start`;
  - its turns, each with the last response's answer;
  - its own turn count;
  - `/clear` ends the first session's Mods session.
- `npm run typecheck`; `src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` and `src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts` still pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: an ACP session with `experimental.mods` on loads no Mods. No hook runs, and nothing reaches the client or the daemon's event stream.

After: the integration test passes on both loops (about 4.4 s each). Against a real `qwen serve` daemon, the session's event stream carried:

```json
[
  { "sessionId": "6e2d3a79-…", "plugin": "daemon-probe", "text": "start null" },
  { "sessionId": "6e2d3a79-…", "plugin": "daemon-probe", "text": "heard: Daemon answer." }
]
```

Closing that session returned in 38 ms after its `session.end` hook had written `ended: other 6e2d3a79-…` to the Mod's store.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built bundle over `qwen --acp` (integration test) and `qwen serve` (manual check), both with an isolated HOME and a local fake OpenAI-compatible server.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The legacy loop hands the turn raw model responses. The host maps each response to content, retries and a finish. The response commit point is shared by both loops, so the legacy finish there is skipped on the shared loop, which sends its own; without that skip the shared loop's answer came out empty. This mapping goes away with the legacy loop.
  - Each ACP session that loads Mods runs its own Mod worker thread, whose guest memory is capped at 64 MiB.
  - Until the Web Shell types `mod_log`, the SDK turns each frame into an unrecognized debug block. The Web Shell filters those blocks out, but a chatty Mod's frames still take slots in the session's event ring.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - Out of scope: render sites and the Web Shell display (the next step); tool and command middleware and prompts (a later ACP step); removing `MessageRewriteMiddleware`. `experimental.mods` stays off the Web Shell settings page until the Web Shell shows Mod output.
  - Not validated: daemon shutdown with Mods; concurrent prompts across sessions (isolation rests on the prompt-id filter and each session's own Config); Zed and the VS Code companion themselves.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing hosts. The terminal and headless hosts keep raising tool events, and the new load flag defaults to on.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 Mod 在 ACP 会话（`qwen --acp`：Web Shell daemon、Zed 和 VS Code companion）中运行。此前 ACP 会话从不加载 Mod；现在打开 `experimental.mods` 后，它会加载工作区的 Mod，信任和权限检查与终端和 headless 运行相同。

- **每个 ACP 会话一个 Mod 会话。** 一个 ACP 进程服务多个会话，每个会话有自己的 Config，现在每个 ACP 会话也拥有自己的 Mod 会话。它在历史回放之后加载，不拖慢 `newSession` 或 `loadSession`；在会话的 Config 关闭之前关闭。客户端再次 load 一个仍在运行的会话时沿用它的 Mod，不会重复 `session.start`。
- **Mod 能听到什么。**
  - `session.start` 和 `session.end`，包括 `/clear`。
  - 每个运行 `UserPromptSubmit` 的 prompt（新 prompt 或重试）的 `turn.start` 和 `turn.complete`，旧循环和共享 agent 循环都支持。
  - `$.model.complete`、`$.store`、`$.session` 的读取、`$.clock` 和 `$.turn.abort`。
  - ACP 会话报告 `surface: null` 和 `isInteractive: false`，与 headless 运行相同。
- **暂不触发的。**
  - 不触发 `ui.render`、`prompt.submit`、`tool.call` 和 `tool.check`，也不提供 Mod 命令。
  - 新增一个加载标志，告诉 Mod worker 宿主是否触发工具事件。宿主不触发的事件上的 hook 会被跳过，并写现有的 "Hooks for unsupported events will not run" 诊断。因此用来守卫工具的 Mod 会被告知它没在守卫，而不是被静默忽略。
  - `$.prompt.submit` 丢弃它的 prompt。
- **日志。** 要进对话记录的日志、`turn.complete` 备注和加载诊断，通过新的 ACP 扩展通知 `qwen/notify/session/mod-log`（`{ sessionId, plugin, text }`）到达客户端。不认识这个方法的客户端会忽略它。daemon 把它作为 `mod_log` 帧转发到会话的事件流，丢弃格式错误的或不属于它的会话的日志行。不向 ACP 进程的 stdout 写任何东西，那里承载协议。
- **隔离。** `$.session.usage()` 读会话自己的 chat，而不是进程范围的遥测计数，后者属于最后应答的那个会话。每个 Mod 会话还把遥测服务的监听器上限加一，打开很多会话的 daemon 不会打印泄漏警告。
- **失败。** Mod 加载失败时，会话用一个说明失败原因的错误拒绝每个 prompt。终端和 headless 运行同样在加载失败时停下，而不是在没有用户的 Mod 的情况下继续运行。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-18-mods-in-acp-sessions.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-18-mods-in-acp-sessions.zh-CN.md)。用户文档：`docs/users/extension/mods.md` 新增 "ACP sessions" 一节，并更新了 `experimental.mods` 的说明（schema、设置页面及其 zh / zh-TW 翻译）。

## 为什么需要

Web Shell 能到达的地方都跑不了 Mod。翻译模型英文输出、记录每轮笔记或调用 `$.model.complete` 的 Mod 在那里都不起作用。这是 Web Shell 绘制 Mod 改写的消息行之前的一步，也是 ACP 的临时方案 `MessageRewriteMiddleware` 在其 README 中希望的基于 hook 的方案。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在用户设置中打开 `"experimental": { "mods": true }`，并安装一个 Mod 扩展，例如：
   ```js
   on('session.start', ($, e, next) => { $.ui.log('start ' + e.surface); return next(e); });
   on('turn.complete', async ($, e, next) => { await next(e); return { text: 'heard: ' + e.answer }; });
   ```
2. 在受信任的工作区启动 `qwen serve`，打开一个会话，订阅 `GET /session/:id/events` 并发送一个 prompt。应看到该会话的两个 `mod_log` 帧：`start null`，然后是 `heard: <答案>`。关闭会话，确认 `session.end` hook 仍会运行（例如写入 `$.store`）。
3. 通过普通的 `qwen --acp`，给 Mod 加一个 `tool.call` hook。会话加载时，客户端应收到内容为 "Hooks for unsupported events will not run: tool.call" 的 `mod-log` 通知。

自动化检查：

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/mods/runtime.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`：不触发工具事件的宿主会跳过 `tool.call` hook 并写诊断，`$.session.version()` 不列出工具事件。
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/acp-mod-session.test.ts`。覆盖：
  - ACP 宿主只在 ACP 模式下加载，不触发 prompt 和工具事件，日志经回调发出，不写 stderr；
  - 用量数字取自会话自己的 chat；
  - 监听器上限先加一、关闭后恢复；
  - 日志行用 ACP 会话 id 发出，`/clear` 之后也是；
  - 加载失败后每个 prompt 都被拒绝；
  - 旧循环的流被读成内容、重试和 finish；
  - turn 结束时分为 answer、error 或 aborted。
- `cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridgeClient.test.ts`：daemon 转发 `mod-log`，丢弃格式错误的或不属于它的日志行。
- `npm run bundle && cd integration-tests && QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/mods-acp.test.ts`，旧循环和共享循环各跑一次。构建后的 CLI 通过 ACP 运行，配合假模型服务器，同一进程里有两个会话。一个 Mod hook 了 `tool.call`，在 `session.start`、`turn.start` 和 `session.end` 写日志。它在 `turn.complete` 中调用 `$.model.complete`、读写 `$.store`，并用模块变量给 turn 计数。第一个会话的第二个 prompt 先读一个文件再回答，所以它的 turn 跨两个模型响应。每个会话按顺序收到：
  - 诊断；
  - 自己的 `session.start`；
  - 自己的 turn，每个都带最后一个响应的答案；
  - 自己的 turn 计数；
  - `/clear` 结束第一个会话的 Mod 会话。
- `npm run typecheck`；`src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` 和 `src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts` 仍然通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：打开 `experimental.mods` 的 ACP 会话不加载任何 Mod。没有 hook 运行，客户端和 daemon 的事件流都收不到任何东西。

之后：集成测试在两条循环上都通过（各约 4.4 秒）。在真实的 `qwen serve` daemon 上，会话事件流收到了：

```json
[
  { "sessionId": "6e2d3a79-…", "plugin": "daemon-probe", "text": "start null" },
  { "sessionId": "6e2d3a79-…", "plugin": "daemon-probe", "text": "heard: Daemon answer." }
]
```

关闭该会话用时 38 毫秒，返回之前它的 `session.end` hook 已把 `ended: other 6e2d3a79-…` 写入 Mod 的 store。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

构建后的 bundle，分别通过 `qwen --acp`（集成测试）和 `qwen serve`（手动验证）运行，都使用隔离的 HOME 和本地假 OpenAI 兼容服务器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：
  - 旧循环交给 turn 的是原始模型响应。宿主把每个响应映射成内容、重试和 finish。响应提交点由两条循环共用，所以共享循环下跳过那里的旧循环 finish，因为共享循环会发自己的；不跳过时，共享循环的答案会变成空的。旧循环移除后，这个映射也随之移除。
  - 每个加载 Mod 的 ACP 会话都运行自己的 Mod worker 线程，guest 内存上限 64 MiB。
  - 在 Web Shell 定义 `mod_log` 类型之前，SDK 把每个帧转成一个未识别的 debug 块。Web Shell 会过滤掉这些块，但日志很多的 Mod 的帧仍会占用会话事件 ring 的位置。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - 不在范围内：渲染站点和 Web Shell 的显示（下一步）；工具和命令中间件以及 prompt（后续的 ACP 步骤）；移除 `MessageRewriteMiddleware`。在 Web Shell 显示 Mod 输出之前，`experimental.mods` 不出现在 Web Shell 设置页。
  - 未验证：带 Mod 的 daemon 退出；跨会话的并发 prompt（隔离依靠 prompt id 过滤和每个会话自己的 Config）；Zed 和 VS Code companion 本身。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对现有宿主无影响。终端和 headless 宿主仍触发工具事件，新加载标志默认打开。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #13749

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>

prs.title: feat(i18n): add Arabic support for CLI and Web Shell with RTL layout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This pull request adds complete Arabic language support across both the command-line interface and the Web Shell, including right-to-left layout support in the Web Shell and exported HTML transcripts.

In core and the CLI, Arabic is registered as a shipped language option in the shared output language table and settings schema so it appears alongside existing locales in interactive language selection, slash-command completions, daemon feature advertisement, ACP integrations, and automated locale checks. A full Arabic locale catalog is included for CLI prompts, commands, tool display names, and subscription quota notices with all six Arabic cardinal plural forms.

In the Web Shell, Arabic is supported across transcript views, standalone gates, Managed agent views, slash-command subcommand completion, local command hints, toast notices, settings dialogs, and the service-worker offline fallback. Right-to-left rendering is driven automatically from the resolved UI language via document and portal direction attributes, Radix direction context propagation, conversion of layout-directional CSS and Tailwind utilities to logical properties, mirrored pointer-drag resize deltas and horizontal arrow-key navigation, flipped directional chevrons and back arrows, RTL-aware sticky DataTable pinning and Switch thumb travel, and explicit left-to-right preservation for code blocks, diffs, terminals, structured spreadsheets, charts, left-to-right plan dependency topology graphs, and interactive waiting games. Interactive-only Arabic translations are stubbed out of the read-only transcript export bundle while keeping transcript-reachable Arabic strings available in exported HTML documents, and the document export bundle budget has been updated to match the measured size.

## Why it's needed

Arabic-speaking users previously had to fall back to English in both the terminal CLI and the browser Web Shell, and Arabic text inside the Web Shell rendered inside an English left-to-right shell chrome with unmirrored spacing, borders, popovers, drawers, and directional controls. Adding full Arabic catalogs, CLDR six-form pluralization, and full RTL layout mirroring makes both interfaces natural and usable for Arabic users without inflating read-only exported HTML transcripts with interactive-only UI strings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Switch the CLI UI language to Arabic via settings or `/language ui ar`, and verify locale normalization for regional and POSIX variants such as `ar-SA` and `ar_EG.UTF-8` while confirming unrelated prefix neighbors like `armenian` do not map to Arabic. Confirm CLI menus, `/language` choices, tool display badges, and multi-form quota messages render in Arabic, and model output language settings recognize `Arabic` alongside existing options.
2. Open the Web Shell in standalone or embedded mode with Arabic selected via `?language=ar`, `/language ui ar`, `/settings`, or browser locale, and verify both the root container and the portal root carry `lang="ar"` and `dir="rtl"`.
3. Inspect key RTL surfaces in Web Shell: the sidebar docks on the start side and widens when dragging its resize handle leftward, popovers and tooltips open on the mirrored side, the floating artifact drawer slides from the left edge, the docked right panel widens when dragging its divider rightward, horizontal tab and timeline arrow navigation follows RTL order, directional back arrows and collapsed chevrons mirror visually, switches slide leftward when toggled on, and DataTable sticky leading/trailing columns pin to the right and left edges respectively.
4. Confirm code blocks, diffs, terminals, spreadsheets, ECharts, and left-to-right DAG plan dependency graphs remain legible with intentional left-to-right structural geometry while user messages isolate mixed-direction text cleanly.
5. Export a conversation to HTML while using Arabic and verify exported transcripts render localized status labels and RTL direction without pulling interactive-only Arabic dictionaries into the read-only transcript bundle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Automated verification after the final edits confirmed green workspace builds, TypeScript typechecks across all packages and integration tests, zero-warning strict linting, CLI i18n checks showing 1976/2005 Arabic keys translated with zero missing keys, clean read-only transcript bundle builds within the updated byte ceiling, and passing unit/DOM tests covering core output-language consumers, CLI language/quota behavior, Web Shell Arabic pluralization, non-collision locale normalization, build-boundary separation, and RTL layout/resize/drawer/table behavior. Live browser screenshots were not captured locally in this turn.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 macOS verification covering workspace builds, strict ESLint, TypeScript typechecks, Prettier formatting, CLI locale validation, and Vitest unit/DOM suites. Playwright browser E2E, integration suites, and Windows/Linux hosts remain to be validated in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Adding Arabic to the shared core output-language table affects downstream consumers across core goal verification, session title generation, the settings JSON schema, the CLI language registry and `/language` command, serve settings/feature routes, ACP integration, and the i18n check script; all downstream consumers were verified against the build, typecheck, and existing/expanded unit tests. In Web Shell, keeping synchronous translator lookups splits Arabic strings into transcript-reachable and interactive-only modules so read-only HTML exports grow by 47,120 measured bytes (including RTL runtime wiring) rather than carrying all interactive copy. Broad logical CSS/Tailwind refactoring across Web Shell components relies on automated CSS, ref-compat, and DOM suites locally and benefits from Playwright/visual spot-checks in CI.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code IDE companion host-chrome strings outside the embedded Web Shell remain English and Simplified Chinese only and were left untouched as requested scope focused on CLI and Web Shell; terminal RTL rendering behavior depends on the host terminal emulator; full Playwright visual tests and non-macOS runners were not executed locally; an unrelated pre-existing timing race observed in the Managed local-files bridge test suite also reproduces identically on the untouched base commit.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. English remains the fallback locale, existing partial-catalog behavior for Russian is unchanged, and existing language configuration values continue to work without migration.

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 为命令行界面（CLI）与 Web Shell 增加了完整的阿拉伯语语言支持，并在 Web Shell 及导出的 HTML 对话记录中支持从右到左（RTL）的镜像布局。

在 Core 与 CLI 部分，我们将阿拉伯语注册为共享输出语言表及设置 Schema 中的内置语言选项，使其能够同步出现在交互式语言选择器、斜杠命令补全、守护进程特性声明、ACP 集成以及国际化校验脚本中。同时新增了完整的 CLI 阿拉伯语翻译词典，覆盖交互提示、命令说明、工具显示名称以及包含全部六种阿拉伯语基数复数形态的订阅配额提示。

在 Web Shell 部分，阿拉伯语已全面覆盖对话记录视图、独立认证门槛页、托管 Agent 视图、斜杠命令子命令补全、本地命令提示、Toast 通知、设置面板以及 Service Worker 离线回退页。系统会根据解析出的界面语言自动在根容器与 Portal 根节点设置 `lang="ar"` 与 `dir="rtl"`，并通过 Radix 方向上下文向下透传；同时将具备方向语义的 CSS 与 Tailwind 样式统一改造为逻辑属性，在 RTL 模式下镜像处理侧边栏与右侧面板拖拽调整宽度的方向符号、横向键盘方向键导航、返回箭头与折叠尖角图标方向、Switch 开关滑块位移动画以及 DataTable 固定列的吸顶方向；对于代码块、Diff、终端、电子表格、图表、有向无环计划拓扑图和等待小游戏等需要保持物理从左到右结构的内容，则显式保留 LTR 排版，并对混合方向的用户消息采用双向隔离渲染。为避免导出体积膨胀，仅交互界面使用的阿拉伯语词条会在导出 HTML 构建模式中被独立存根剔除，仅保留只读记录所需词条，并依据实测字节数同步更新了导出运行时大小预算。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前使用阿拉伯语的用户在 CLI 与 Web Shell 中只能回退到英文界面，且 Web Shell 中的阿拉伯语文本会直接嵌入英文 LTR 界面框架里，导致边距、边框、弹出层方向、抽屉滑出方向以及箭头图标方向均与阿拉伯语阅读习惯相反。通过补充完整的阿拉伯语词条、CLDR 六形态复数规则以及全套 RTL 镜像布局，两个端都可以为阿拉伯语用户提供自然完整的使用体验，同时保证只读导出的 HTML 文件不会被仅用于交互界面的翻译文本拖累体积。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 在 CLI 中通过配置文件或 `/language ui ar` 切换界面语言为阿拉伯语，并验证 `ar-SA`、`ar_EG.UTF-8` 等区域/POSIX 标签的规范化解析，同时确认诸如 `armenian` 等共享前缀但不相干的词不会被误识别为阿拉伯语。检查 CLI 菜单、`/language` 选项、工具名称徽章、订阅配额多复数形式以及模型输出语言 `Arabic` 的显示与设置是否正常。
2. 在独立模式或嵌入模式下通过 `?language=ar`、`/language ui ar`、`/settings` 或浏览器语言切换到阿拉伯语打开 Web Shell，确认主根节点和 Portal 根节点均带有 `lang="ar"` 和 `dir="rtl"` 属性。
3. 验证 Web Shell 中的核心 RTL 交互与布局：侧边栏停靠在起始侧且向左拖拽分隔条时加宽，Tooltip 与 Popover 在镜像侧弹出，窄屏下的浮动右侧抽屉从左侧滑入，宽屏停靠下的右侧面板向右拖拽分隔条时加宽，水平 Tab 与时间轴导航遵循 RTL 方向键顺序，返回箭头和折叠箭头图标完成水平镜像，Switch 在开启时向左滑动，DataTable 固定首列与操作尾列分别吸附在右侧和左侧边缘。
4. 确认代码块、Diff 视图、终端、电子表格、ECharts 图表以及计划 DAG 拓扑图依然保持清晰的从左到右结构方向，同时包含阿英混排的用户消息可正确自动隔离文本方向。
5. 在阿拉伯语环境下导出 HTML 对话记录，确认导出文档可正确呈现本地化状态文案与 RTL 排版，且仅交互场景使用的阿拉伯语词典未被打包进只读导出产物。

### 对比证据

在最终修改完成后，我们已完成全仓工作区构建、全量 TypeScript 类型检查、零警告严格 ESLint 检查、Prettier 格式化校验、CLI 国际化脚本校验（阿拉伯语共翻译 1976/2005 项，缺失关键项为 0）、导出 HTML 运行时体积校验以及核心模块、CLI、Web Shell 与 VS Code Companion 相关单测和 DOM 测试验证。本次在本地未额外截取实时浏览器界面截图。

### 运行环境说明

基于本地 macOS 与 Node 22 环境完成了工作区构建、严格 ESLint 检查、TypeScript 类型检查、Prettier 格式检查、CLI 语言校验与 Vitest 单元/DOM 测试；Playwright 浏览器 E2E 测试、集成测试及 Windows/Linux 环境需由 CI 进一步验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在核心公共输出语言表中新增阿拉伯语会影响目标校验、会话标题生成、设置 JSON Schema、CLI 语言注册及 `/language` 命令、daemon 设置与特性路由、ACP 集成以及 i18n 检查脚本等下游消费方；上述全部下游消费方均已通过构建、类型检查以及原有与新增单测的验证。在 Web Shell 中，为保持同步翻译读取契约，我们将阿拉伯语词条拆分为只读记录与交互界面两个模块，使导出 HTML 运行时资产实测净增 47,120 字节（包含 RTL 方向控制逻辑）而不会引入大批量交互文案。组件库及各页面级样式大量改造为 CSS 逻辑属性与 RTL 镜像规则后，本地已通过 CSS 规则、ref 兼容与 DOM 单测验证，建议 CI 中结合视觉回归进一步复核。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：VS Code 扩展宿主侧外部框架文案未在本次范围内，仍维持英文与简体中文（其中嵌入的 Web Shell 本体支持阿拉伯语和 RTL）；终端层面的双向文字排布效果取决于用户所用的终端模拟器本身；全量 Playwright 视觉测试及非 macOS 平台尚未在本地运行；在 Web Shell 全量测试运行中观察到的 Managed 本地文件桥接测试条目存在一处上游基线提交已引入的无关竞态失败（我们的改动未涉及该目录）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。英文继续作为兜底语言，俄语既有的部分词条策略保持不变，现有语言配置无需任何迁移即可继续使用。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): close six deferred loop review pins
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes six review findings that the merged managed `/loop` slices recorded as deferred under the convergence posture — acknowledged but not fixed in their rounds. Each was re-verified against current main before fixing. (1) The fake model's minted-id extraction in the skill E2E delete fixture regains a meta-test pin (the assertion-side `createdScheduleId` pin had left it uncovered). (2) The classifier block-schema narrowing becomes an executable top-level pure helper (`classifierBlockAnswer`) used by both the skill and fire fakes and exercised in the meta-test against block and non-block schemas, so an additive fallback that mis-answers unrelated side queries reddens. (3) The union/wakeup sentinel guard is inverted from a deny-list of known non-expanding forms to an allow-list of the two expanding `-dynamic` forms, extracted as the pure `assertSentinelsExpanded` and executed against a hostile body, so a newly added sentinel ships red. (4) The interval table's `Nd` claim is corrected: `0 0 */N * *` is a day-of-month step that resets at each month start, not a rolling N-day cadence; the bundled source, the generator's managed substitution and the regenerated sidecars all carry the accurate wording plus a month-boundary caveat. (5) A parity test pins the exact Parsing rule inventory so a rule deleted from the bundled source reddens (the source→body drift guard alone cannot see a deletion). (6) The profile set becomes a single exported source (`MANAGED_LOOP_PROFILES`) with the type derived from it, replacing six hand-kept test lists so an added or removed profile cannot drift.

## Why it's needed

These are the load-bearing gaps the review rounds explicitly deferred: a forged witness could pass (fake id extraction, classifier mis-answer, new sentinel), a deleted contract rule could vanish silently, the profile set could drift across hand-kept lists, and the skill taught an inaccurate cron cadence. Closing them makes the existing assertions honest and fail-closed without changing any production runtime behavior — the skill generator is test-only and the only artifact a running Session reads is the regenerated sidecar JSON.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the core parity suite (`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/loop/managed-loop-skill.test.ts`) and the scripts meta suites (`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`). To confirm the new guards are load-bearing, apply each mutation and watch the matching assertion redden, then restore: add an additive `shouldBlock:false` fallback for non-block schemas in `classifierBlockAnswer` (non-block directions redden); revert `assertSentinelsExpanded` to the old deny-list (the brand-new-sentinel direction reddens); replace the fake `createdId` regex with a fabricated id (its pin reddens); delete a Parsing rule from SKILL.md (the inventory pin reddens); add a post-gate fallback that re-derives the allow through `classifierBlockAnswer` under a second binding (the AST answer-site set reddens); reassign a `let` decision to an inline `{ shouldBlock: false }` after the gate, or with `??=` (the construction-site and reassignment sets redden); fabricate one arm's `blockProperties` initializer (the provenance set reddens); rewrite the caveat bound to `Keep N ≤ 45` and regenerate the sidecars, or lower the Managed slot compiler's day-of-month upper bound (the derived assertion reddens); delete the Java `SHELL_V3` routing branch (the routing-target set reddens while the sidecar-key assertion stays green). For the real stack, rebuild the jar (`mvn -B -pl server -am package -DskipTests -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Dspotbugs.skip=true` under packages/managed-agent-server) and run `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-skill` and `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-fire`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Before: the six gaps existed as deferred findings. After, on current main: core parity 33/33 green (bundled and per-shell Parsing inventories, allow-list and call-site tests, sidecar-set pin, Java supply set and profile→key routing map, parser-derived caveat clauses, two-evaluator agreement, regenerated-sidecar byte-for-byte parity); scripts meta 183/183 green (fake createdId pins, executable classifier narrowing, executable minted-id extraction, and the executed AST classifier-wiring scanner with its loop scoping); eslint, prettier and core typecheck clean. Six review rounds and two independent verification rounds are folded in. The `Nd` bound is N ≤ 30, and the caveat's bound and worked examples are derived from `compileCron` — the TypeScript twin of the Java `CronSlots` scanner that actually fires a Managed schedule — asserted as whole clauses so the two month-boundary gaps cannot be swapped, with `parseCron` (which the local `CronCreate` validates with) bound to agree on every step. The profile single-source crosses into both Java sites, the sidecar supply map and `forProfile`'s profile→key mapping, scraped from comment-stripped code so a comment-only Java edit does not redden the suite. The minted-id extraction is a pure helper executed against hostile histories. The classifier wiring is pinned as AST structure scoped to the loop fake callbacks: schema-properties provenance, helper bindings and every helper call's argument, `!== undefined` gates, one answer site per callback under its own call id, tool-name sites (string or template literal), the allow's single construction site inside the helper, and any write to the decision or its input (any assignment operator, member write, delete, `Object.assign`). Every inventory has a mutation witness, including the four survivors the second verification round measured; a comment naming a binding stays green, and a legitimate non-loop `respond_in_schema` arm no longer reddens a loop pin. Every witness returns green on byte-equal restore. The branch is merged up to date with main (zero file overlap with the incoming commits). Real packaged-stack arms re-run green at this head after a frozen-lockfile install, full build, bundle and jar rebuild, with the rebuilt jar's four sidecars verified byte-equal to the committed contracts: `--loop-skill` success (session `0d3900aa-983e-4885-823c-997d21ab2eca`, modelRounds 6, cron create/list/delete all witnessed); `--loop-fire` success (session `94d32c41-0be2-4104-ba27-6becdcca3305`, `fireTrigger=scheduled`, `fireOutcome=fired`, `fireState=completed`, occurrenceKey `schedule:2026-11-18T05:55:00Z`, modelRounds 5). One deferred item is tracked in #17673: binding the caveat's oracle to `CronSlots.java` through shared fixture cases, a cross-language contract change kept out of this PR.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local packaged stack: MySQL 8.4.6 (runner-private mysqld), Spring executable jar (JDK 21.0.9), `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` with embedded runtime broker, fake OpenAI server; Node 24.22.1 for the runner and vitest. No sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the `Nd` wording change alters model-facing skill content in two places — the regenerated Managed sidecars and the bundled local `SKILL.md`, which ships with the build and is read at runtime by `readBundledReference`. It is a correctness fix (day-of-month stepping, not a rolling cadence), the byte-for-byte parity test is the oracle for the sidecars, and the caveat's bound and worked examples are derived from the Managed slot compiler (with the local parser bound to agree). The sentinel allow-list is stricter than the old deny-list but the shipped bodies already carry only the two expanding forms, so no body changes from it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the remaining ~64 deferred entries (design-doc stale claims, dead Java branches, child-catalog code gaps, other probes) need their own triage against current code; local macOS/Windows runs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No Java source change and no new CI arm. No runtime *code* changes: nothing imports managed-loop-skill.ts at runtime (its consumers are the regenerator and its test), and the classifier helper lives in the E2E runner's fake model. Shipped *content* does change — the bundled local `/loop` SKILL.md and the Managed sidecar JSON the Java classpath copies at build — which is the intended `Nd` correctness fix, not a behavior or API change. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-deferred-pins.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-17-managed-loop-deferred-pins.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17272, #17433, #17470, #17506 (referenced without closing keywords — closes the six deferred review findings those PRs recorded, not an issue).
