<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

关闭已合入 managed `/loop` 切片在收敛姿态下记为延后的六条评审发现——已确认但当轮未修。每条先对当前 main 复验再修。(1) skill E2E delete 夹具的假模型 minted-id 提取重获元测试钉（断言侧 `createdScheduleId` 钉曾使其失覆盖）。(2) 分类器 block-schema 收窄成为可执行顶层纯 helper（`classifierBlockAnswer`），skill 与 fire 两个 fake 都用它，并在元测试中对 block 与非 block schema 执行，使误答无关侧查询的 additive fallback 红。(3) union/wakeup 哨兵守卫从已知非展开形的 deny-list 反转为两个展开 `-dynamic` 形的 allow-list，提取为纯函数 `assertSentinelsExpanded` 并对敌意 body 执行，使新增哨兵红。(4) 间隔表 `Nd` 声明修正：`0 0 */N * *` 是每月月初重置的月内日期步进，非滚动 N 天节奏；bundled source、生成器 managed 替换与重生 sidecar 都带准确措辞加月界 caveat。(5) parity 测试钉住精确 Parsing 规则库存，使从 bundled source 删除规则红（仅 source→body drift guard 看不到删除）。(6) profile 集合成为单一导出来源（`MANAGED_LOOP_PROFILES`），类型由其派生，替换六个手工测试列表，使增删 profile 不漂移。

## 为什么需要

这些是评审轮明确延后的承重缺口：伪造见证可通过（fake id 提取、分类器误答、新哨兵）、删除的契约规则可静默消失、profile 集合可在手工列表间漂移、skill 教了不准确的 cron 节奏。关闭它们使既有断言诚实且失败关闭，不改任何生产运行时行为——skill generator 仅 test，运行中 Session 读的唯一产物是重生的 sidecar JSON。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

跑 core parity 套件（`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills/bundled/loop/managed-loop-skill.test.ts`）与 scripts 元套件（`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/managed-agent-server-e2e.test.js scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`）。确认新守卫承重：施加每个变异看对应断言红再还原——在 `classifierBlockAnswer` 对非 block schema 加 additive `shouldBlock:false` fallback（非 block 方向红）；把 `assertSentinelsExpanded` 回退旧 deny-list（全新哨兵方向红）；把 fake `createdId` 正则换成伪造 id（其钉红）；从 SKILL.md 删一条 Parsing 规则（库存钉红）；在门之后加一段经 `classifierBlockAnswer` 在第二绑定下重推 allow 的 fallback（AST answer 站点集合红）；把 `let` 决策在门后重赋值为内联 `{ shouldBlock: false }` 或用 `??=`（构造点与重赋值集合红）；伪造某一臂的 `blockProperties` 初始化式（来源集合红）；把 caveat 上界改成 `Keep N ≤ 45` 并重生 sidecar，或调低 Managed 槽编译器日域上界（派生断言红）；删 Java `SHELL_V3` 路由分支（路由目标集合红，而 sidecar 键断言仍绿）。真实栈：重建 jar（packages/managed-agent-server 下 `mvn -B -pl server -am package -DskipTests -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Dspotbugs.skip=true`）并跑 `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-skill` 与 `npm run test:e2e:managed-loop-fire`。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI）。前：六缺口以延后发现存在。后（当前 main）：core parity 33/33 绿（bundled 与各 shell 的 Parsing 库存、allow-list 与调用点测试、sidecar 集合钉、Java 提供集合与 profile→key 路由映射、解析器派生的 caveat 子句、双求值器一致性、重生 sidecar 逐字节 parity）；scripts 元 183/183 绿（fake createdId 钉、可执行分类器收窄、可执行 minted-id 提取，以及被执行的 AST 分类器接线扫描器及其 loop 域限定）；eslint、prettier 与 core typecheck 净。已折入六轮评审与两轮独立验证。`Nd` 上限为 N ≤ 30，caveat 的上界与示例由 `compileCron`（真正触发 Managed 调度的 Java `CronSlots` 扫描器的 TS 镜像）派生，并以整条子句断言，故两个月界间隔无法对调；同时绑定 `parseCron`（本地 `CronCreate` 用它校验）对每个步长与之一致。profile 单一来源跨入 Java 两处——sidecar 提供 map 与 `forProfile` 的 profile→key 映射——且刮取前剥离注释，故仅改 Java 注释不会红。minted-id 提取为对敌意历史执行的纯 helper。分类器接线以 AST 结构上钉并限定在 loop fake 回调域：schema-properties 来源、helper 绑定与每次 helper 调用的实参、`!== undefined` 门、每回调一个 answer 站点且各带自己的 call id、工具名站点（字符串或模板字面量）、allow 在 helper 内的唯一构造点，以及对决策或其输入的任何写入（任意赋值运算符、成员写入、delete、`Object.assign`）。每项库存都有变异见证，含第二轮验证测出的四个存活缺口；提到绑定名的注释保持绿，合法的非 loop `respond_in_schema` 臂不再红到 loop 钉。每个见证字节级还原复绿。分支已合并最新 main（与 incoming 提交零文件重叠）。真实打包栈臂在本 head 经 frozen-lockfile 安装、全量构建、bundle 与 jar 重建后复跑绿，重建 jar 内四个 sidecar 已核实与已提交契约逐字节相等：`--loop-skill` success（session `0d3900aa-983e-4885-823c-997d21ab2eca`、modelRounds 6、cron create/list/delete 均见证）；`--loop-fire` success（session `94d32c41-0be2-4104-ba27-6becdcca3305`、fireTrigger=scheduled、fireOutcome=fired、fireState=completed、occurrenceKey `schedule:2026-11-18T05:55:00Z`、modelRounds 5）。一条延后项转 #17673：经共享 fixture 案例把 caveat 的 oracle 绑定到 `CronSlots.java`，属跨语言契约改动，留在本 PR 之外。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测 · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测 · 🐧 Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境（可选）

本地打包栈：MySQL 8.4.6（runner 私有 mysqld）、Spring 可执行 jar（JDK 21.0.9）、`dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` 带内嵌 runtime broker、假 OpenAI 服务器；runner 与 vitest 用 Node 24.22.1。无沙箱。

- 主要风险/取舍：`Nd` 措辞改动在两处改变模型面向的 skill 内容——重生的 Managed sidecar，以及随构建发布、由 `readBundledReference` 在运行时读取的 bundled 本地 `SKILL.md`。是正确性修复（月内日期步进非滚动节奏）：sidecar 以逐字节 parity 测试为 oracle，caveat 的上界与示例由 Managed 槽编译器派生（并绑定本地解析器与之一致）。哨兵 allow-list 比旧 deny-list 更严，但 shipped body 本就只带两个展开形，故它不引起 body 变化。

prs.title: feat(channels): add Microsoft Teams extension and host ingress
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Microsoft Teams channel extension for personal conversations, explicit group mentions, channel-thread isolation and ordered final-text replies. It supports standalone operation and an application host using the same protocol code.

Hosts can call `createTeamsIngress(name, credentials, acceptInbound)` without constructing a bridge, router, channel or listener. It returns only `handleWebhook`; the Microsoft SDK authenticates and normalizes each Activity, and success waits for acceptance. TeamsChannel delegates to the same verification path. Execution and send hooks remain separate from HTTP ingress.

## Why it's needed

Teams users lack a native channel provider. Application hosts need durable acceptance and ownership checks without copying Teams protocol logic or modifying inference core.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Verify private messages and trusted bot mentions execute; ordinary group text, wrong bot/tenant, bad serviceUrl, and invalid signature/audience/issuer/expiry do not.
- Set another bot's `Connections__*` environment registry: explicit Teams credentials must remain authoritative, including audience and issuer validation.
- Block or reject the acceptance callback. HTTP success must wait, and persistence failure must be retryable. Original actor/thread/target must survive concurrent requests.
- Verify exact-event cancellation and revocation suppress output, including empty/oversized completed results. These results become bounded notices through the ordinary ChannelBase cancellation and send path.
- Base 0.23.0 supports hosted operation only; 0.26.1 supports standalone and hosted operation. One physical host-provided base instance is required.
- Run the actual release script for a new version, pack/install the manifests together, and confirm the current exact base peer follows the release while the tested legacy peer remains supported.

### Evidence

Focused package tests, repository build/typecheck/bundle, release-script tests and independent compiled SDK/Fastify verification are reported in the verification comment for the current source revision. Independent checks cover the new ingress on both supported base versions, existing channel behavior, completed-result/cancellation races, and an actual release consumer installation.

JWT tests use temporary RSA keys and local JWKS lookup through the real SDK verifier. Connector/UserToken clients are controlled recorders. This demonstrates protocol and host behavior, not live tenant delivery.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Local build, package, SDK/host and release-consumer verification |
| Windows | Local verification not performed |
| Linux | CI results are recorded separately |

Node 22.23.1, Microsoft Agents SDK 1.9.1, Fastify 5.11.3.

## Risk & Scope

- Standalone scheduling/dedup is in memory. Durable acceptance, execution recovery and delivery retry policy belong to the host. The standalone ingress itself neither queues nor deduplicates.
- No changes to inference core, ChannelBase or built-in provider registration. Publication and registry inclusion remain maintainer decisions. Untested base versions are not declared compatible.
- Not validated: real tenant app installation, Microsoft JWKS/Connector network, actual agent tools, and end-to-end CLI extension loading. The global CLI baseline was unavailable; built CLI smoke is tracked separately. National clouds, attachments, Graph history, cards and scheduled delivery are outside this proposal.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/teams-channel/docs/design/teams-channel.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/teams-channel/docs/design/teams-channel.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15618. This remains a draft proposal; it is not merged or published.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

通用 Teams 扩展支持私聊、群显式 @、帖子隔离和顺序文本回复。新增独立 `createTeamsIngress`，无需临时 Bridge/Router/Channel，也不启动监听器；同一 SDK 验签路径等待宿主接收完成再 ACK。显式认证连接隔离宿主环境配置，空白/超长确定结果沿正常取消与发送保护处理，发版脚本同步当前 base peer 并保留已验证 legacy peer。

持久化、恢复与重试策略归宿主；插件不绑定特定应用或数据库。未改推理核心、ChannelBase 或内置注册表。合成 SDK/Fastify、取消竞态和实际包安装证据与真实 Teams 租户验收分别记录；维护者接受、合并和正式发布仍待完成。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): extract the shared composer status stack component
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extracts the composer status stack — the bordered root that holds the queued-prompt display and the active-goal strip — out of the two daemon chat columns and into a single shared presentational component. Both the main daemon column and the split-view / side-task column now render that one component instead of each carrying its own copy of the same inline JSX. The change is behavior-preserving: each column keeps its own mount condition and its own callbacks, and the goal strip still appears only while the session snapshot carries a goal. This is the first step of slice 2 of the unified chat surface design, which converges the daemon and managed chat columns onto one backend-neutral surface.

## Why it's needed

The status-stack markup was duplicated verbatim across the two daemon columns, so any future change to its structure (a new element, a different gate, a renamed test anchor) had to be made twice and could silently drift between the main column and the panes. Centralizing it removes that duplication and is a named deliverable of slice 2 ("slice 2 creates the component"). Doing this small, behavior-preserving extraction first also de-risks the larger move of the main chat column into the shared surface that follows in this slice.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new characterization test together with the two child component suites and the two host suites from `packages/web-shell`; all should pass with no behavior change:

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/components/ComposerStatusStack.test.tsx client/components/QueuedPromptDisplay.test.tsx client/components/GoalStatusStrip.test.tsx client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/App.test.tsx
```

Observed locally: `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 1844 passed (1844)` (the new stack adds 4 cases; the full `App.test.tsx` alone is 1565 cases). The new test renders the real component with the real children and pins the shared root anchor, the queued-prompt region, and the goal strip appearing only when a goal is present (and still rendering the root for a goal-only stack with an empty queue).

Type gates (the stricter CI build gate is `tsconfig.lib.json`):

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0
```

ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files. Note: a stale local `@qwen-code/sdk` dist can produce unrelated `no exported member` errors in `tsconfig.lib.json`; rebuild the SDK (`npm run build --workspace=@qwen-code/sdk`) before judging the gate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — behavior-preserving refactor. The rendered DOM is identical: the same root anchor (`composer-status-stack`), the same queued-prompt and goal-strip regions, the same mount gates. The browser-level visual before/after gate is reserved for the subsequent step that switches the main column onto the shared surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests and type checks only (vitest + tsc). No daemon or browser run was needed for this presentational extraction.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: minimal — a pure presentational extraction with no logic change; the host suites (including the full main-column suite) pass unchanged. The shared component takes the children's props as grouped objects so a prop added to a child cannot drift out of the stack's type.
- Not validated / out of scope: browser visual parity (reserved for the surface switch); the managed column, the `ChatSurface` component itself, and the daemon adapter are later steps of slice 2 and are untouched here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No public API, route, storage key, or session namespace changes.

Design: [unified-chat-surface (EN)](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) · [简体中文](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.zh-CN.md). Builds on the merged contract (#17520) and composer decoupling (#17661).

## Linked Issues

Part of slice 2 of the unified chat surface design (#17460). Follows the merged decoupling prerequisite #17661.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 composer 状态栈——承载排队提示显示与活动目标条的带边框根容器——从两个 daemon 聊天列中抽取出来，合到一个共享的纯展示组件里。主 daemon 列与分屏/侧任务列现在都渲染这一个组件，而不再各自保留一份相同的内联 JSX。改动保持行为不变：每一列仍保留自己的挂载条件与回调，目标条仍只在会话快照携带目标时出现。这是统一聊天界面设计 slice 2 的第一步，该 slice 的目标是把 daemon 与 managed 聊天列收敛到一个后端中立的共享界面。

## 为什么需要

状态栈标记此前在两个 daemon 列里逐字重复，因此今后对其结构的任何改动（新增元素、更改门控、重命名测试锚点）都得改两遍，且可能在主列与分屏之间静默漂移。集中化消除了这份重复，也是 slice 2 明确点名的交付物（「slice 2 创建该组件」）。先做这个小的、行为不变的抽取，也为随后把主聊天列搬入共享界面的更大动作降低风险。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/web-shell` 下运行新的表征测试、两个子组件套件与两个宿主套件，应全部通过且无行为变化：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/components/ComposerStatusStack.test.tsx client/components/QueuedPromptDisplay.test.tsx client/components/GoalStatusStrip.test.tsx client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/App.test.tsx
```

本地实测：`Test Files 7 passed (7)`、`Tests 1844 passed (1844)`（新状态栈增加 4 个用例；完整 `App.test.tsx` 单独就有 1565 个用例）。新测试用真实子组件渲染真实组件，钉住共享根锚点、排队提示区域，以及目标条仅在存在目标时出现（空队列+仅有目标时仍渲染根容器）。

类型门（更严格的 CI 构建门是 `tsconfig.lib.json`）：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0
```

ESLint 与 Prettier 在改动文件上均干净。注意：本地陈旧的 `@qwen-code/sdk` dist 会让 `tsconfig.lib.json` 报出无关的 `no exported member` 错误；判定该门前请先重建 SDK（`npm run build --workspace=@qwen-code/sdk`）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——行为不变的重构。渲染 DOM 完全一致：相同的根锚点（`composer-status-stack`）、相同的排队提示与目标条区域、相同的挂载门控。浏览器级视觉前后对比门留待随后把主列切换到共享界面的那一步。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅（本地）；🪟 Windows ⚠️；🐧 Linux ⚠️（交由 CI）。

### 环境

仅本地单元测试与类型检查（vitest + tsc）。此纯展示抽取无需 daemon 或浏览器运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：极小——纯展示抽取、无逻辑变更；宿主套件（含完整主列套件）原样通过。共享组件以分组对象接收子组件 props，子组件新增 prop 不会从状态栈类型中漂移出去。
- 未验证/超出范围：浏览器视觉一致性（留待界面切换）；managed 列、`ChatSurface` 组件本身、daemon adapter 都是 slice 2 的后续步骤，此处不动。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。不改任何公共 API、路由、存储键或会话命名空间。

设计文档：[unified-chat-surface（英文）](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) · [简体中文](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.zh-CN.md)。建立在已合入的契约（#17520）与 composer 解耦（#17661）之上。

## 关联 Issue

属于统一聊天界面设计（#17460）slice 2 的一部分。承接已合入的解耦前置 #17661。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sdk): enforce the peer frame limit before dispatch
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reject an oversized peer frame before dispatching its completed line, including when the terminating newline arrives in the same chunk. Stop processing the overflowing batch while preserving valid separate frames whose combined size exceeds the per-frame cap.

## Why it's needed

The existing guard only limits the unfinished buffer. A complete oversized line bypasses that guard and reaches the message consumer, so enforcement depends on how the stream is chunked.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Send a completed frame larger than the advertised limit in one chunk. It should trigger the overflow path and deliver no frame.
2. Repeat with an oversized unfinished frame, and with an exact-limit frame. Only the oversized frame should be rejected.
3. Send multiple individually valid frames in a batch larger than the per-frame limit. All valid frames should arrive in order.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The new regression file changes from 2 failed / 3 passed on the unchanged base to 5 passed; the existing framing suite adds 26 passing tests, for 31 total. An independent source-level parser reproduction passes 3 controls/cases. SDK-only normal TypeScript checking, isolated strict checking of the new test, changed-file lint, formatting and the normal commit hook pass. Real socket listening was unavailable in this environment (EPERM); the parser test uses a controlled socket implementation and does not claim network end-to-end coverage.

The remote tree is identical to the tested local commit tree. Complete repository preflight is not established locally: the unchanged core build was killed with status 137, and a bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. This PR records the completed scoped checks while upstream CI evaluates the proposed commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Scoped tests and independent reproduction |

### Environment

Linux, Node.js 24.22.1, repository-pinned pnpm dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Oversized completed frames that previously slipped through are now rejected. Valid per-frame boundaries and batches remain compatible.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real socket network end-to-end execution and native macOS/Windows execution. Complete repository preflight is also pending.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or protocol change; no migration required.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17562.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

在完整行交付前检查 peer 帧大小，包括换行符和超限内容一起到达的情况。发生超限后停止处理该批次，同时保留每个帧都合法、仅批次总长度超过单帧上限的情况。

## 修改原因

原检查只限制未完成的缓冲区；已经带换行的超大帧可以绕过检查并进入消费者，导致限制是否生效取决于网络分块。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 单个分块发送超过上限且带换行的完整帧，应触发超限路径且不交付帧。
2. 分别检查未完成的超大帧和恰好达到上限的帧，仅超大帧应被拒绝。
3. 在总大小超过单帧上限的批次中发送多个各自合法的帧，应按顺序全部交付。

### 修改前后证据

新增回归文件在未修改基线上为 2 失败、3 通过，修改后为 5 通过；现有分帧测试另有 26 通过，共 31 通过。独立的实际解析器复现及对照为 3 通过。SDK 范围的正常 TypeScript 检查、新测试的独立严格类型检查、修改文件 lint、格式和正常提交 hook 均通过。本环境监听真实 socket 返回 EPERM，因此测试使用受控 socket 实现，没有宣称网络端到端覆盖。

远端树与已测试本地提交树完全一致。本地尚未完成全仓 preflight：未修改的 core 构建以状态 137 被终止，限制堆内存的重试以状态 134 耗尽内存。本 PR 如实记录已完成的范围内检查，由上游 CI 继续验证拟提交版本。

### 测试平台

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the missing SSE admission cap display to the Web Shell daemon status dialog (follow-up 3 of #17554). The transport card gains an "SSE admission (used / cap)" row right below the live REST SSE counter: when the daemon reports the aggregate stream occupancy breakdown, the row pairs that total with the effective cap — the cap's own scope, deliberately not the REST-only counter above it; a daemon that reports the cap without the breakdown shows the cap alone; a daemon predating the cap omits the row entirely; a disabled cap reads as unlimited. English, Chinese, and Russian locales are updated, and four fixture tests cover the paired, cap-only, unlimited, and absent states.

This branch also carries follow-up 4 of #17554, merged in via #17664: the deferred #17502 review pins and the SSE test hygiene in `packages/cli/src/serve/server.test.ts` (shared forced-stall / deadline-read / slot-release fixtures, five reworked suites, and the `Deferred #17502 review pins` describe). That CLI test refactor is the largest part of this diff and is test-only — no production code arrives with it.

Stacked on #17662 (follow-ups 1 and 2 of #17554), which introduces the aggregate occupancy and per-listener caps this row displays. Base branch: `feat/sse-unified-admission-occupancy`.

## Why it's needed

#17502 added `limits.maxSseConnections` to daemon status and noted the Web Shell row as a follow-up; #17554 tracks it explicitly. Operators watching the status dialog could see the live REST SSE count but not the admission budget that refuses new streams, so approaching saturation was invisible in the UI. With the stacked base PR broadening the cap to every stream surface, the dialog now shows the aggregate occupancy paired with the cap at the cap's own scope.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- From `packages/web-shell`: `npx vitest run client/components/dialogs/DaemonStatusDialog.test.tsx client/i18n.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 110 passed, including the four row states: `6 / 204` paired display (aggregate total 6 spread over listeners 3/2/1, REST-only counter 3 stays its own row), cap-only exact text `SSE admission (used / cap)204` when the breakdown is absent, `0 / unlimited` when the cap is null, and no row at all when the daemon omits the field; plus the zh/ru parity case for the new label. `npm run typecheck` in the same package passes.
- From `packages/cli` (the follow-up 4 CLI test refactor — **run locally: a non-default base branch gets no unit CI**): `npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "(Deferred #17502 review pins|T2.9 SSE writer idle timeout|SSE reaper arming|Unified SSE admission/occupancy)" --coverage.enabled=false` — expect 24 passed at this head (the full file collects 1506). The deferred pins cover the zero-budget arm gate (exact `[15000]` interval list), budget-comparison discrimination, override enforcement consolidated with the exact `5/5` refusal body and deep-health-at-saturation pair, the refusal WARN context, and timer cleanup; each pin is mutation-verified.
- Against a live daemon from the stacked base PR: open the daemon status dialog (rail → More → Daemon Status, Overview tab); the transport card shows "SSE admission (used / cap)" with the same total/cap pair that `GET /daemon/status?detail=full` reports under `runtime.transport.streamOccupancy.total` and `limits.maxSseConnections`. Start the daemon with `--max-sse-connections 0` and the row reads `0 / unlimited`; against an older daemon without the cap field the row is absent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the transport card shows only "REST SSE streams: N" with no admission budget anywhere in the dialog. After: an "SSE admission (used / cap)" row appears directly below it (e.g. `6 / 204`), degrading gracefully for older daemons. Verified via the jsdom fixture tests above **and** a browser-level pr-ui-verify run against four real daemons (head bundle with six held streams → `6 / 204`; base-commit daemon with cap but no breakdown → `204`; `--max-sse-connections 0` → `0 / unlimited`; pre-#17502 global qwen → no row), zero page errors: report at `.qwen/e2e-tests/sse-unified-admission-occupancy/pr-ui-verify-17663-r2.md`, screenshots on the fork branch `assets-pr17663` under `pr17663-r2/` (non-TUI surface; no tmux capture needed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

jsdom component tests + web-shell typecheck; cli selection above + cli typecheck; eslint/prettier clean on the changed files; Playwright (headless Chromium) for the four-state browser verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the row pairs the aggregate occupancy with the cap while the row above remains REST-only — intentional, because the cap gates every surface; the two rows are separately labeled so the scopes are not conflated.
- The follow-up 4 portion is test-only (`server.test.ts`); its risk is pin strength, addressed by the mutation witnesses named in the test plan.
- Not validated / out of scope: per-listener caps and the per-surface breakdown stay API-only (the issue asks for the cap row); Windows/Linux locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the row is conditional on fields older daemons omit, so nothing changes for them.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17554 (follow-ups 3 and 4). Stacked on #17662; includes #17664 merged into this branch.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep each /send reply in view and drop the gap under send records
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes two layout problems in the Web Shell caller page after a `/send`.

A message sent with `/send` no longer leaves a gap between its bubble and its timestamp row. The message is only a record of the send and never starts a turn of its own, but the per-turn hook statistics row treated it as a prompt and attached an empty padded row under it.

When several sends get their replies back, the collapsed turn now keeps each relayed answer in view next to its "Cross-session message" card. Before, all those replies landed in one turn, and collapsing kept only the last answer, so the earlier replies looked unanswered until the turn was expanded. Each reply another session sent is its own exchange, so the answer before each such card is now kept as well, including an answer that a passive completion split into several rows. Ordinary background-agent results keep their existing folding, where only the turn's final answer stays visible.

## Why it's needed

With two `/send` messages in flight, the user saw two reply cards followed by only the second relay; the first relay was hidden among the folded steps. The extra gap under every send record also made the transcript look broken. Both were reported while using #17539.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a Web Shell session, send two messages with `/send` to sessions in another trusted workspace (for example "reply with 1" and "reply with 2"), and wait for both replies.
2. Hover a sent message: the timestamp row sits right under the bubble, the same distance as for an ordinary user message.
3. After both replies arrive and the turn collapses: each "Cross-session message" card is followed by its own relayed answer. Thinking and tool steps are still folded, and expanding the turn shows them as before.
4. A turn with ordinary background-agent results still collapses to its final answer only.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Two sends and their replies, collapsed (mock daemon replay):

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/before-replay.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/after-replay.png) |

A hovered send record:

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/before-hover-send.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/after-hover-send.png) |

Unit tests: the hook statistics turns no longer take a send record as a turn, and the collapsed-turn DOM tests cover a reply card keeping the answer before it plus two reply cards where the first answer is split by a completion marker. All three fail without the fix. Web Shell typecheck, eslint and prettier pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Web Shell Vite dev server against the Playwright mock daemon, replaying a transcript with two send records and two reply turns.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: only turns that contain a reply from another session change their collapsed view; other turns take the same path as before (the split-answer handling was moved into a shared helper without changing it).
- Not validated / out of scope: replies to several sends still share one turn group, so the group header's elapsed time is measured from the last send. Splitting each reply into its own group would change turn boundaries across the transcript and is left out.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17539.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

修复 Web Shell 调用方页面在 `/send` 之后的两个布局问题。

用 `/send` 发出的消息，气泡和时间戳行之间不再有一大段空白。这条消息只是发送记录，本身不会开启一轮；但每轮的 hook 统计行把它当成了 prompt，在它下面挂了一个带内边距的空行。

多条发送的回复都回来后，折叠的一轮会在每张“跨会话消息”卡片后面保留它对应的转述。之前这些回复都落在同一轮里，折叠只保留最后一条回答，前面的回复看起来像没有回答，要展开才能看到。另一个会话发来的每条回复都是一次独立的往来，所以每张这类卡片之前的回答现在也会保留，包括被被动完成通知切成几行的回答。普通后台智能体结果的折叠方式不变，仍然只显示这一轮的最终回答。

## 为什么需要

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Web Shell 会话里用 `/send` 给另一个受信 workspace 里的会话发两条消息（例如“回复 1”“回复 2”），等两条回复都回来。

### 证据（修复前后）

| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/before-hover-send.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/c6308b0a1932886da7bf877f29eca728fc622eeb/after-hover-send.png) |

单元测试：hook 统计不再把发送记录当成一轮；折叠一轮的 DOM 测试覆盖“回复卡片保留它之前的回答”，以及“两张回复卡片，第一条回答被完成标记切开”的情况。三条测试在没有修复时都会失败。Web Shell 类型检查、eslint 和 prettier 均通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Web Shell 的 Vite 开发服务器加 Playwright mock daemon，回放一份含两条发送记录和两轮回复的对话记录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：只有包含另一个会话回复的轮次，折叠后的显示会变化；其他轮次走的路径和以前相同（处理被切开回答的逻辑移到了一个共用函数里，行为没变）。

prs.title: fix(copy): preserve fence-like content in code and math extraction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Recognize a closing code fence only when it uses the opening marker character, is at least as long, and is followed only by ASCII spaces or tabs, with an optional final carriage return from raw CRLF input. CLI and Web Shell copy extraction retain fence-like content and exclude math inside code.

The follow-up in `b294760` shares the CLI closing predicate across copy extraction, source-hint numbering, Markdown rendering, pending-height calculation, and streaming splits. `CODE_FENCE_RE` and its prefilter remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

A marker followed by text, a language tag, or a non-breaking space is code content. Closing there truncates copied code and can expose later code contents as LaTeX candidates.

The initial extraction fix also left the renderer using the old rule: a `/copy latex 1` or `/copy mermaid 1` hint could label one block while copying another. The shared rule now keeps the rendered source, its index, and the copy command aligned, including across streaming splits.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Include backtick/tilde marker lines followed by text, a longer false fence, or a non-breaking space inside code. Rendering and copying must retain the content until a valid closer.
2. Put hidden math or Mermaid content after a false closer, then a real closing fence and a visible block. The displayed source hint and the actual copy command must both resolve index 1 to the visible source.
3. Verify LF/CRLF, valid longer closing fences with spaces/tabs, pending pipe content, height limits, and code continued across a streaming split.

### Evidence (Before & After)

#### Streaming normalization and consumer regressions (`66a89be`)

The streaming height estimate now uses the renderer's CRLF line splitting, while commit boundaries still index the original text so copied and pending source bytes remain intact.

- The real streaming hook now covers LF, CRLF and doubled-CR line endings with both fence markers. Before the fix, the two doubled-CR cases failed and the four controls passed; all six pass after the one-line normalization change.
- The complete streaming-hook, copy, renderer, height and Markdown utility suites pass **854 tests**, with **5 existing skips**, using the normal package configuration and prerequisite guard.
- Replacing only the splitter's closing predicate with the old marker/length comparison makes the six new trailing-content/NBSP cases fail while its 59 existing cases pass. Restoring the source returns the full utility file to **65 passed**. The cases also check safe boundaries and fence repair with continued line numbers.
- Changed-file ESLint, Prettier and diff checks pass. The normal local CLI build reached the 4 GiB JavaScript heap limit (compiler exit 134), so complete build/typecheck verification is pending in [the exact new head's upstream CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44248698670). Earlier build results below retain their original revision scope.

#### CRLF follow-up (`a809a21`)

prs.title: feat(cli): discover models during custom provider setup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends custom-provider setup and reconnect in `/auth` with an automatically fetched candidate snapshot for OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, in both Ink and native OpenTUI. Users can search, toggle candidates or enter IDs manually; Enter confirms the draft and final Review/Save persists it. Returning restores confirmed selections; leaving during loading aborts the request and ignores late completion. Failed discovery leaves manual entry usable; Gemini remains manual.

Reuses the existing bounded discovery infrastructure and renderer-specific pickers. Preserves built-in preset defaults and curated metadata, adds protocol-specific listing conventions and gateway-map parsing, and disables authenticated redirects for custom discovery. No background polling, daemon changes or automatic capability inference.

**Draft for maintainer design feedback:** #17446 was accepted for exploration, but maintainer sign-off on the automatic authenticated request before Save remains outstanding. This PR retains that proposed behavior and does not imply it has already been approved.

## Why it's needed

Custom-gateway users currently have to look up and type IDs even when their endpoint exposes them. Built-in presets already offer discovery; this extends the same setup experience without adding a parallel configuration service or runtime model-switching feature.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In either renderer, open `/auth` → Custom Provider, choose a supported protocol, and enter a listing-capable URL and key. Entering Model IDs should show cancellable loading followed by unchecked candidate rows, search and manual input. New remote candidates should not be selected automatically.
2. Search and select one candidate with Space, add an unlisted manual ID, and continue to Advanced Config. Return with Esc: the fresh snapshot should restore confirmed choices. Deselect a candidate and confirm again; Review should contain only the intended additions. Nothing should persist until Save; existing configured entries should survive installation.
3. With a missing/invalid listing, manual entry should still proceed. With a delayed listing, Esc should return to API Key, close the request and prevent late screen changes or configuration writes. Gemini should remain manual.
4. Check Responses and Anthropic listing paths/headers, prefix preservation, validated/deduplicated gateway IDs and custom redirect rejection. Existing built-in preset success/fallback, metadata and default redirects should remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: custom-provider Model IDs exposed only a comma-separated manual input, and native OpenTUI did not call discovery. The prior OpenTUI baseline passed 85 auth-dialog tests.

After: strict Bun/OpenTUI against an isolated loopback fixture displayed the following native terminal flow (tmux excerpts, synthetic credentials):

```text
Custom Provider · Step 5/7 · Model IDs
Models · from the provider · 0 checked
○ fixture-alpha
○ fixture-beta
Search beta → Space → 1 checked
Advanced → Esc → fresh listing, 1 checked
Space → 0 checked → Space → 1 checked
Custom Provider · Step 7/7 · Review
"id": "fixture-beta"
Enter to save, Esc to go back
```

Disk assertions confirmed beta was installed and the existing alpha entry was preserved. HTTP 404 allowed manual continuation. Esc cancelled a held request, returned to API Key, closed the connection and left settings unchanged after six seconds. No inference requests were sent. A separate E2E report comment records verification and limitations.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ targeted unit/network/native TUI checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not locally tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not locally tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.14.1; Bun 1.3.14 for native OpenTUI; tmux 140×45; isolated temporary home/configuration; synthetic credentials and loopback fixtures. Strict OpenTUI selection prevented silent Ink fallback.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: entering Model IDs now makes an authenticated request before Save and can wait up to five seconds. Discovery is cancellable, limited to 1 MiB and advisory; custom requests do not follow redirects. Maintainer confirmation of this request timing is outstanding.
- Not validated / out of scope: arbitrary real gateways, Windows/Linux native interaction, background refresh, saved-provider bulk maintenance, daemon network policy, runtime switching and capability inference. Earlier full-suite runs in a shared checkout had failures outside the feature files; they are disclosed rather than claimed as an upstream baseline. A green whole-repository preflight is not claimed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the extra pre-Save request and loading state are intentional observable behavior changes. No settings migration or automatic active-model switch; unsupported listings still allow manual setup.

Synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/cli-custom-model-discovery/docs/design/cli-custom-model-discovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/cli-custom-model-discovery/docs/design/cli-custom-model-discovery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #17446 upon approval and merge. Setup-only subtask of #1206; leaves its broader runtime-switching request open. Web Shell maintenance in #16785 is separate. Extends the existing discovery work from #9980 and #15189.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 Ink 和原生 OpenTUI 的 `/auth` 自定义供应商新建及重新连接流程增加自动获取模型候选快照，覆盖 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses 和 Anthropic 兼容端点。支持搜索、多选、手输；Enter 确认草稿，最终 Review/Save 才保存。返回时恢复已确认选择；加载中离开会中止请求并丢弃晚到结果。发现失败仍可手填，Gemini 保持手填。

复用已有有界发现设施及各渲染器选择器，保留内置预设默认值和精选元数据，增加协议路径和网关映射解析，自定义发现禁止携带认证重定向。不新增后台轮询、daemon 改动或能力推断。

**此 Draft 用于征求维护者设计意见：** #17446 已接受探索，但进入模型步骤即在 Save 前自动发起带认证请求，仍待维护者确认。PR 保留该提案行为，不代表已获批准。

## 为什么需要

自定义网关即使提供模型列表，用户仍需查找并手填 ID。内置预设已有发现能力；此次扩展同一配置体验，不新增平行配置服务或运行时模型切换功能。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 两种渲染器均进入 `/auth` → Custom Provider，选择支持的协议并填写可列举模型的 URL 和 key。进入模型步骤先显示可取消加载，再显示未勾选候选、搜索和手输。新候选不应自动选中。
2. 搜索并用 Space 选中一个候选，加一个列表外手动 ID，进入高级配置。Esc 返回后新快照应恢复已确认选择；取消候选并确认，Review 只列出预期新增项。Save 前不持久化，安装保留已有配置条目。
3. 列表缺失/无效时仍可手填继续；慢列表加载中 Esc 返回 API Key、关闭请求，晚到结果不应更改界面或配置。Gemini 保持手填。
4. 验证 Responses/Anthropic 路径与认证头、路径前缀、网关 ID 校验去重和自定义重定向拒绝。内置预设成功/回退、元数据和重定向默认值不变。

### 前后证据

之前：自定义模型步骤只有逗号分隔的输入框，原生 OpenTUI 不调用发现；旧 OpenTUI 认证对话框基线 85 项测试通过。

之后：严格 Bun/OpenTUI 配合隔离本地模拟服务、tmux 和假凭据，原生终端显示两个未选候选；搜索 beta、Space 勾选；进入高级配置再 Esc 返回，新列表恢复 1 项勾选；取消至 0 再重新勾选；Review 显示 `fixture-beta` 并成功保存。上方英文终端摘录展示对应步骤与原生提示。

磁盘断言确认 beta 已安装且原有 alpha 保留；404 后可手填继续；慢请求中 Esc 返回 API Key、关闭连接，六秒后仍无晚到覆盖且配置未变。未发送推理请求。另附独立 E2E 报告评论说明结果及局限。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向单测、网络与原生终端检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |

### 环境

Node 24.14.1；原生 OpenTUI 使用 Bun 1.3.14；tmux 140×45；临时隔离 home/配置；假凭据及本机模拟服务。严格 OpenTUI 模式防止静默回退到 Ink。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：进入模型步骤会在 Save 前发起带认证请求，最长等待五秒。请求可取消、响应限 1 MiB，仅提供候选，自定义请求不跟随重定向。请求时机仍待维护者确认。
- 未验证及范围外：任意真实网关、Windows/Linux 原生交互、后台刷新、已存供应商批量维护、daemon 网络策略、运行时切换和能力推断。此前共享工作区全量测试在功能文件外有失败，已明确披露，不声称是上游基线；不声称全仓 preflight 全绿。
- 兼容与迁移：新增 Save 前请求和加载状态是有意的可观察行为变化。无需配置迁移、不自动切换当前模型，列表不可用时仍能手填。

同步设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/cli-custom-model-discovery/docs/design/cli-custom-model-discovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/cli-custom-model-discovery/docs/design/cli-custom-model-discovery.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

获批准并合并后关闭 #17446。是 #1206 中仅限 setup 的子任务，保留其运行时切换需求；与 #16785 的 Web Shell 维护分开；扩展 #9980 和 #15189 已有发现实现。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): make background work visible on sidebar session rows
prs.body:
## What this PR does The sidebar's session row now shows its trailing busy marker whenever the session has background work running, tinted with the same amber the background status dot already uses. The marker is named only where it is the one element carrying that name: in the background-only shape the status dot already announces it, so the marker stays unnamed; during a turn the marker keeps its `Running` name and adds a tooltip composing both states. The session details popover names the background work in every shape where something else outranks it — a turn in flight, an approval, or a question. The same change makes the actions agree with what the row advertises. One shared predicate now answers "would closing this session end work it is still doing", counting background tasks alongside a turn, and the gates that read that question use it: the row's own busy state, the archive and delete eligibility checks, the standalone archive handler, the recent rows' archive gate, the delete dialog's block on the session this client is attached to, the Session Overview card actions, and the Activity archive confirmation. Two staleness holes close with it. Selection mode keeps its own copy of each ticked session, so its refresh now carries the background flag too — bulk Archive no longer judges a session by the value it had when ticked. And the delete dialog re-evaluates the guard when it builds the request, not only on click, so a row that turns busy after being ticked can neither be confirmed alone nor ride along in a batch. The status dot's precedence, the touch layout and the existing hover contracts are unchanged. ## Why it's needed A session whose only activity was background work looked finished in the sidebar. The trailing busy marker was suppressed for exactly that shape, so the row carried nothing but a small dot and read like an idle row; and while a turn was in flight the background state was not surfaced anywhere on the row, because the status dot is prompt-gated. Anyone leaving a watch script, a long build or a background agent running could not tell from the sidebar which sessions were still working. The reporting side was already correct: the daemon's live-state and the session catalog both publish the background flag, and the released UI does render the amber dot for a background-only session. This is therefore an expression fix, not a data-path change. Making the row say "busy" also exposed a contradiction worth closing in the same change: the guards behind Archive and Delete only counted turns and other active work, so a row that now clearly advertises background work still offered the action that closes the live session daemon-side and kills it. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Open the Web Shell against a daemon, start a session, and have the agent run a long command in the background (any background shell, e.g. a ten-minute sleep). Let the turn finish. Before: the row shows only a small amber dot on the left and no spinner on the right. After: the row also shows an amber spinning marker on the right, and the row announces "Background tasks running" exactly once — the dot carries the name, the marker does not repeat it. 2. Send another prompt in that session while the background command is still running. Before: green running dot plus a plain grey spinner, with nothing mentioning the background work. After: the spinner is amber and the row's **details popover** reads "Running · Background tasks running". Open the popover by hovering the row; the marker's own `title` carries the same text but is not a dependable place to read it, because hovering the marker fades it out and the revealed action buttons cover it. 3. With that same background-only row, open its "More actions" menu. Archive must be disabled, with the tooltip explaining that archiving would stop the work. In the delete dialog, the session this client is attached to must likewise be unselectable while only background work runs. 4. Hover a background-only row. The row actions must appear and the amber marker must fade out, so the marker is never overlapped by the buttons — and the buttons must still be clickable through the faded marker. Hovering the **status dot** itself keeps the dot visible and hides the actions, as before; that contract is about the dot, not the new spinner. 5. Let the background command finish. Both the amber marker and the amber dot must disappear, and a row with only a running turn must look exactly as it did before this change. Commands, copy-pasteable from the repository root: ``` cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/session-catalog/ client/components/dialogs/ client/components/sidebar/ client/components/SessionOverviewPanel.test.tsx client/visual-capture-contracts.test.ts cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.background-turn.spec.ts client/e2e/web-shell.composer-usage.spec.ts cd packages/web-shell && npm run typecheck ``` Observed on this branch: 1943 unit tests passed across 80 files, 8 Playwright tests passed across the two specs (including the existing "keeps the background task sidebar indicator visible on hover and prioritizes the prompt spinner" contract), and typecheck exited 0. ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files. For disclosure, the full `packages/web-shell` suite reports 16638 passed and 43 failed; all 43 are attributed and unrelated to this diff. 42 are `build-artifact.test.ts` failing with `ENOENT … packages/web-shell/dist` because this worktree has no web-shell build, two channel suites cannot resolve `@qwen-code/channel-email` for the same reason, and one `useManagedLocalFilesBridge` case fails a real-HTTP timing assertion in a module graph that imports none of the changed files. ### Evidence (Before & After) Real browser captures against a live daemon with two real sessions and no response interception. Both arms come from the **same page, same daemon and the same two DOM rows**; the only difference is the code — the After arm is this branch, the Before arm is its base with the three production files swapped back and the page reloaded, then restored. CSS animations were disabled for every capture and the pointer was parked outside the sidebar, so no hover highlight contaminates the comparison. The same two rows in context — top row has a turn in flight *and* a background shell running; bottom row's turn has finished with its background shell still running: | Before (base) | After (this PR) | | --- | --- | | | | Row-level crops of the same two rows: | Session shape | Before (base) | After (this PR) | | --- | --- | --- | | Turn in flight + background work | | | | Background work only | | | Pixel diff on the same-size pairs proves the state was really captured, and localises it: | Pair | Size | Changed pixels | Diff bounding box | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Background-only row | 550×68 | 216 (0.58%) | x 506–530, y 22–46 — exactly the trailing 12×12 CSS marker | | Turn + background row | 550×68 | 398 (1.06%) | x 260–530, y 22–46 — the marker plus the title's truncation fade | | Both rows in context | 582×220 | 614 (0.48%) | x 276–546, y 82–178 — both rows' trailing markers | The background-only pair is the discriminating one: the base renders no trailing marker at all, so the entire changed region is the newly rendered spinner. The review round changed naming, guards and the details status, none of which is visible in a still frame: re-capturing after those fixes produced **byte-identical PNGs** (sha256 compared for all six), so the images above are the current head's rendering. What that round did change was verified in the same real browser: - Chromium's accessibility tree for the background-only row reads `button "Background tasks running 🧵 bg-status-probe Pin More actions"` with a single `img "Background tasks running"` — the name is announced once, not twice. - That row's marker has `aria-label: null` and `title: null`; the turn-in-flight marker keeps `aria-label="Running"` and `title="Running · Background tasks running"`. - Its Archive menu item is `aria-disabled="true"` with the tooltip "A running session cannot be archived; archiving would stop its work". - After hovering the row, hit-testing the "More actions" button's centre returns the button's own icon, so the faded marker does not swallow the click. - Hovering the background-only row: marker opacity 0, actions opacity 1. No page errors in either arm. Manifests: [round 1 images and method](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/assets-pr17676/pr17676-r1/README.md) · [round 2 verification](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/assets-pr17676/pr17676-r2/README.md). ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### Environment `npm run dev` for the Web Shell client, proxied to a local `qwen serve` daemon; unit tests and the two Playwright specs run locally on macOS. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the busy marker shares the row's trailing slot with the branch/worktree icon, so a background-only row now shows the spinner instead of that icon — the same tradeoff a row with a running turn already makes. The amber tint is a second cue, never the only one: the dot's name, the marker's name during a turn, and the details status all carry the state as text. - Behaviour change beyond the visual: a session with running background tasks can no longer be archived from the sidebar, and the session this client is attached to can no longer be deleted while background work runs. That is the point of the change — those actions close the live session and kill the work — and it matches the policy already applied to running turns. The flag is read as strictly `true`, so rows with no live-state coverage stay actionable exactly as before. - Not validated / out of scope: a session that is no longer live (closed, reclaimed, or after a daemon restart) while a detached background shell keeps running still shows nothing, because the shell registry is in-memory and no background flag reaches the client for such a session. The Session Overview panel still grades a background-only session idle, which keeps its sort order and displayed status unchanged; its two destructive card actions are gated separately, because that grade alone would offer them. Two poll-cadence aggregates that ask a similar question are deliberately untouched: they only pick between fast and idle catalog polling on daemons without live-state. The `unknown` and `unsupported` grades also stay out of the shared predicate — the side-task archive gate fails closed on them, and that difference is documented rather than silently widened. All of these are recorded in the design. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new translation keys, no protocol or settings change. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-sidebar-background-marker/docs/design/web-shell-sidebar-background-work-indicator.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-sidebar-background-marker/docs/design/web-shell-sidebar-background-work-indicator.zh-CN.md) — both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and the follow-ups above. ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 侧栏的会话行现在只要该会话有后台任务在跑，就显示右侧的忙标记，并使用后台状态圆点已在用的同一种琥珀色。标记只在它是唯一命名载体时才命名：仅后台形态下状态圆点已经播报了该状态，因此标记不命名；回合进行中时标记保留 `Running` 名字，并新增一个组合两种状态的 tooltip。会话详情浮层则在所有「被别的状态盖过」的形态下都说出后台任务——回合进行中、等待审批、等待回答。 同一改动让操作与行内宣称保持一致。现在由一个共享判据回答「关掉这个会话会不会中断它正在做的工作」，把后台任务与回合一起计入，读这个问题的闸门都改用它：行自身的忙状态、归档与删除的资格判断、standalone 归档处理器、recent 行的归档闸门、删除弹窗对本客户端所连接会话的拦截、Session Overview 的卡片动作，以及 Activity 的归档确认。 随之收口两处「快照过期」漏洞。选择模式保存的是勾选那一刻的会话副本，因此它的刷新现在也带上后台标志——批量归档不再按勾选时的旧值判断。删除弹窗则在**构造请求时**重新评估闸门，而不只在点击时，因此勾选后才变忙的行既不能单独确认，也不能夹在批量里被带走。 状态圆点的优先级、触屏布局与既有悬停契约都不变。 ## 为什么需要 唯一活动就是后台任务的会话，在侧栏里看起来像已经结束。右侧忙标记恰好对这一形态被关掉，于是整行只有一个小圆点，读起来就是空闲行；而回合进行中时，行里任何位置都不体现后台状态，因为状态圆点受 prompt 门控。任何留着 watch 脚本、长构建或后台 agent 在跑的人，都无法从侧栏看出哪些会话还在工作。 上报侧本来就是对的：daemon 的 live-state 与会话目录都会发布后台标志，已发布的 UI 也确实为「仅后台」会话渲染了琥珀圆点。所以这是一次表达层修复，不是数据链路改动。 让行说出「在忙」之后，也暴露出一个值得在同一改动里收口的矛盾：归档与删除背后的判据只数回合与其他活跃工作，于是一行明明在宣称有后台任务，却仍提供会在 daemon 侧关闭该 live 会话、杀掉这份工作的操作。 ## 评审验证计划 ### 如何验证 1. 打开连着 daemon 的 Web Shell，新建会话，让 agent 在后台跑一条长命令（任意后台 shell，例如十分钟的 sleep）。让回合结束。改动前：行里只有左侧一个小琥珀点，右侧没有 spinner。改动后：右侧还会出现一个琥珀色旋转标记，且整行只播报「Background tasks running」一次——名字由圆点承载，标记不重复。 2. 在该后台命令仍在跑时，于同一会话再发一条 prompt。改动前：绿色运行圆点加一个普通灰色 spinner，没有任何东西提到后台任务。改动后：spinner 变琥珀色，该行的**详情浮层**显示「Running · Background tasks running」。悬停该行即可打开浮层；标记自身的 `title` 虽然带同样文案，但不是可靠的读取位置——悬停标记会让它淡出，露出的操作按钮还会盖住它。 3. 对同一个「仅后台」的行打开「More actions」菜单。归档必须为禁用，并带有「归档会中止其工作」的说明 tooltip。在删除弹窗里，本客户端所连接的会话在只有后台任务在跑时同样必须不可选中。 4. 悬停一个只有后台任务的行。操作按钮必须出现，琥珀标记必须淡出，标记不会被按钮遮挡——而且透过淡出的标记，按钮仍必须可点击。悬停**状态圆点**本身时圆点保持可见并隐藏操作按钮，与之前一致；那条契约说的是圆点，不是新增的 spinner。 5. 让后台命令跑完。琥珀标记与琥珀圆点都必须消失；只有回合在跑的行，观感必须与改动前完全一致。 命令，可在仓库根目录直接复制执行： ``` cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/session-catalog/ client/components/dialogs/ client/components/sidebar/ client/components/SessionOverviewPanel.test.tsx client/visual-capture-contracts.test.ts cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.background-turn.spec.ts client/e2e/web-shell.composer-usage.spec.ts cd packages/web-shell && npm run typecheck ``` 本分支上的实测：80 个文件共 1943 个单测通过，两个 spec 共 8 个 Playwright 用例通过（含既有的「keeps the background task sidebar indicator visible on hover and prioritizes the prompt spinner」契约），typecheck 退出码 0。改动文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier 均干净。 如实披露：全量 `packages/web-shell` 为 16638 通过、43 失败，43 条全部已归因且与本 diff 无关。其中 42 条是 `build-artifact.test.ts` 报 `ENOENT … packages/web-shell/dist`（本 worktree 未构建 web-shell），两个 channel 套件因同样原因解析不到 `@qwen-code/channel-email`，还有 1 条 `useManagedLocalFilesBridge` 的真实 HTTP 计时断言，其模块图不导入任何被改文件。 ### 证据（改动前与改动后） 真实浏览器截图，对着真实 daemon、用两个真实会话，未拦截任何响应。两臂来自**同一个页面、同一个 daemon、同两条 DOM 行**；唯一差别是代码——「改动后」是本分支，「改动前」把三个生产文件换回基线并重新加载，截完再还原。每张截图都禁用了 CSS 动画，并把鼠标停在侧栏之外，避免悬停高亮污染对照。 同两行的上下文对照——上行是回合进行中**且**后台 shell 在跑；下行是回合已结束、后台 shell 仍在跑： | 改动前（基线） | 改动后（本 PR） | | --- | --- | | | | 同两行的行级裁剪： | 会话形态 | 改动前（基线） | 改动后（本 PR） | | --- | --- | --- | | 回合进行中 + 后台任务 | | | | 仅后台任务 | | | 对同尺寸图对做像素 diff，证明状态真被截到并定位差异： | 图对 | 尺寸 | 变化像素 | 差异包围盒 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 仅后台的行 | 550×68 | 216（0.58%） | x 506–530、y 22–46 —— 恰好是尾位那个 12×12 CSS 标记 | | 回合 + 后台的行 | 550×68 | 398（1.06%） | x 260–530、y 22–46 —— 标记加上标题截断处的渐隐 | | 两行上下文 | 582×220 | 614（0.48%） | x 276–546、y 82–178 —— 两行的尾位标记 | 其中「仅后台」那对是判别性的：基线根本不渲染尾位标记，所以整块变化区域就是新渲染出来的 spinner。 评审轮改的是命名、闸门与详情状态，这些在静态截图里都看不见：修完后重截得到的是**逐字节相同**的 PNG（六张都做了 sha256 比对），所以上面的图就是当前 head 的渲染。那一轮真正改变的部分，在同一个真实浏览器里做了验证： - Chromium 的无障碍树里，仅后台行读作 `button "Background tasks running 🧵 bg-status-probe Pin More actions"`，其中只含一个 `img "Background tasks running"` —— 名字只播报一次，不是两次。 - 该行标记的 `aria-label: null`、`title: null`；回合进行中的标记保留 `aria-label="Running"` 与 `title="Running · Background tasks running"`。 - 该行的归档菜单项为 `aria-disabled="true"`，tooltip 为「A running session cannot be archived; archiving would stop its work」。 - 悬停该行后，对「More actions」按钮中心做命中测试返回的是按钮自己的图标，说明淡出的标记不吞点击。 - 悬停仅后台行：标记 opacity 0、操作按钮 opacity 1。两臂都无页面错误。 清单：[第一轮图片与方法](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/assets-pr17676/pr17676-r1/README.md) · [第二轮验证](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/assets-pr17676/pr17676-r2/README.md)。 ### 测试过的系统 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### 环境 Web Shell 客户端用 `npm run dev`，代理到本机 `qwen serve` daemon；单测与两个 Playwright spec 在 macOS 本地执行。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：忙标记与分支/worktree 图标共用行内尾位，因此只有后台任务的行现在显示 spinner 而不是该图标 —— 这与回合在跑的行本来就在做的取舍相同。琥珀着色是第二重线索，绝不是唯一线索：圆点的名字、回合进行中时标记的名字、以及详情状态，都用文字承载该状态。 - 超出视觉的行为变化：有后台任务在跑的会话不能再从侧栏归档；本客户端所连接的会话在后台工作仍在跑时也不能删除。这正是本改动的目的——这两个操作会关闭 live 会话并杀掉工作——且与「回合在跑」既有的策略一致。该标志按严格 `true` 读取，因此没有 live-state 覆盖的行与之前一样仍可操作。 - 未验证 / 不在范围：会话已不再 live（被关闭、被回收，或 daemon 重启后）而 detached 后台 shell 仍在跑时，依旧什么都不显示，因为 shell 注册表是纯内存的，这类会话根本没有后台标志到达客户端。Session Overview 面板仍把「仅后台」会话判为 idle，从而保持其排序与显示状态不变；它的两个破坏性卡片动作已另行加闸，因为只靠该等级会把它们放出来。另有两处问法相近的轮询节奏聚合量刻意不动：它们只在没有 live-state 的 daemon 上决定目录轮询走快档还是空闲档。`unknown` 与 `unsupported` 等级同样不并入共享判据——侧任务归档闸门对它们 fail closed，该差异被写明而非静默放宽。以上都已记入设计文档。 - 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。没有新增文案键，没有协议或设置改动。 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-sidebar-background-marker/docs/design/web-shell-sidebar-background-work-indicator.zh-CN.md) —— 两版完整同步，包含设计决策、约束、验收标准与上述后续工作。 ## 关联 Issue prs.title: feat(web-shell): mark sessions carrying a Goal in the sidebar
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a lifecycle-tinted goal marker to the Web Shell sidebar session rows, so a session carrying a Goal is recognizable at a glance without opening the Goals page. The marker is the app-wide Goals glyph tinted with the same execution-status palette the Goals page uses (running / attention), carries a tooltip and accessible name with the localized status and the objective, and opens the session on click — the same action as the row itself. Completed goals render no marker, matching the Goals listings' existing filter; archived rows show the marker as a pure indicator because they do not open on click.

Under the hood, each goal transition writes a small per-session sidecar projection next to the transcript, the session catalog reads it from disk (no IPC probes, no transcript parses), and a best-effort catalog-clock notification — mirroring the PR-binding propagation — makes live clients refetch the marker immediately. The transcript stays canonical: the sidecar is a lag-tolerant projection, repaired by the next transition or load, and mutations serialize per path in-process so rapid automatic transitions cannot land out of order.

## Why it's needed

The Goals page (#17230, #17291, #17349) shows goal state only once opened, and its listing probes live sessions only. The sidebar is the surface users actually scan to find a session; today it gives no hint which sessions carry a goal, and a paused goal in an unloaded session is invisible everywhere except the Goals page. This was explicitly deferred as a non-goal in #17349 because it needs a daemon-side projection; this PR delivers it with the same sidecar pattern the PR-binding feature already proved.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run a daemon with a workspace, create a session and set a goal (`/goal <condition>` or the Goals page). The session's sidebar row shows a blue-tinted Target marker; hovering shows "Goal: In progress — <objective>".
2. Pause the goal (Goals page or `/goal pause`): the marker flips to the attention tone without a manual refresh; resume flips it back. Clearing the goal removes the marker.
3. Restart the daemon without loading the session: the marker is still present (disk sidecar), while the Goals page listing shows nothing until the session loads. Loading a session journaled before this feature recreates the sidecar from the transcript and the marker appears.
4. Archive the session: the archived row shows the marker as a non-clickable indicator; unarchive restores the clickable marker.
5. Switch the UI language to zh-CN / ru: the marker tooltip/accessible name localizes (目标：已暂停 — … / Цель: Пауза — …).
6. Click the marker: it opens the session exactly as clicking the row does, without double-firing the row handler or triggering rename on double-click.

Automated: unit suites all unfiltered — core sidecar/recorder 211, sessionService 279, config 1083; cli session-list 40, Session 1542; acp-bridge 1074; web-shell marker+i18n 51, sidebar 181, App/GoalsDialog/Strip/ChatPane 1820. New mockDaemon E2E spec 2/2 (@smoke: tones painted + accessible name + complete/goal-less absent; marker click navigation); existing goals E2E suites 20/20 unchanged. Mutation witnesses: the unqueued-write mutant is killed by an inverted-delay ordering test (byte-level restore verified); a failed mutation does not block later ones. Real-daemon browser verification: 12/12 checks on the pre-fix build (including the daemon-restart legacy-session path and the ru surface) plus 4/4 post-fix smoke on the rebuilt bundle; screenshots below, contents+raw byte reconciled on the assets branch. Repo-wide typecheck, ESLint, Prettier green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: sidebar rows carry no goal indication (the Goals page is the only surface). After (real daemon, real browser):

| Running marker | Paused marker (attention) |
| --- | --- |
| ![running](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-goal-display/real-env-markers/markers-real-running.png) | ![paused](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-goal-display/real-env-markers/markers-real-paused.png) |

| Legacy session restored after daemon restart | ru surface |
| --- | --- |
| ![restored](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-goal-display/real-env-markers/markers-real-restored.png) | ![ru](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-goal-display/real-env-markers/markers-real-ru.png) |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Isolated `qwen serve` from the local bundle (own HOME + runtime dir, defanged model endpoint), vite dev proxy, real Chromium; mockDaemon Playwright for the E2E specs. Resident daemon untouched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the sidecar is a projection, not the source of truth — a crash between journal append and sidecar write, or an archive move racing a pending write, can lag the marker until the next transition/load (documented lag contract, same as the PR badge; never a wrong state, only a missing one). Mutations serialize per path in-process; no cross-process lock because only the session child writes its own sidecar.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows local runs (CI covers them); goal markers on group headers or the navigation rail (session rows only); budget figures in the sidebar (Goals page remains the detail surface); bulk backfill for pre-feature sessions (they gain the marker on next load).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The summary field is optional everywhere; older daemons omit it and no marker renders. No transcript schema change.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers/docs/design/2026-11-17-web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers/docs/design/2026-11-17-web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17349 (its Non-goals section deferred sidebar goal markers).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 侧栏会话行上加一个按生命周期着色的目标标记，让承载 Goal 的会话一眼可辨，无需打开 Goals 页。标记是全应用统一的 Goals 图标，着与 Goals 页相同的执行状态色板（running / attention），tooltip 与可访问名携带本地化状态与目标内容，点击打开会话——与行点击同一动作。已完成目标不渲染标记，与 Goals 列表的既有过滤一致；已归档行显示纯指示标记（归档行不响应点击打开）。

底层：每次目标转换在转录旁写一个每会话的小型 sidecar 投影，会话目录从磁盘读取（无 IPC 探针、无转录解析），一条尽力而为的目录时钟通知（镜像 PR 绑定的传播机制）让在线客户端立即重取标记。转录保持权威：sidecar 是可滞后的投影，由下次转换或加载修复；变更按路径进程内序列化，快速自动转换不会乱序落盘。

## 为什么需要

Goals 页（#17230、#17291、#17349）只在打开后展示目标状态，且其列表仅探测存活会话。侧栏才是用户日常扫视找会话的界面，今天却看不出哪些会话承载目标；未加载会话里暂停的目标除了 Goals 页外 everywhere 不可见。这在 #17349 中作为非目标明确延后（需要 daemon 侧投影）；本 PR 用 PR 绑定特性已验证的 sidecar 模式交付它。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 起一个带工作区的 daemon，创建会话并设置目标（`/goal <条件>` 或 Goals 页）。会话侧栏行出现蓝色调 Target 标记；悬停显示 "Goal: In progress — <目标内容>"。
2. 暂停目标（Goals 页或 `/goal pause`）：标记无需手动刷新即翻转为 attention 色调；继续则翻回。清除目标移除标记。
3. 不加载会话直接重启 daemon：标记仍在（磁盘 sidecar），而 Goals 页列表在会话加载前什么都不显示。加载本特性之前记入日志的会话会从转录重建 sidecar，标记出现。
4. 归档会话：归档行显示不可点击的指示标记；取消归档恢复可点击标记。
5. 切换界面语言到 zh-CN / ru：标记 tooltip/可访问名本地化（目标：已暂停 — … / Цель: Пауза — …）。
6. 点击标记：与点击行一样打开会话，不会双触发行处理器，双击也不触发重命名。

自动化：单测全部无过滤——core sidecar/recorder 211、sessionService 279、config 1083；cli session-list 40、Session 1542；acp-bridge 1074；web-shell marker+i18n 51、侧栏 181、App/GoalsDialog/Strip/ChatPane 1820。新增 mockDaemon E2E 2/2（@smoke：色调绘制+可访问名+complete/无目标缺席；标记点击导航）；既有 goals E2E 20/20 不变。变异见证：无队列写变异被倒置延迟排序用例击杀（字节级还原核验）；失败变更不阻塞后续。真实 daemon 浏览器验证：修复前构建 12/12（含 daemon 重启遗留会话路径与 ru 面）+ 修复后重建 bundle 冒烟 4/4；截图见下，assets 分支 contents+raw 字节对账。全仓 typecheck、ESLint、Prettier 绿。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：侧栏行无目标指示（Goals 页是唯一界面）。改动后（真实 daemon、真实浏览器）：见上方四张截图（running、paused attention、daemon 重启后遗留会话恢复、ru 面）。

### 测试平台

macOS ⚠️ 未测 · Windows ⚠️ 未测 · Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

本地 bundle 的隔离 `qwen serve`（独立 HOME + 运行时目录、defanged 模型端点）、vite dev 代理、真实 Chromium；E2E 用 mockDaemon Playwright。常驻 daemon 未触碰。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：sidecar 是投影而非事实源——日志追加与 sidecar 写之间崩溃、或归档搬移与待写竞争，可能让标记滞后到下次转换/加载（已记录的滞后契约，与 PR 徽章相同；只会缺失，不会错误）。变更按路径进程内序列化；无需跨进程锁，因为给定会话的 sidecar 只由该会话子进程写。
- 未验证/超出范围：macOS/Windows 本地运行（CI 覆盖）；分组头部或导航栏的目标标记（仅会话行）；侧栏预算数字（Goals 页仍是详情界面）；遗留会话批量回填（下次加载即获得标记）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。摘要字段处处可选；旧 daemon 省略则不渲染标记。转录 schema 不变。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers/docs/design/2026-11-17-web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers/docs/design/2026-11-17-web-shell-sidebar-goal-markers.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

#17349 的续作（其「非目标」段延后了侧栏目标标记）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sdk): stop buffered SSE delivery after cancellation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stop delivering buffered SSE events as soon as the caller cancels the stream. Cancellation is checked after a pending read settles and before each buffered event is delivered, while the existing stream cleanup remains in place.

## Why it's needed

Cancelling after the first event in a network batch currently still delivers later events from that batch. Consumers can therefore apply stale session updates after they have cancelled observation. The outcome should not depend on network chunk boundaries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Send several events in a single LF-delimited batch, read the first event, and cancel. Only the first event should reach the consumer and the body should be cancelled.
2. Repeat with CRLF delimiters and with cancellation occurring as an awaited read settles. No event should be delivered after cancellation.
3. Leave the stream uncancelled and verify ordinary event order, incomplete-tail handling and stream cleanup.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The scoped results below apply to the previous head `43553c7`.

The focused SDK test file reports **3 failed, 18 passed** on the unchanged base and **21 passed** with this change. An independent rerun using the original real ReadableStream reproduction and an uncancelled control reports **2 passed**. Changed-file lint, formatting, the normal commit hook and diff checks pass. That previous remote tree was identical to the tested local commit tree.

The complete repository preflight is not established locally: the unchanged core build was killed with status 137, and a separate bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44087973200) passed for that previous head; the completed scoped checks are recorded above. A global CLI was unavailable, so these results are direct SDK stream tests rather than terminal end-to-end coverage.

### Review follow-up

Commit [`10759b3`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/10759b3ea656a2df39a567e9aca255ec946bd002): Removed the two redundant close-path guards while retaining the post-read and per-event checks. Added an oversized separator-free read that settles during cancellation and an uncancelled oversized-read control, covering cancellation precedence over the framing limit.

Independent hosted verification of the exact head [passed](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44148560137/job/134270263572): 23 SSE tests, normal core/ACP prerequisite builds, SDK typechecking (including the test fence and public surface), and changed-file lint/format checks. Removing only the post-read abort guard made the new oversized-read case fail with `SseFramingError`; the source was then restored and the tracked tree remained clean. This is scoped verification; upstream required CI remains separate.

[Qwen Code CI for head `10759b3`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44147607643) passed. This status update records the upstream run; the existing local and hosted evidence retains its recorded revision and scope.

### Closed-stream and parked-tail coverage (`a16dbb7`)

This follow-up adds tests only; the production parser remains identical to `10759b3`.

- A real zero-prefetch `ReadableStream` retains an unterminated frame, parks the parser's second read, then cancels. No event is delivered; cancellation is observed and exactly two pulls occurred. Removing only the post-read abort guard makes this case deliver event 7 and fail.
- Already-closed LF and CRLF batches each stop after event 1. Removing only the main buffered-event guard makes both cases deliver `[1, 2, 3]` and fail. This verifies that an enqueued final batch is consumed by the main loop before the later `done` read; closing the source does not move queued frames into the decoder-flush loop.
- The complete SSE test file passes **26 tests** on the final local tree, which matches the pushed commit tree. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff checks pass; both mutations were restored before the final run.

The earlier hosted prerequisite-build and SDK-typecheck results above apply to `10759b3`, whose production code is unchanged by this test-only follow-up. For current head `a16dbb7`, [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44238353925) has passed, as have Managed Agent gate, Managed Agent loop verification, Web Shell Managed Host Build, and tui-parity. This records the current head's upstream results separately from the earlier scoped evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Focused SDK tests and independent stream reproduction |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1, Linux, repository-pinned pnpm dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: cancellation deliberately stops delivery of events that were buffered before the signal; uncancelled streams retain their existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete repository preflight, real daemon networking and native macOS/Windows execution.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API or wire-format change; this restores the existing cancellation contract.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17560.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

调用者取消流后，立即停止交付已缓冲的 SSE 事件。在等待中的读取结束后及每次交付缓冲事件前检查取消状态，保留原有响应流清理。

## 修改原因

目前一个网络批次中读出第一个事件后取消，后面的事件仍会送达，消费者可能在取消观察后继续应用旧会话更新。结果不应依赖网络分块方式。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 在一个 LF 分隔批次中发送多个事件，读出第一个后取消。消费者只应收到第一个事件，响应流应被取消。
2. 用 CRLF 分隔符重复，并检查读取结束同时取消的情况。取消后不应再交付事件。
3. 不取消流，验证正常事件顺序、不完整尾部处理及流清理。

### 修改前后证据

下述定向验证结果对应前一提交 `43553c7`。

定向 SDK 测试文件在未修改基线上为 **3 失败、18 通过**，修改后为 **21 通过**。独立复跑原始真实 ReadableStream 复现和无取消对照，结果为 **2 通过**。修改文件的 lint、格式、正常提交 hook 和 diff 检查通过；该前一远端树与已测试的本地提交树完全一致。

本地尚未完成全仓 preflight：未修改的 core 构建以状态137被终止，单独限制堆内存的重试以状态134耗尽内存。该前一提交的 [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44087973200) 已通过，上文记录了已完成的定向检查。环境没有全局 CLI，因此这里是直接 SDK 流测试，未宣称终端端到端覆盖。

### 评审跟进

提交 [`10759b3`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/10759b3ea656a2df39a567e9aca255ec946bd002)：删除两个多余的关闭路径检查，保留读取后和逐事件检查。新增读取超大无分隔符数据时的取消竞态及无取消对照，覆盖取消优先于 framing 上限错误的行为。

精确 head 的[独立远端验证已通过](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44148560137/job/134270263572)：23 项 SSE 测试、正常 core/ACP 前置构建、SDK 类型检查（含 test fence 和公开接口）及修改文件 lint/格式检查。仅移除读取后中止检查时，新增超限读取用例因 `SseFramingError` 失败；随后恢复源码，已跟踪文件树保持干净。这是定向验证；对应提交的上游 CI 结果单独记录如下。

[提交 `10759b3` 的 Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44147607643) 已通过。本次状态更新记录上游运行结果，已有本地和托管验证证据仍仅适用于各自记录的版本与范围。

### 关闭流与挂起尾帧覆盖（`a16dbb7`）

本次仅新增测试，生产解析器与 `10759b3` 完全一致。

- 使用真实零预取 `ReadableStream`，先缓冲未结束帧，等待解析器第二次读取挂起后取消；断言无事件交付、触发取消且恰好读取两次。仅删除读取后 abort 检查时，该用例会错误交付事件 7 并失败。
- 已关闭的 LF/CRLF 批次都只交付事件 1。仅删除主要缓冲循环里的检查时，两项都变为 `[1, 2, 3]` 并失败，确认已入队数据仍先由主循环处理，之后才收到 `done`，不会移入 decoder flush 多帧循环。
- 最终本地树与推送树一致，完整 SSE 文件 **26 项通过**，修改文件 ESLint/Prettier 和 diff 检查通过；两类变异均已恢复后重跑。

上述既有远端前置构建及 SDK 类型检查属于 `10759b3`，本次测试提交没有改变其生产代码。当前 head `a16dbb7` 的 [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44238353925) 已通过，Managed Agent gate、Managed Agent loop verification、Web Shell Managed Host Build 和 tui-parity 也已全部通过。这里单独记录当前提交的上游结果，既有定向验证保留其对应版本与范围。

### 环境

Linux，Node.js 24.22.1，仓库固定版本的 pnpm 依赖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：取消会停止交付信号发生前已经缓冲的后续事件；未取消的流保留既有行为。
- 未验证或不在范围内：完整全仓 preflight、真实 daemon 网络及原生 macOS/Windows 执行。
